```ts
    hole_number: hole,
    winner_id: winner as string | null,
    is_carryover: false,
    payout_amount: payout,
    carryover_to_next: 0,
    hole_scores: scores,
  });
  const tied = (hole: number, carryover: number) => ({
    hole_number: hole,
    winner_id: null as string | null,
    is_carryover: true,
    payout_amount: 0,
    carryover_to_next: carryover,
    hole_scores: scores,
  });
  const netSum = (payouts: { net_result: number }[]) =>
    payouts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.net_result, 0);

  describe('calculatePlayedPot', () => {
    it('is the whole planned pot for a round played as planned', () => {
      expect(calculatePlayedPot(createMockGame(), { plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 18 })).toBe(90); // $5 × 18
      expect(calculatePlayedPot(createMockGame(), { plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 9 })).toBe(45); // $5 × 9
      expect(
        calculatePlayedPot(createMockGame({ pot_type: 'total_pot', pot_value: 90 }), {
          plannedHoles: 9,
          holesPlayed: 9,
        })
      ).toBe(90);
    });

    it('shrinks in proportion to the holes played', () => {
      expect(calculatePlayedPot(createMockGame(), { plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 6 })).toBe(30); // 90 × 6/18
      expect(
        calculatePlayedPot(createMockGame({ pot_type: 'total_pot', pot_value: 90 }), {
          plannedHoles: 9,
          holesPlayed: 6,
        })
      ).toBe(60); // $10 a hole × 6
    });

    it('prices an ended-early pot on the rounded hole price actually paid out', () => {
      // $25 / 9 = $2.78 a hole (rounded) × 3 = $8.34 — not $25 × 3/9 = $8.33
      expect(
        calculatePlayedPot(createMockGame({ pot_type: 'total_pot', pot_value: 25 }), {
          plannedHoles: 9,

      expect(

    for (const payout of payouts) {

    expect(payouts.find((p) => p.player_id === 'p1')!.net_result).toBe(0); // 20 - 20
    expect(payouts.find((p) => p.player_id === 'p2')!.net_result).toBe(10); // 30 - 20
    expect(payouts.find((p) => p.player_id === 'p3')!.net_result).toBe(-10); // 10 - 20
    expect(netSum(payouts)).toBeCloseTo(0, 2);

  it('total_pot $25, front nine ended after 3, 4 players, all tied: nets to exactly zero', () => {
    const game = createMockGame({ pot_type: 'total_pot', pot_value: 25 }); // p1–p4
```

Replace with:

```ts
/**
 * The pot actually played for.
 * - Played as planned: the planned pot, calculateTotalPot(type, value,
 *   plannedHoles) — unchanged from today for a full 18.
 * - Ended early: the rounded hole price the per-hole processing paid out
 *   (calculateHoleValue over the planned holes) × holes played, so winnings
 *   sum to this pot exactly. Scaling the pot instead (pot × played/planned)
 *   drifts by a cent per hole on a total pot that doesn't divide evenly.
 */
export function calculatePlayedPot(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value'>,
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts
): number {
  const { plannedHoles, holesPlayed } = holeCounts;
  if (holesPlayed >= plannedHoles) {
    return calculateTotalPot(game.pot_type, game.pot_value, plannedHoles);
  }
  return roundCurrency(calculateHoleValue(game.pot_type, game.pot_value, plannedHoles) * holesPlayed);
}

/**
 * What a SETTLED game actually staked: the sum of its stored buy-ins. Null
 * when the game isn't completed or its payouts aren't written yet — callers
 * then fall back to calculatePlayedPot / a settlement preview. The single
 * "is this game settled?" rule for every skins display.
 */
export function calculateSettledPot(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'status'>,
  payouts: Pick<SkinsPayout, 'buy_in'>[] | null | undefined
): number | null {
  if (game.status !== 'completed' || !payouts || payouts.length === 0) return null;
  return roundCurrency(payouts.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.buy_in, 0));
}

/**
 * Each participant's buy-in: the played pot split evenly. For a round played
 * as planned this is exactly calculateBuyIn over the planned holes, so a
 * complete 18-hole game prices as before.
 */
function calculateSettlementBuyIn(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value'>,
  participantCount: number,
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts
): number {
  return roundCurrency(calculatePlayedPot(game, holeCounts) / participantCount);
}

export function calculateFinalPayoutsWithCarryover(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value' | 'participant_ids'>,
  results: Pick<SkinsResult, 'hole_number' | 'winner_id' | 'is_carryover' | 'payout_amount' | 'carryover_to_next' | 'hole_scores'>[],
  participants: PayoutParticipant[],
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
): FinalPayoutResult {
  // The remaining carryover is the HIGHEST hole's (calculateCurrentCarryover).
  // Results after the last played hole don't exist at settlement: the
  // end_round_early RPC deletes them when the round is ended.
  const buyIn = calculateSettlementBuyIn(game, participants.length, holeCounts);
  const payoutMap = accumulateHoleOutcomes(results, participants, buyIn);
```

```tsx
/**
 * Per-hole skins pricing: a hole is worth pot / planned holes (9 for a
 * front/back nine), not pot / 18.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { act, renderHook } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useProcessSkinsHole, useProcessTeamSkinsHole } from '@/hooks/skins/mutations';
import type { SkinsHoleScores, SkinsTeamHoleScores } from '@/types/database/skins.types';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
}));
jest.mock('@/services/api/players', () => ({ fetchPlayerListByIds: jest.fn() }));
jest.mock('@/hooks/useAuth', () => ({ useAuth: () => ({ user: null }) }));
jest.mock('@/hooks/achievements/useCheckAchievements', () => ({
  useCheckAchievements: () => ({ checkAndAward: jest.fn(), isReady: false }),
}));
jest.mock('@/context/AchievementToastContext', () => ({
  useAchievementToast: () => ({ showMultipleToasts: jest.fn() }),
}));

type QueryResult = { data: unknown; error: unknown };

/**
 * PostgREST stand-in: filters chain; `single` / `maybeSingle` resolve the
 * queued results in order; awaiting the chain itself resolves `awaited`.
 */
function makeTable(opts: { single?: QueryResult[]; maybeSingle?: QueryResult[]; awaited?: QueryResult } = {}) {
  const singles = [...(opts.single ?? [])];
  const maybes = [...(opts.maybeSingle ?? [])];
  const awaited = opts.awaited ?? { data: [], error: null };
  const table: Record<string, jest.Mock> = {};
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'order', 'insert', 'update', 'upsert']) {
    table[method] = jest.fn(() => table);
  }
  table.single = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(singles.shift() ?? { data: null, error: null }));
  table.maybeSingle = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(maybes.shift() ?? { data: null, error: null }));
  table.then = jest.fn(
    (onFulfilled: (value: QueryResult) => unknown, onRejected?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
      Promise.resolve(awaited).then(onFulfilled, onRejected)
  );
  return table;
}

function makeWrapper() {
  const client = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { mutations: { retry: false } } });
  return function Wrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={client}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

// total_pot $90, gross, two players
const GAME = {
  id: 'g1',
  round_id: 'r1',
  pot_type: 'total_pot',
  pot_value: 90,
  scoring_type: 'gross',
  participant_ids: ['p1', 'p2'],
  is_team_skins: false,
};

// p1 (3) beats p2 (4) outright → p1 wins, no carryover
const HOLE_SCORES: SkinsHoleScores = {
  p1: { gross: 3, net: 3, strokes_received: 0 },
  p2: { gross: 4, net: 4, strokes_received: 0 },
};

/** Individual path: game `single`, results awaited, round `maybeSingle`,
 *  existing-hole `single` (none), then insert().select().single(). */
function wireIndividual(nineType: string | null) {
  const tables = {
    skins_games: makeTable({ single: [{ data: GAME, error: null }] }),
    skins_results: makeTable({
      awaited: { data: [], error: null },
      single: [
        { data: null, error: null },
        { data: { id: 'res-3', skins_game_id: 'g1' }, error: null },
      ],
    }),
    rounds: makeTable({ maybeSingle: [{ data: { nine_type: nineType }, error: null }] }),
  };
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((name: string) => tables[name as keyof typeof tables]);
  return tables;
}

describe('per-hole skins pricing', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockFrom.mockReset();
  });

  it('prices a front-9 total pot at pot / 9 per hole', async () => {
    const tables = wireIndividual('front9');
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProcessSkinsHole(), { wrapper: makeWrapper() });

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.mutateAsync({ skinsGameId: 'g1', holeNumber: 3, holeScores: HOLE_SCORES });
    });

    expect(tables.rounds.eq).toHaveBeenCalledWith('id', 'r1');
    // $90 / 9 = $10, no carryover in → payout $10
    expect(tables.skins_results.insert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ hole_number: 3, winner_id: 'p1', hole_pot_value: 10, payout_amount: 10 })
    );
  });

  it('keeps pot / 18 for a full round', async () => {
    const tables = wireIndividual('full');
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProcessSkinsHole(), { wrapper: makeWrapper() });

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.mutateAsync({ skinsGameId: 'g1', holeNumber: 3, holeScores: HOLE_SCORES });
    });

    // $90 / 18 = $5
    expect(tables.skins_results.insert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ hole_pot_value: 5, payout_amount: 5 })
    );
  });

  it('prices team skins on the planned holes too', async () => {
    const teamGame = { ...GAME, is_team_skins: true };
    const tables = {
      skins_games: makeTable({ single: [{ data: teamGame, error: null }] }),
      skins_results: makeTable({
        awaited: { data: [], error: null },
        maybeSingle: [{ data: null, error: null }],
        single: [{ data: { id: 'res-12', skins_game_id: 'g1' }, error: null }],
      }),
      rounds: makeTable({ maybeSingle: [{ data: { nine_type: 'back9' }, error: null }] }),
    };
    mockFrom.mockImplementation((name: string) => tables[name as keyof typeof tables]);
    // scramble uses team_score: t1 3 beats t2 4
    const teamScores: SkinsTeamHoleScores = {
      t1: { team_score: 3, member_scores: {} },
      t2: { team_score: 4, member_scores: {} },
    };
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useProcessTeamSkinsHole(), { wrapper: makeWrapper() });

    await act(async () => {
      await result.current.mutateAsync({ skinsGameId: 'g1', holeNumber: 12, teamScores, teamFormat: 'scramble' });
    });

    expect(tables.skins_results.upsert).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
      expect.objectContaining({ hole_number: 12, team_winner_id: 't1', hole_pot_value: 10, payout_amount: 10 }),
      { onConflict: 'skins_game_id,hole_number' }
    );
  });
});
```

Create `src/services/skins/roundHoleCounts.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The hole counts a round's skins games are priced and settled over, read
 * from the round row. Used by per-hole processing (hole value = pot /
 * planned holes), by settlement (finalizeSkinsGame, finalizeSkinsForSubMatch)
 * and by useSkinsHoleCounts.
 *
 * Part A reads nine_type only; B1b adds holes_played to the select once the
 * column exists.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/services/supabase/client';
import { createError } from '@/services/errors';
import { getSkinsHoleCounts, type SkinsHoleCounts } from '@/utils/skins/holeCounts';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

/**
 * @returns Planned / played hole counts. A round row hidden by RLS (no data,
 *   no error) keeps the 18-hole default; a query error throws so money is
 *   never settled on a guessed hole count.
 */
export async function fetchSkinsHoleCounts(roundId: string): Promise<SkinsHoleCounts> {
  const { data, error } = (await supabase
    .from('rounds')
    .select('nine_type')
    .eq('id', roundId)
    .maybeSingle()) as unknown as {
    data: { nine_type?: NineType | null } | null;
    error: { message: string } | null;
  };

  if (error) {
    throw createError(`Failed to load round for skins pricing: ${error.message}`, 'DATABASE');
  }

  return getSkinsHoleCounts(data);
}
```

### Task A5b-1: Extract skins settlement into a non-hook service

The settlement moves out of `useFinalizeSkinsGame`'s `mutationFn` into `finalizeSkinsGame` (non-hook), so A6a's queued "finalise round" item can settle without React.

`finalizeSkinsForSubMatch` gets `fetchSkinsHoleCounts` too, so every settlement path reads the round's counts: `useFinalizeSkinsGame` (and through it the `useSkinsGameState` auto-finalise and `useFinalizeSkinsForRound`), `finalizeActiveSkinsForRound` and `finalizeSkinsForSubMatch`. `useFinalizeSkinsForRound` is **not** edited: A6d deletes it.

Both settlement paths size the buy-in on `game.participant_ids.map((id) => ({ id }))`. `calculateFinalPayoutsWithCarryover` only reads `participant.id` (`PayoutParticipant` is `{ id: string }`), and `fetchPlayerListByIds` logs and swallows read errors, so a failed `players` read used to settle on an empty list: a wrong divisor and no payout rows. The settlement no longer reads `players` at all.

`finalizeSkinsGame` takes **no** hole-count override: there is no production caller for one, and every path must read `fetchSkinsHoleCounts`.

- Produces, in `src/services/skins/finalizeSkinsGame.ts`:
  - `finalizeSkinsGame(gameId: string): Promise<SkinsGame>`. **No `holeCounts` parameter** (the first draft's `holeCounts?` is dropped; the Interface Contract matches): counts always come from `fetchSkinsHoleCounts(game.round_id)`. Participants come from `game.participant_ids`. It throws on any failure.
  - `finalizeActiveSkinsForRound(roundId: string): Promise<FinalizeActiveSkinsResult>`, where `FinalizeActiveSkinsResult = { finalized: boolean; game?: SkinsGame; error?: unknown }`. It never throws. **`error` is set whenever settlement failed** (the caught value itself, not a message); A6a's `finalizeSubmittedRound` reads it to make the queued `'finalize'` item retry. A retry is safe: only `active` games are looked up, so a settled game is never settled twice.

```ts
 * awardSkinsAchievements) — the non-hook skins settlement used by useFinalizeSkinsGame and the queued

import {
  finalizeActiveSkinsForRound,
  finalizeSkinsGame,
} from '@/services/skins/finalizeSkinsGame';
import type { SkinsGame } from '@/types/database/skins.types';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
}));

// The settlement must NOT size the buy-in on a players read: this helper logs
// and swallows errors, so a failed read returned [] (wrong divisor, no rows).
const mockFetchPlayerList = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/api/players', () => ({
  fetchPlayerListByIds: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFetchPlayerList(...args),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/errors', () => ({
  createError: (message: string) => new Error(message),
}));

type QueryResult = { data: unknown; error: unknown };

/**
 * PostgREST stand-in: filters chain; `single` / `maybeSingle` resolve the
 * queued results in order; awaiting the chain itself resolves `awaited`.
 */
function makeTable(opts: { single?: QueryResult[]; maybeSingle?: QueryResult[]; awaited?: QueryResult } = {}) {
  const singles = [...(opts.single ?? [])];
  const maybes = [...(opts.maybeSingle ?? [])];
  const awaited = opts.awaited ?? { data: [], error: null };
  const table: Record<string, jest.Mock> = {};
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'order', 'limit', 'insert', 'update', 'delete', 'not']) {
    table[method] = jest.fn(() => table);
  }
  table.single = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(singles.shift() ?? { data: null, error: null }));
  table.maybeSingle = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve(maybes.shift() ?? { data: null, error: null }));
  table.then = jest.fn(
    (onFulfilled: (value: QueryResult) => unknown, onRejected?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
      Promise.resolve(awaited).then(onFulfilled, onRejected)
  );
  return table;
}

// per_hole $5, two players
const GAME: SkinsGame = {
  id: 'g1',
  round_id: 'r1',
  pairing_id: null,
  sub_match_id: null,
  participant_ids: ['p1', 'p2'],
  pot_type: 'per_hole',
  pot_value: 5,
  currency: 'AUD',
  scoring_type: 'gross',
  status: 'active',
  disclaimer_accepted_at: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z',
  disclaimer_accepted_by: 'p1',
  created_by: 'p1',
  created_at: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z',
  updated_at: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z',
  completed_at: null,
  is_team_skins: false,
  participant_team_ids: null,
};

/** One $5 skin per hole, won by the listed player, holes numbered from 1. */
function wonHoles(winners: string[]) {
  return winners.map((winner, i) => ({
    hole_number: i + 1,
    winner_id: winner,
    is_carryover: false,
    payout_amount: 5,
    carryover_to_next: 0,
    hole_scores: {
      p1: { gross: 4, net: 4, strokes_received: 0 },
      p2: { gross: 4, net: 4, strokes_received: 0 },
    },
  }));
}

function wire({
  results = [] as unknown[],
  resultsError = null as unknown,
  nineType = 'full' as string | null,
  activeGame = GAME as SkinsGame | null,
  game = GAME as SkinsGame | null,
} = {}) {
  const tables = {
    skins_games: makeTable({
      single: [
        { data: game, error: game ? null : { message: 'missing' } },
        { data: game ? { ...game, status: 'completed' } : null, error: null },
      ],
      maybeSingle: [{ data: activeGame, error: null }],
    }),
    skins_results: makeTable({ awaited: { data: results, error: resultsError } }),
    skins_payouts: makeTable({ awaited: { data: null, error: null } }),
    rounds: makeTable({ maybeSingle: [{ data: { nine_type: nineType }, error: null }] }),
  };
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((name: string) => tables[name as keyof typeof tables]);
  return tables;
}

type InsertedPayout = { player_id: string; buy_in: number; net_result: number };

describe('finalizeSkinsGame', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockFrom.mockReset();
    mockFetchPlayerList.mockReset();
    // What the swallowed-error players read returns; settlement must not use it.
    mockFetchPlayerList.mockResolvedValue([]);
  });

  it('keeps the full-18 buy-in for a full round (pinned: unchanged from today)', async () => {
    // Ann wins 2 holes ($10), Bob 1 ($5); buy-in $5 × 18 / 2 = $45
    const tables = wire({ nineType: 'full', results: wonHoles(['p1', 'p1', 'p2']) });

    await finalizeSkinsGame('g1');

    const rows = tables.skins_payouts.insert.mock.calls[0][0] as InsertedPayout[];
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.buy_in)).toEqual([45, 45]);
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.net_result)).toEqual([-35, -40]); // 10 - 45, 5 - 45
  });

  it('settles a 9-hole round zero-sum, priced on the round nine type', async () => {
    // Ann wins holes 1–5 ($25), Bob 6–9 ($20); buy-in $5 × 9 / 2 = $22.50
    const tables = wire({
      nineType: 'front9',
      results: wonHoles(['p1', 'p1', 'p1', 'p1', 'p1', 'p2', 'p2', 'p2', 'p2']),
    });

    await finalizeSkinsGame('g1');

    expect(tables.rounds.eq).toHaveBeenCalledWith('id', 'r1');
    const rows = tables.skins_payouts.insert.mock.calls[0][0] as InsertedPayout[];
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.buy_in)).toEqual([22.5, 22.5]);
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.net_result)).toEqual([2.5, -2.5]);
    expect(rows.reduce((sum, r) => sum + r.net_result, 0)).toBeCloseTo(0, 2);
  });

  it("sizes the buy-in on the game's participant ids, never on a players read", async () => {
    // Ann wins 1 ($5); buy-in $5 × 18 / 2 = $45 — two rows even though the
    // players read would have come back empty
    const tables = wire({ results: wonHoles(['p1']) });

    await finalizeSkinsGame('g1');

    expect(mockFetchPlayerList).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    const rows = tables.skins_payouts.insert.mock.calls[0][0] as InsertedPayout[];
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.player_id)).toEqual(['p1', 'p2']);
    expect(rows.map((r) => r.buy_in)).toEqual([45, 45]);
  });

  it('replaces old payouts, marks the game completed and returns it', async () => {
    const tables = wire({ results: wonHoles(['p1']) });

    expect(tables.skins_payouts.delete).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(tables.skins_games.update).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

    expect(settled.status).toBe('completed');
  });

  it('throws when the game does not exist', async () => {
    wire({ game: null });

    await expect(finalizeSkinsGame('g1')).rejects.toThrow('Skins game not found');

});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the service**

Create `src/services/skins/finalizeSkinsGame.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Skins game settlement — the non-hook core of useFinalizeSkinsGame.
 *
 * Computes each participant's payout, rewrites skins_payouts and marks the
 * game completed. The buy-in is priced over the round's hole counts
 * (fetchSkinsHoleCounts): a 9-hole round's pot covers 9 holes, and a round
 * ended early settles over the holes played, so individual payouts stay
 * zero-sum within cent rounding (I11).
 *
 * Lives outside React so finalizeSubmittedRound — and the queued "finalise
 * round" sync item it backs — can settle a game without a hook.
 */

import { supabase } from '@/services/supabase/client';
import { createError } from '@/services/errors';
import { calculateFinalPayoutsWithCarryover } from '@/utils/skins';
import { fetchActiveSkinsGame } from './activeGame';
import { fetchSkinsHoleCounts } from './roundHoleCounts';
import type { SkinsGame, SkinsResult } from '@/types/database/skins.types';

/**
 * Settle one skins game. Hole counts are always read from the game's round
 * (fetchSkinsHoleCounts); there is deliberately no override.
 *
 * @param gameId - Skins game to settle
 * @returns The game, now `completed`. Throws on any failure.
 */
export async function finalizeSkinsGame(gameId: string): Promise<SkinsGame> {
  const { data: rawGame, error: gameError } = await supabase
    .from('skins_games')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', gameId)
    .single();

  const game = rawGame as unknown as SkinsGame | null;

  if (gameError || !game) {
    throw createError('Skins game not found', 'NOT_FOUND');
  }

  const { data: rawResults, error: resultsError } = await supabase
    .from('skins_results')
    .select('*')
    .eq('skins_game_id', gameId)
    .order('hole_number', { ascending: true });

  if (resultsError) {
    throw createError(`Failed to fetch results: ${resultsError.message}`, 'DATABASE');
  }

  const results = (rawResults ?? []) as unknown as SkinsResult[];

  // The buy-in divisor is the game's own participant list. The calculator
  // only needs ids, and a players read (fetchPlayerListByIds) swallows errors,
  // so a failed read would have settled on an empty list.
  const participants = game.participant_ids.map((id) => ({ id }));
  const holeCounts = await fetchSkinsHoleCounts(game.round_id);

  const payoutResult = calculateFinalPayoutsWithCarryover(game, results, participants, holeCounts);

  await supabase.from('skins_payouts').delete().eq('skins_game_id', gameId);

  const payoutInserts = payoutResult.payouts.map((p) => ({
    skins_game_id: gameId,
    player_id: p.player_id,
    buy_in: p.buy_in,
    total_winnings: p.total_winnings,
    net_result: p.net_result,
    holes_won: p.holes_won,
    holes_tied: p.holes_tied,
    holes_lost: p.holes_lost,
  }));

  if (payoutInserts.length > 0) {
    const { error: insertError } = await supabase
      .from('skins_payouts')
      .insert(payoutInserts as never);

    if (insertError) {
      throw createError(`Failed to insert payouts: ${insertError.message}`, 'DATABASE');
    }
  }

  const { data: updatedGame, error: updateError } = await supabase
    .from('skins_games')
    .update({
      status: 'completed',
      completed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    } as never)
    .eq('id', gameId)
    .select()
    .single();

  if (updateError) {
    throw createError(`Failed to update game status: ${updateError.message}`, 'DATABASE');
  }

  return updatedGame as unknown as SkinsGame;
}

export interface FinalizeActiveSkinsResult {
  finalized: boolean;
  /** The settled game (status `completed`) when one was finalised. */
  game?: SkinsGame;
  /**
   * The caught failure (the raw value), set whenever settlement failed. A
   * caller that can retry (the queued 'finalize' round item) should treat it
   * as retryable: only `active` games are looked up, so a retry never settles
   * a game twice.
   */
  error?: unknown;
}

/**
 * Settle the round's active skins game, if it has one. Never throws: a
 * failure comes back as `{ finalized: false, error }`.
 */
export async function finalizeActiveSkinsForRound(roundId: string): Promise<FinalizeActiveSkinsResult> {
  try {
    const activeGame = await fetchActiveSkinsGame({ roundId });
    if (!activeGame) {
      return { finalized: false };
    }

    const game = await finalizeSkinsGame(activeGame.id);
    return { finalized: true, game };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('[finalizeActiveSkinsForRound] Error finalizing skins:', error);
    return { finalized: false, error };
  }
}
```

```ts
/** What awardSkinsAchievements needs from the React side (useAuth / useCheckAchievements / toasts). */
export interface SkinsAchievementContext {
  playerId: string;
  checkAndAward: (
    eventType: AchievementEventType,
    eventData: AchievementEventData
  ) => Promise<{
    hasNewRewards: boolean;
    newAchievements: AchievementDefinition[];
    newCosmetics: CosmeticDefinition[];
  }>;
  showMultipleToasts: (
    achievements: AchievementDefinition[],
    cosmetics?: (CosmeticDefinition | null)[]
  ) => void;
}

/**
 * Skins achievement events for one player after a game settles. Shared by
 * useFinalizeSkinsGame.onSuccess and the round-submit hook (A6c), which
 * settles through finalizeActiveSkinsForRound and so never runs onSuccess.
 * Non-blocking: failures are logged, never thrown.
 */
export async function awardSkinsAchievements(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'id' | 'pot_value'>,
  { playerId, checkAndAward, showMultipleToasts }: SkinsAchievementContext
): Promise<void> {
  try {
    // Query the player's payout to get holes won data
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- Supabase generated types restriction workaround
    const { data: payout } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('skins_payouts')
      .select('holes_won, holes_tied')
      .eq('skins_game_id', game.id)
      .eq('player_id', playerId)
      .single();

    const holesWon = (payout?.holes_won as number) ?? 0;

    // Count carryover wins: holes the player won where previous hole(s) had carryovers
    // A hole with payout_amount > pot_value indicates accumulated carryovers
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- Supabase generated types restriction workaround
    const { data: carryoverWins } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('skins_results')
      .select('id, payout_amount')
      .eq('skins_game_id', game.id)
      .eq('winner_id', playerId)
      .eq('is_carryover', false)
      .not('payout_amount', 'is', null);

    // Filter to holes where payout exceeded the base hole value (indicating carryovers)
    const baseHoleValue = game.pot_value ?? 0;
    const carryoverHolesWon = (carryoverWins as Array<{ payout_amount: number }> | null)
      ?.filter((r) => r.payout_amount > baseHoleValue).length ?? 0;

    // skins_game_completed
    const r1 = await checkAndAward('skins_game_completed', {
      skins_holes_won: holesWon,
    });
    if (r1.hasNewRewards) showMultipleToasts(r1.newAchievements, r1.newCosmetics);

    // skins_hole_won (with counts)
    if (holesWon > 0) {
      const r2 = await checkAndAward('skins_hole_won', {
        skins_holes_won: holesWon,
        skins_carryover_holes_won: carryoverHolesWon,
      });
      if (r2.hasNewRewards) showMultipleToasts(r2.newAchievements, r2.newCosmetics);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.warn('[awardSkinsAchievements] Achievement check failed (non-blocking):', error);
  }
}
```

### Task A5c-1: Skins hole-count hook, summary, indicator and settings card

Shared skins displays get the round's hole counts:
- **Completed** games show what was stored (the `skins_payouts` buy-ins for the pot).
- **In-progress** games price holes on the planned count and the pot on the holes played.
- Components that know their round read the counts themselves through a new `useSkinsHoleCounts(roundId)`, so screens don't thread them.

|---|---|
| `src/hooks/skins/queries.ts` | New `useSkinsHoleCounts`, pure `buildSkinsSummary`, and `useSkinsSummary(gameId, holeCounts?)`. `total_pot` = Σ stored buy-ins when settled, else the played pot; `per_hole_value` = planned price |
| `SkinsIndicator` + `SkinsSummaryModal` | Summary and the "x/N holes" progress on the round's counts (was `/18`) |
| `useSkinsGameState` (ViewRound settings card) | Per-hole on planned holes; pot = stored buy-ins when settled, else the played pot. The auto-finalise is unchanged (it settles through `fetchSkinsHoleCounts`) |

```ts
  carryover_to_next: carry,
  payout_amount: payout,
  calculated_at: '2026-10-07T01:00:00Z',
  winner: winnerId ? { id: winnerId, name: winnerId } : null,
});

const payout = (playerId: string, buyIn: number, net: number): SkinsPayoutWithPlayer => ({
  id: `pay-${playerId}`,
  skins_game_id: 'g1',
  player_id: playerId,
  team_id: null,
  is_team_payout: false,
  buy_in: buyIn,
  total_winnings: buyIn + net,
  net_result: net,
  holes_won: 0,
  holes_tied: 0,
  holes_lost: 0,
  calculated_at: '2026-10-07T03:00:00Z',
  player: { id: playerId, name: playerId },
});

describe('buildSkinsSummary', () => {
  it('keeps the 18-hole pricing when no hole counts are given', () => {
    const summary = buildSkinsSummary(game(), [result(1, 'p1', 5, 0), result(2, null, 0, 5)], []);

    expect(summary.per_hole_value).toBe(5);
    expect(summary.total_pot).toBe(90); // $5 × 18
    expect(summary.current_carryover).toBe(5); // hole 2 tied
    expect(summary.holes_completed).toBe(2);
  });

  it('prices a front nine on 9 holes', () => {
    const summary = buildSkinsSummary(game(), [], [], { plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 9 });

    expect(summary.per_hole_value).toBe(5);
    expect(summary.total_pot).toBe(45); // $5 × 9
  });

  it('prices holes on the plan and the pot on the holes played after an early end', () => {
    const summary = buildSkinsSummary(
      game({ pot_type: 'total_pot', pot_value: 90 }),
      [],
      [],
      { plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 6 }
    );

    expect(summary.per_hole_value).toBe(10); // $90 / 9
    expect(summary.total_pot).toBe(60); // $90 × 6/9
  });

  it('shows the stored buy-ins once the game is settled', () => {
    const summary = buildSkinsSummary(
      game({ status: 'completed' }),
      [],
      [payout('p1', 22.5, 2.5), payout('p2', 22.5, -2.5)]
    );

    expect(summary.total_pot).toBe(45); // 22.5 + 22.5, not the 18-hole $90
  });

  it('falls back to the played pot for a completed game with no payouts yet', () => {
    const summary = buildSkinsSummary(game({ status: 'completed' }), [], [], {
      plannedHoles: 18,
      holesPlayed: 6,
    });

    expect(summary.total_pot).toBe(30); // $90 × 6/18
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * useSkinsGameState — the round-settings skins card. Holes are priced on the
 * planned count, the pot on the holes played; a settled game shows its stored
 * buy-ins. The auto-finalise passes only the game id, so settlement reads the
 * round's hole counts (fetchSkinsHoleCounts) itself.
 */
import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { useSkinsGameState } from '@/components/rounds/ViewRound/RoundDetailsTab/components/useSkinsGameState';

const mockState = {
  games: [] as Record<string, unknown>[],
  payouts: [] as { buy_in: number; total_winnings: number }[],
  results: [] as unknown[],
};
const mockFinalize = jest.fn();
const mockRefetchPayouts = jest.fn();
const mockUseSkinsHoleCounts = jest.fn();

jest.mock('@/hooks/useSkins', () => ({
  useSkinsGamesByRound: () => ({ data: mockState.games, isLoading: false }),
  useSkinsPayouts: () => ({ data: mockState.payouts, isLoading: false, refetch: mockRefetchPayouts }),
  useSkinsResults: () => ({ data: mockState.results, isLoading: false }),
  useFinalizeSkinsGame: () => ({ mutateAsync: mockFinalize, isPending: false }),
  useSkinsHoleCounts: (...args: unknown[]) => mockUseSkinsHoleCounts(...args),
}));

const baseGame = {
  id: 'g1',
  round_id: 'r1',
  status: 'active',
  pot_type: 'total_pot',
  pot_value: 90,
  scoring_type: 'gross',
  participant_ids: ['p1', 'p2'],
};

describe('useSkinsGameState', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockState.games = [baseGame];
    mockState.payouts = [];
    mockState.results = [];
    mockFinalize.mockResolvedValue({});
    mockUseSkinsHoleCounts.mockReturnValue({ plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 18 });
  });

  it('prices a full round played as planned exactly as before', () => {
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSkinsGameState({ roundId: 'r1', roundStatus: 'in-progress' }));

    expect(result.current.perHoleValue).toBe(5); // $90 / 18
    expect(result.current.totalPot).toBe(90);
  });

  it("reads the round's hole counts and prices an ended-early front nine", () => {
    mockUseSkinsHoleCounts.mockReturnValue({ plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 6 });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSkinsGameState({ roundId: 'r1', roundStatus: 'in-progress' }));

    expect(mockUseSkinsHoleCounts).toHaveBeenCalledWith('r1');
    expect(result.current.perHoleValue).toBe(10); // $90 / 9
    expect(result.current.totalPot).toBe(60); // $90 × 6/9
  });

  it('shows the stored buy-ins as the pot once the game is settled', () => {
    mockState.games = [{ ...baseGame, status: 'completed', pot_type: 'per_hole', pot_value: 5 }];
    mockState.payouts = [
      { buy_in: 22.5, total_winnings: 25 },
      { buy_in: 22.5, total_winnings: 20 },
    ];
    mockUseSkinsHoleCounts.mockReturnValue({ plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 9 });

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useSkinsGameState({ roundId: 'r1', roundStatus: 'completed' }));

    expect(result.current.perHoleValue).toBe(5);
    expect(result.current.totalPot).toBe(45); // 22.5 + 22.5 (computed at 18 it would read $90)
  });

  it('auto-finalises with the game id only (settlement reads the hole counts)', () => {
    mockState.results = [{ hole_number: 1 }];

    renderHook(() => useSkinsGameState({ roundId: 'r1', roundStatus: 'completed' }));

    expect(mockFinalize).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockFinalize).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ gameId: 'g1' });
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Query hook to fetch complete skins game summary
 *
 * Combines game, results, and payouts with calculated metrics.
 *
 * @param gameId - Skins game UUID
 * @returns Query result with SkinsGameSummary
 */
export function useSkinsSummary(gameId: string | undefined) {
  const gameQuery = useSkinsGame(gameId);
  const resultsQuery = useSkinsResults(gameId);
  const payoutsQuery = useSkinsPayouts(gameId);

  // Extract data from dependent queries
  const game = gameQuery.data;

  // Compute summary directly using useMemo - this reacts to changes in dependent data
  const summary = useMemo((): SkinsGameSummary | null => {
    if (!game) return null;

    const results = resultsQuery.data ?? [];
    const payouts = payoutsQuery.data ?? [];

    const totalPot = calculateTotalPot(game.pot_type, game.pot_value);
    const perHoleValue = calculateHoleValue(game.pot_type, game.pot_value);
    const currentCarryover = calculateCurrentCarryover(results as SkinsResult[]);
    const holesCompleted = results.length;

    return {
      game: game as SkinsGameWithParticipants,
      results: results as SkinsResultWithWinner[],
      payouts: payouts as SkinsPayoutWithPlayer[],
      current_carryover: currentCarryover,
      holes_completed: holesCompleted,
      total_pot: totalPot,
      per_hole_value: perHoleValue,
    };
  }, [game, resultsQuery.data, payoutsQuery.data]);
```

Replace with:

```ts
/**
 * Hole counts a round's skins are priced (planned) and settled (played) on,
 * read through fetchSkinsHoleCounts. The 18-hole default while loading or
 * without a round.
 */
export function useSkinsHoleCounts(roundId: string | undefined): SkinsHoleCounts {
  const { data } = useQuery({
    queryKey: skinsKeys.holeCounts(roundId ?? ''),
    queryFn: () => fetchSkinsHoleCounts(roundId as string),
    enabled: !!roundId,
    staleTime: CACHE_TIMES.SHORT,
    gcTime: GC_TIMES.SHORT,
  });
  return data ?? DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS;
}

/**
 * Build a skins game summary. Each hole is priced on the planned holes; the
 * pot is what was actually staked once the game is settled (sum of the
 * stored buy-ins), otherwise the pot for the holes played.
 */
export function buildSkinsSummary(
  game: SkinsGameWithParticipants | SkinsGameWithTeamParticipants,
  results: SkinsResultWithWinner[] | SkinsResultWithTeamWinner[],
  payouts: SkinsPayoutWithPlayer[],
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
): SkinsGameSummary {
  return {
    game: game as SkinsGameWithParticipants,
    results: results as SkinsResultWithWinner[],
    payouts,
    current_carryover: calculateCurrentCarryover(results as SkinsResult[]),
    holes_completed: results.length,
    total_pot: calculateSettledPot(game, payouts) ?? calculatePlayedPot(game, holeCounts),
    per_hole_value: calculateHoleValue(game.pot_type, game.pot_value, holeCounts.plannedHoles),
  };
}

/**
 * Query hook to fetch complete skins game summary
 *
 * Combines game, results, and payouts with calculated metrics.
 *
 * @param gameId - Skins game UUID
 * @param holeCounts - Holes planned (prices each hole) and played (sizes the
 *   pot); defaults to a full 18 played as planned
 * @returns Query result with SkinsGameSummary
 */
export function useSkinsSummary(
  gameId: string | undefined,
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
) {
  const gameQuery = useSkinsGame(gameId);
  const resultsQuery = useSkinsResults(gameId);
  const payoutsQuery = useSkinsPayouts(gameId);

  // Extract data from dependent queries
  const game = gameQuery.data;
  const { plannedHoles, holesPlayed } = holeCounts;

  // Compute summary directly using useMemo - this reacts to changes in dependent data
  const summary = useMemo((): SkinsGameSummary | null => {
    if (!game) return null;
    return buildSkinsSummary(game, resultsQuery.data ?? [], payoutsQuery.data ?? [], {
      plannedHoles,
      holesPlayed,
    });
  }, [game, resultsQuery.data, payoutsQuery.data, plannedHoles, holesPlayed]);
```

### Task A5c-2: Skins results card on the round's hole counts

The hole-by-hole results card prices holes on the planned count and labels the holes played. A tied last hole on a 9-hole round or an ended-early round is now reported as an unsettled carryover; today only hole 18 is. ViewRound's skins tab and the match-play scorecard pass the round's counts.

| Site | Change |
|---|---|
| `SkinsResultsCard` / `useSkinsResultRows` | Optional `holeCounts`: per-hole price on planned holes, "N holes" = holes played. The unsettled carryover is keyed on the last result once every played hole has one (was hole 18 only) |
| ViewRound `SkinsTab`, `MatchPlayScorecardScreen` | Pass `useSkinsHoleCounts(roundId)` to `SkinsResultsCard` |

Replace with:

```ts
import { useMemo } from 'react';
import { calculateHoleValue, DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS, type SkinsHoleCounts } from '@/utils/skins';
import type {
  SkinsResultWithWinner,
  SkinsResult,
  SkinsPotType,
  SkinsParticipant,
  SkinsTeamParticipant,
} from '@/types/database';
import type { ParticipantTotal, ResultRow } from '../types';

interface UseSkinsResultRowsParams {
  results: SkinsResultWithWinner[];
  potType: SkinsPotType;
  potValue: number;
  /** Holes planned (prices each hole) and played (finds the game's last hole) */
  holeCounts?: SkinsHoleCounts;
  participants?: SkinsParticipant[];
  isTeamSkins: boolean;
  teams?: SkinsTeamParticipant[];
}

export function useSkinsResultRows({
  results,
  potType,
  potValue,
  holeCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS,
  participants,
  isTeamSkins,
  teams,
}: UseSkinsResultRowsParams) {
  const { plannedHoles, holesPlayed } = holeCounts;

  // Each hole is worth the pot spread over the planned holes
  const perHoleValue = useMemo(
    () => calculateHoleValue(potType, potValue, plannedHoles),
    [potType, potValue, plannedHoles]
  );
```

(`_totalPot` was unused and is removed.)

Replace with:

```ts
  // Calculate front 9 and back 9 totals
  const { front9Total, back9Total, unsettledCarryover } = useMemo(() => {
    let front = 0;
    let back = 0;
    let carryover = 0;

    // Sum up payouts by hole range
    results.forEach((r) => {
      if (r.hole_number <= 9) {
        front += r.payout_amount;
      } else {
        back += r.payout_amount;
      }
    });

    // Unsettled carryover: the game's last hole was tied. That is hole 18, or
    // — for a 9-hole round or one ended early — the highest result once every
    // played hole has one.
    const lastResult = results.reduce<SkinsResultWithWinner | null>(
      (last, r) => (!last || r.hole_number > last.hole_number ? r : last),
      null
    );
    if (
      lastResult &&
      lastResult.is_carryover &&
      (lastResult.hole_number === 18 || results.length >= holesPlayed)
    ) {
      carryover = lastResult.carryover_to_next;
    }

    return { front9Total: front, back9Total: back, unsettledCarryover: carryover };
  }, [results, holesPlayed]);
```

```tsx
import {

  results,
  potType,
  potValue,
  scoringType,
  parValues,
  participants,
  isTeamSkins: isTeamSkinsProp = false,
  teams,
  testID,
}: SkinsResultsCardProps) {
  const colors = useThemeColors();

  // Auto-detect team skins from results if prop is not set but results have team_winner_id
  const isTeamSkins = useMemo(() => {
    if (isTeamSkinsProp) return true;
    // Check if any result has team_winner_id - indicates team skins

  );

    results,
    potType,
    potValue,
    participants,
    isTeamSkins,
    teams,
  });
```

### Task A5d-1: Live skins standings on the round's hole counts

`calculateInProgressPayouts` and `SkinsCurrentStandingsCard` take `holeCounts`, so the live standings price the buy-in exactly as the settlement will. Review's `SkinsTabContent` replaces its `totalHoles` prop with `holeCounts`, and its "still in progress" gate and copy use the holes played. An ended-early round with a result on every played hole therefore stops showing live standings.

- Modify: `src/__tests__/utils/skinsCalculations.test.ts:824` (updated call) and append a describe

```tsx
/**
 * Review SkinsTabContent — the live standings, "still in progress" gate and
 * results card use the round's hole counts (holes played after an early end).
 */
import React from 'react';
import { render } from '@/__tests__/utils/renderHelpers';
import { SkinsTabContent } from './SkinsTabContent';

const mockUseSkinsSummary = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/hooks/useSkins', () => ({
  useSkinsSummary: (...args: unknown[]) => mockUseSkinsSummary(...args),
}));
jest.mock('@/hooks/skins', () => ({
  backfillSkinsResults: jest.fn(),
  useProcessSkinsHole: () => ({}),
  useProcessTeamSkinsHole: () => ({}),
}));
jest.mock('@/components/skins', () => ({
  SkinsResultsCard: jest.fn(() => null),
  SkinsSettlementCard: jest.fn(() => null),
  SkinsCurrentStandingsCard: jest.fn(() => null),
}));

const skinsComponents = jest.requireMock('@/components/skins') as Record<string, jest.Mock>;

const ENDED_AFTER_6 = { plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 6 };

function summaryWith(holesCompleted: number) {
  return {
    game: {
      id: 'g1',
      round_id: 'r1',
      status: 'active',
      pot_type: 'per_hole',
      pot_value: 5,
      scoring_type: 'gross',
      is_team_skins: false,
      participant_ids: ['p1', 'p2'],
      participants: [],
    },
    results: Array.from({ length: holesCompleted }, (_, i) => ({ hole_number: i + 1 })),
    payouts: [],
    current_carryover: 0,
    holes_completed: holesCompleted,
    total_pot: 30,
    per_hole_value: 5,
  };
}

function renderTab() {
  return render(
    <SkinsTabContent
      skinsGameId="g1"
      holeCounts={ENDED_AFTER_6}
      isRefreshing={false}
      onRefresh={jest.fn()}
      bottomInset={0}
    />
  );
}

describe('Review SkinsTabContent hole counts', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
  });

  it('prices the summary and live standings over the holes played', () => {
    mockUseSkinsSummary.mockReturnValue({ data: summaryWith(4), isLoading: false, refetch: jest.fn() });

    renderTab();

    expect(mockUseSkinsSummary).toHaveBeenCalledWith('g1', ENDED_AFTER_6);
    // React calls function components with (props, …); assert on the props only
    expect(skinsComponents.SkinsResultsCard.mock.calls[0][0]).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ holeCounts: ENDED_AFTER_6 })
    );
    expect(skinsComponents.SkinsCurrentStandingsCard.mock.calls[0][0]).toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ holeCounts: ENDED_AFTER_6, holesCompleted: 4 })
    );
  });

  it('stops showing live standings once every played hole has a result', () => {
    mockUseSkinsSummary.mockReturnValue({ data: summaryWith(6), isLoading: false, refetch: jest.fn() });

    renderTab();

    expect(skinsComponents.SkinsCurrentStandingsCard).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Calculate the current standing of an ACTIVE skins game.
 *
 * Same accumulation as the final settlement, except the pending carryover
 * is not split — mid-game it is still winnable on the holes ahead, so it
 * is reported separately instead of being banked to anyone.
 *
 * @param game - The skins game configuration
 * @param results - Hole results so far (partial round)
 * @param participants - List of participants
 * @param holeCounts - Holes planned and played; prices the buy-in exactly as
 *   the settlement will. Defaults to a full 18 played as planned.
 * @returns Standing per participant plus the undistributed carryover
 */
export function calculateInProgressPayouts(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'pot_type' | 'pot_value' | 'participant_ids'>,
  results: Pick<SkinsResult, 'hole_number' | 'winner_id' | 'is_carryover' | 'payout_amount' | 'carryover_to_next' | 'hole_scores'>[],
  participants: PayoutParticipant[],
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
): InProgressPayoutResult {
  const buyIn = calculateSettlementBuyIn(game, participants.length, holeCounts);
  const payoutMap = accumulateHoleOutcomes(results, participants, buyIn);
```

### Task A5d-2: Skins payouts tabs from stored settlements

ViewRound `PayoutsTab` and Review `PayoutsTabContent` today re-derive every game's payouts at 18 holes. Now:
- a **completed** game shows its stored `skins_payouts` (`calculateSettledPot` decides "settled");
- an unsettled game with played holes still to come shows the **live standings** (`calculateInProgressPayouts` on the round's hole counts). The pending carryover is not split, exactly as Review's Skins tab (`SkinsCurrentStandingsCard`) shows it, so the two tabs agree mid-round;
- an unsettled game with a result on every played hole previews the settlement (`calculateFinalPayouts` on the round's hole counts, which splits a carryover left on the last hole).

This fixes the drift on an already-settled 9-hole game ($5 per hole, 2 players, Ann wins 5 of 9). Every tab now shows the stored values.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/utils/skins/payouts.ts` (new `resolveSkinsNetResults` after `calculateInProgressPayouts`)
- Modify: `src/utils/skins/index.ts` payouts export blocks (as A5a-1 leaves them)
- Modify: `src/__tests__/utils/skinsCalculations.test.ts` (import; append a describe)
- Modify: `src/screens/scoring/ReviewScorecardScreen/components/PayoutsTabContent.tsx:16`, `:28-42`, `:70-97`, `:113-122`
- Modify: `src/screens/scoring/ReviewScorecardScreen/index.tsx:572-578`
- Modify: `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/tabs/PayoutsTab.tsx:18`, `:183-197`
- Test (create): `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/tabs/PayoutsTab.skins.test.tsx`
- Test (create): `src/screens/scoring/ReviewScorecardScreen/components/PayoutsTabContent.skins.test.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `calculateFinalPayouts(..., holeCounts)` and `calculateSettledPot` (A5a-1); `calculateInProgressPayouts(..., holeCounts)` (A5d-1); `useSkinsHoleCounts`, `useSkinsSummary(gameId, holeCounts)` (A5c-1); Review's `skinsHoleCounts` memo (A5d-1); `useSkinsPayouts` (existing)
- Produces: `SkinsNetResult`, `resolveSkinsNetResults(game, results, storedPayouts, holeCounts?)` (`storedPayouts: Pick<SkinsPayout, 'player_id' | 'net_result' | 'buy_in'>[] | null | undefined`) and `PayoutsTabContentProps.holeCounts?`.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

In `src/__tests__/utils/skinsCalculations.test.ts`, in the `@/utils/skins` import, add `resolveSkinsNetResults,` after `calculatePlayedPot,` (A5a-1's addition). Then append to the end of the file:

```ts
// ============================================================================
// Payouts tabs: stored payouts once settled, else a preview on hole counts
// ============================================================================

describe('resolveSkinsNetResults', () => {
  const scores = createMockHoleScores([
    { playerId: 'p1', gross: 4, net: 4, strokes_received: 0 },
    { playerId: 'p2', gross: 4, net: 4, strokes_received: 0 },
  ]);
  const won = (hole: number, winner: string, payout: number) => ({
    hole_number: hole,
    winner_id: winner as string | null,
    is_carryover: false,
    payout_amount: payout,
    carryover_to_next: 0,
    hole_scores: scores,
  });
  const tied = (hole: number, carryover: number) => ({
    hole_number: hole,
    winner_id: null as string | null,
    is_carryover: true,
    payout_amount: 0,
    carryover_to_next: carryover,
    hole_scores: scores,
  });
  // Ann (p1) wins holes 1–5 ($25), Bob (p2) holes 6–9 ($20)
  const nineHoles = createMockResults(
    Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => won(i + 1, i < 5 ? 'p1' : 'p2', 5))
  );
  const baseGame = createMockGame({ participant_ids: ['p1', 'p2'] });

  it('shows the stored payouts of a settled game', () => {
    // Settled before this fix at 18 holes: buy-in $45 → Ann -20, Bob -25
    const stored = [
      { player_id: 'p1', buy_in: 45, net_result: -20 },
      { player_id: 'p2', buy_in: 45, net_result: -25 },
    ];

    expect(
      resolveSkinsNetResults({ ...baseGame, status: 'completed' }, nineHoles, stored, {
        plannedHoles: 9,
        holesPlayed: 9,
      })
    ).toEqual([
      { player_id: 'p1', net_result: -20 },
      { player_id: 'p2', net_result: -25 },
    ]);
  });

  it('previews an unsettled game with every played hole in on the hole counts', () => {
    // $5 × 9 / 2 = $22.50 → Ann +2.50, Bob -2.50
    expect(
      resolveSkinsNetResults({ ...baseGame, status: 'active' }, nineHoles, undefined, {
        plannedHoles: 9,
        holesPlayed: 9,
      })
    ).toEqual([
      { player_id: 'p1', net_result: 2.5 },
      { player_id: 'p2', net_result: -2.5 },
    ]);
  });

  it('previews a completed game whose payouts are not written yet', () => {
    expect(
      resolveSkinsNetResults({ ...baseGame, status: 'completed' }, nineHoles, [], {
        plannedHoles: 9,
        holesPlayed: 9,
      })
    ).toEqual([
      { player_id: 'p1', net_result: 2.5 },
      { player_id: 'p2', net_result: -2.5 },
    ]);
  });

  it('keeps the 18-hole buy-in without hole counts (unchanged values)', () => {
    // 9 of 18 holes in, no carryover: $5 × 18 / 2 = $45 → Ann 25 - 45, Bob 20 - 45
    expect(resolveSkinsNetResults({ ...baseGame, status: 'active' }, nineHoles, undefined)).toEqual([
      { player_id: 'p1', net_result: -20 },
      { player_id: 'p2', net_result: -25 },
    ]);
  });

  it('mid-round, leaves an open carryover unsplit, like the Skins tab live standings', () => {
    // Ann wins hole 1 ($5); hole 2 ties, $5 carries into hole 3 (not played yet).
    // Buy-in $5 × 18 / 2 = $45. Live standings: Ann 5 - 45, Bob 0 - 45.
    // (Splitting the carryover would read Ann -37.50, Bob -42.50.)
    const results = createMockResults([won(1, 'p1', 5), tied(2, 5)]);
    const holeCounts = { plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 18 };
    const participants = [{ id: 'p1' }, { id: 'p2' }];

    const netResults = resolveSkinsNetResults({ ...baseGame, status: 'active' }, results, undefined, holeCounts);

    expect(netResults).toEqual([
      { player_id: 'p1', net_result: -40 },
      { player_id: 'p2', net_result: -45 },
    ]);
    expect(netResults).toEqual(
      calculateInProgressPayouts(baseGame, results, participants, holeCounts).payouts.map((p) => ({
        player_id: p.player_id,
        net_result: p.net_result,
      }))
    );
  });

  it('splits a carryover left on the last hole played once every played hole is in', () => {
    // Ended after 2 of 18: Ann wins hole 1 ($5), hole 2 ties ($5 left over).
    // Buy-in $5 × 2 / 2 = $5; the $5 splits $2.50 each → Ann 7.50 - 5, Bob 2.50 - 5
    const results = createMockResults([won(1, 'p1', 5), tied(2, 5)]);

    expect(
      resolveSkinsNetResults({ ...baseGame, status: 'active' }, results, undefined, {
        plannedHoles: 18,
        holesPlayed: 2,
      })
    ).toEqual([
      { player_id: 'p1', net_result: 2.5 },
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the net-results util**


Directly after the end of `calculateInProgressPayouts` (its closing `}` after `unsettledCarryover: calculateCurrentCarryover(results),` / `};`), insert:

```ts
/** One participant's skins net result, for the payouts tabs. */
export interface SkinsNetResult {
  player_id: string;
  net_result: number;
}

/**
 * Net results for a payouts display.
 * - Settled (calculateSettledPot non-null): the stored skins_payouts.
 * - Unsettled, played holes still to come: the live standings
 *   (calculateInProgressPayouts) — the pending carryover is NOT split, exactly
 *   as Review's Skins tab shows it, so the two tabs agree mid-round.
 * - Unsettled, every played hole in: the settlement preview
 *   (calculateFinalPayouts), which splits a carryover left on the last hole.
 */
export function resolveSkinsNetResults(
  game: Pick<SkinsGame, 'status' | 'pot_type' | 'pot_value' | 'participant_ids'>,
  results: Pick<SkinsResult, 'hole_number' | 'winner_id' | 'is_carryover' | 'payout_amount' | 'carryover_to_next' | 'hole_scores'>[],
  storedPayouts: Pick<SkinsPayout, 'player_id' | 'net_result' | 'buy_in'>[] | null | undefined,
  holeCounts: SkinsHoleCounts = DEFAULT_SKINS_HOLE_COUNTS
): SkinsNetResult[] {
  if (storedPayouts && calculateSettledPot(game, storedPayouts) !== null) {
    return storedPayouts
      .filter(
        (p): p is Pick<SkinsPayout, 'net_result' | 'buy_in'> & { player_id: string } => p.player_id !== null
      )
      .map((p) => ({ player_id: p.player_id, net_result: p.net_result }));
  }

  const participants = game.participant_ids.map((id) => ({ id }));
  const stillPlaying = game.status !== 'completed' && results.length < holeCounts.holesPlayed;
  const payouts = stillPlaying
    ? calculateInProgressPayouts(game, results, participants, holeCounts).payouts
    : calculateFinalPayouts(game, results, participants, holeCounts);
  return payouts.map((p) => ({
    player_id: p.player_id,
    net_result: p.net_result,
  }));
}
```

`SkinsPayout` and `calculateSettledPot` are already in `payouts.ts` (A5a-1), and `calculateInProgressPayouts` takes `holeCounts` (A5d-1), so no import changes.

### Task A6a-1: `finalizeRoundStatus` reports completion and throws on read errors

`finalizeRoundStatus` ignores read errors today: `const { data: roundCards } = …` at `finalizeRoundStatus.ts:42-45, 58-62, 80-83`. A network blip therefore reads as "not complete", which would silently drop a queued finalisation (A6a-3).

This task makes it:
- resolve `true` when the round is completed (now or already);
- resolve `false` while it isn't finished, on an RLS 0-row refusal, or when the round row is missing;
- throw on every other read or write error.

Its tests move from the `useRoundFinalization` hook (deleted in A6d-2) to the service.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/services/rounds/finalizeRoundStatus.ts` (whole file)
- Create: `src/__tests__/services/rounds/finalizeRoundStatus.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/screens/scoring/ReviewScorecardScreen/hooks/useRoundFinalization.ts:13-16` (return type)
- Modify: `src/__tests__/hooks/rounds/useUpdateSubMatchResult.test.tsx:50,75` (mock value)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: nothing new.
- Produces: `finalizeRoundStatus(roundId): Promise<boolean>`. It throws on read errors, and returns `false` for a missing round (`PGRST116`) or an RLS 0-row refusal.

Create `src/__tests__/services/rounds/finalizeRoundStatus.test.ts`. The first six cases are ported unchanged from `src/__tests__/hooks/scorecard/useRoundFinalization.test.ts`, calling the service directly; A6d-2 deletes that hook and its test. The last two lock today's throws.

```ts
/**
 * finalizeRoundStatus — completes a round only when it is genuinely finished.
 *
 * @see src/services/rounds/finalizeRoundStatus.ts
 */
import { finalizeRoundStatus } from '@/services/rounds/finalizeRoundStatus';
import { supabase } from '@/services/supabase/client';

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: jest.fn() },
}));

const ROUND_ID = 'round-aaaaaaaa-0000-0000-0000-000000000000';

type ScorecardRow = { status: string; player_id: string };
type PairingRow = { player_ids: string[] };
type SubMatchRow = { status: string };
type TableError = { message: string; code?: string };

interface MockOptions {
  roundStatus?: string;
  updatedRows?: { id: string; status: string }[];
  errors?: {
    rounds?: TableError;
    scorecards?: TableError;
    sub_matches?: TableError;
    pairings?: TableError;
    update?: TableError;
  };
}

/** Wire supabase.from() per table. Returns the `update` spy. */
function setupSupabaseMocks(
  scorecards: ScorecardRow[],
  pairings: PairingRow[],
  subMatches: SubMatchRow[] = [],
  {
    roundStatus = 'in-progress',
    updatedRows = [{ id: ROUND_ID, status: 'completed' }],
    errors = {},
  }: MockOptions = {}
): jest.Mock {
  const updateSpy = jest.fn().mockReturnValue({
    eq: jest.fn().mockReturnValue({
      select: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(
        errors.update ? { data: null, error: errors.update } : { data: updatedRows, error: null }
      ),
    }),
  });

  const listTable = (rows: unknown[], error?: TableError) => ({
    select: jest.fn().mockReturnValue({
      eq: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(error ? { data: null, error } : { data: rows, error: null }),
    }),
  });

  (supabase.from as jest.Mock).mockImplementation((table: string) => {
    switch (table) {
      case 'scorecards':
        return listTable(scorecards, errors.scorecards);
      case 'pairings':
        return listTable(pairings, errors.pairings);
      case 'sub_matches':
        return listTable(subMatches, errors.sub_matches);
      case 'rounds':
      default:
        return {
          // Initial fetch: .select().eq().single()
          select: jest.fn().mockReturnValue({
            eq: jest.fn().mockReturnValue({
              single: jest.fn().mockResolvedValue(
                errors.rounds
                  ? { data: null, error: errors.rounds }
                  : {
                      data: {
                        id: ROUND_ID,
                        status: roundStatus,
                        user_id: 'user-11111111',
                        competition_id: 'comp-11111111',
                      },
                      error: null,
                    }
              ),
            }),
          }),
          // Status update: .update().eq().select()
          update: updateSpy,
        };
    }
  });

  return updateSpy;
}

function makeCards(statuses: string[]): ScorecardRow[] {
  return statuses.map((status, i) => ({ status, player_id: `player-${i + 1}` }));
}

function makePairings(playerCount: number): PairingRow[] {
  const group1 = Array.from({ length: playerCount / 2 }, (_, i) => `player-${i + 1}`);
  const group2 = Array.from({ length: playerCount / 2 }, (_, i) => `player-${i + 1 + playerCount / 2}`);
  return [{ player_ids: group1 }, { player_ids: group2 }];
}
```

```ts
/**
 * finalizeRoundStatus
 *
 * Flips a round to `completed` — but only when it is genuinely finished:
 *  - Split rounds (players grouped in `sub_matches`) complete only once EVERY
 *    sub-match is terminal (completed/forfeited). This is the same condition
 *    result aggregation requires (see finalizePairResults), and prevents the
 *    first sub-match's submit/forfeit from flipping the whole round.
 *  - Non-split rounds gate on scorecards: every scorecard terminal AND enough
 *    terminal cards to cover the distinct players across the round's pairings
 *    (multi-group independence — one group's submit must not lock out another).
 *
 * Shared by every submit path (through finalizeSubmittedRound, including the
 * queued "finalise round" sync item) and the sub-match result/forfeit flow
 * (useUpdateSubMatchResult) so completion is decided in exactly one place.
 *
 * Resolves true when the round is completed — by this call or already before
 * it. Resolves false while the round isn't finished, when the round row can't
 * be found (deleted, or not visible to this user), or when the update is
 * refused (0 rows: RLS — e.g. a competition player who isn't the organiser),
 * which no retry can fix. THROWS on any other read or write error: a network
 * blip must never read as "not complete", or a queued finalisation is dropped.
 */
import { supabase } from '@/services/supabase/client';
import { submitLogger } from '@/utils/debugLogger';

/** PostgREST code for `.single()` matching no row. */
const NO_ROWS = 'PGRST116';

function readError(what: string, roundId: string, error: { message?: string }): Error {
  return new Error(
    `Failed to read ${what} for round ${roundId.substring(0, 8)}: ${error.message ?? 'unknown error'}`
  );
}

export async function finalizeRoundStatus(roundId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    // Query the round's current status before updating (logging / context).
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- Supabase generated types restriction workaround
    const { data: currentRound, error: fetchError } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('rounds')
      .select('id, status, user_id, competition_id')
      .eq('id', roundId)
      .single();

    if (fetchError) {
      if (fetchError.code === NO_ROWS) {
        // Deleted, or not visible to this user: there is nothing to complete.
        submitLogger.warn('Round not found before status update', { roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...' });
        return false;
      }
      throw readError('the round', roundId, fetchError);
    }

    submitLogger.info('Round current state before update', {
      roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
      currentStatus: currentRound?.status,
      userId: currentRound?.user_id?.substring(0, 8) + '...',
      competitionId: currentRound?.competition_id?.substring(0, 8) || 'standalone',
    });

    const alreadyCompleted = currentRound?.status === 'completed';

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- generated-types workaround
    const { data: roundCards, error: cardsError } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('scorecards')
      .select('status, player_id')
      .eq('round_id', roundId);
    if (cardsError) throw readError('scorecards', roundId, cardsError);

    const cards: { status: string }[] = roundCards ?? [];
    const TERMINAL = new Set(['completed', 'confirmed']);
    const terminalCount = cards.filter((c) => TERMINAL.has(c.status)).length;
    const allTerminal = cards.length > 0 && terminalCount === cards.length;

    // Split rounds group players in `sub_matches` (NOT `pairings`), so the
    // pairings-based field-size guard below sees 0 players and would let the
    // FIRST sub-match's submit/forfeit flip the whole round to completed (the
    // "round shows complete" bug). For split rounds the correct invariant is:
    // complete only once EVERY sub-match is terminal.
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- generated-types workaround
    const { data: subMatchRows, error: subMatchesError } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('sub_matches')
      .select('status')
      .eq('round_id', roundId);
    if (subMatchesError) throw readError('sub-matches', roundId, subMatchesError);
    const subMatches: { status: string }[] = subMatchRows ?? [];

    if (subMatches.length > 0) {
      const TERMINAL_SM = new Set(['completed', 'forfeited']);
      const terminalSubMatches = subMatches.filter((s) => TERMINAL_SM.has(s.status)).length;
      if (terminalSubMatches !== subMatches.length) {
        submitLogger.info('Split round not yet complete — sub-matches still open', {
          roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
          terminalSubMatches,
          totalSubMatches: subMatches.length,
        });
        return alreadyCompleted;
      }
      // Every sub-match is terminal → fall through to mark the round completed.
    } else {
      // Non-split round: gate on scorecards. Expected field size = distinct
      // players across the round's pairings.
      // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- generated-types workaround
      const { data: pairingRows, error: pairingsError } = await (supabase as any)
        .from('pairings')
        .select('player_ids')
        .eq('round_id', roundId);
      if (pairingsError) throw readError('pairings', roundId, pairingsError);
      const expected = pairingRows
        ? new Set(
            (pairingRows as { player_ids: string[] }[]).flatMap((p) => p.player_ids ?? [])
          ).size
        : 0;
      const enoughCards = expected === 0 ? true : terminalCount >= expected;

      if (!allTerminal || !enoughCards) {
        submitLogger.info('Round not yet complete — leaving status unchanged', {
          roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
          terminalCount,
          totalCards: cards.length,
          expected,
        });
        return alreadyCompleted;
      }
    }

    submitLogger.info('Updating round status to completed', { roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...' });

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any -- Supabase generated types restriction workaround
    const { data: updatedRows, error } = await (supabase as any)
      .from('rounds')
      .update({ status: 'completed' })
      .eq('id', roundId)
      .select('id, status');

    if (error) {
      submitLogger.error('Failed to update round status', error, { roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...' });
      throw error;
    }

    if (!updatedRows || updatedRows.length === 0) {
      // RLS refused the write. A retry can't help (a queued finalisation would
      // only burn its retries into a retained failure), so report "not
      // completed by this call" instead of throwing.
      submitLogger.error('Round status update affected 0 rows - possible RLS policy issue', undefined, {
        roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
      });
      return alreadyCompleted;
    }

    submitLogger.info('Round status updated successfully', {
      roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
      newStatus: updatedRows[0]?.status,
      rowsAffected: updatedRows.length,
    });
    return true;
  } catch (error) {
    submitLogger.error('Error updating round status', error, { roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...' });
    throw error;
  }
}
```

### Task A6a-2: `finalizeSubmittedRound`, `queueRoundFinalize` and `hasUnsyncedScorecardsForRound`

This task adds the shared post-submit steps, `finalizeSubmittedRound` (status → results → skins; never rejects on a step failure, only with `RoundNotReadyError` while the round is already in flight), and `queueRoundFinalize`, which writes them as a durable `round` sync item, plus `removeQueuedRoundFinalize` to drop that item by its entity key. It also adds the DAO check that the queue handler (A6a-3) runs before anything else, and a DAO delete by entity key. Callers switch over in A6c and A6d-1.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/services/rounds/finalizeSubmittedRound.ts`
- Create: `src/__tests__/services/rounds/finalizeSubmittedRound.test.ts`
- Modify: `src/services/offline/dao/SyncQueueDAO.ts` (add `removePendingSyncByEntityKey` after `removePendingSync`, line 115; add `hasUnsyncedScorecardsForRound` after `getFailedSyncCountForRound`, line 204)
- Modify: `src/services/offline/database.ts:49` (re-exports)
- Test: `src/__tests__/services/offline/database.test.ts` (import + new describe)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `finalizeRoundStatus` (A6a-1);
  - `finalizeActiveSkinsForRound(roundId): Promise<{ finalized: boolean; game?: SkinsGame; error?: unknown }>` (A5b, `@/services/skins/finalizeSkinsGame`);
  - `refinalizeRoundResults` (existing; swallows its own errors);
  - `addPendingSync`;
  - `roundKeys.all`, `skinsKeys.all`, `competitionKeys.all` (`@/hooks/queryKeys`); `invalidateLeaderboardCache` (`@/services/queryClient`).
- Produces:
  - `RoundSyncData` = `{ id: string; action: 'finalize'; userId?: string }`;
  - `FinalizeSubmittedRoundResult { completed: boolean; skinsGame: SkinsGame | null; statusError: unknown; skinsError: unknown }`;
  - `finalizeSubmittedRound(roundId)`: marks the round in flight while it runs, with an atomic test-and-set. It rejects only with `RoundNotReadyError` when the round is already in flight (another caller's run), and never on a step failure;
  - `isRoundFinalizeInFlight(roundId): boolean` (tests and diagnostics; no caller needs to pre-check it);
  - `roundFinalizeEntityKey(roundId)` = `round:<id>:finalize`;
  - `queueRoundFinalize(roundId)` (A6b-1 adds `options?: { requestDrain?: boolean }`);
  - `removeQueuedRoundFinalize(roundId): Promise<boolean>`;
  - `class RoundNotReadyError` (`constructor(roundId: string, reason?: string)`);
  - `hasUnsyncedScorecardsForRound(roundId): Promise<boolean>` (pending queue rows, plus submitted SQLite cards with no queue row; retained `failed` rows are not counted);
  - `removePendingSyncByEntityKey(entityKey): Promise<boolean>` (DAO; no revision guard).

```ts
    expect(mockInvalidateLeaderboardCache).toHaveBeenCalledWith();
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ queryKey: ['competitions'] });
    // Prefix of ['home', 'inProgressRounds', uid] and ['home', 'upcomingRounds', uid].
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ queryKey: ['home'] });
  });

  it('marks the round in flight only while it runs', async () => {
    let release!: (value: boolean) => void;
    mockFinalizeRoundStatus.mockReturnValue(
      new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
        release = resolve;
      })
    );

    const running = finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID);
    expect(isRoundFinalizeInFlight(ROUND_ID)).toBe(true);
    expect(isRoundFinalizeInFlight('another-round')).toBe(false);

    release(true);
    await running;
    expect(isRoundFinalizeInFlight(ROUND_ID)).toBe(false);
  });

  // The test-and-set is atomic: no await separates the check from the mark,
  // so a submit screen and a drain can never both run the steps.
  it('runs the steps once when two callers race for the same round; the second gets RoundNotReadyError', async () => {
    let release!: (value: boolean) => void;
    mockFinalizeRoundStatus.mockReturnValue(
      new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => {
        release = resolve;
      })
    );

    const first = finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID);
    const second = finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID);

    await expect(second).rejects.toBeInstanceOf(RoundNotReadyError);
    // The loser leaves the winner's mark alone.
    expect(isRoundFinalizeInFlight(ROUND_ID)).toBe(true);

    release(true);
    await expect(first).resolves.toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ completed: true }));
    expect(mockFinalizeRoundStatus).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockRefinalize).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockFinalizeActiveSkins).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(isRoundFinalizeInFlight(ROUND_ID)).toBe(false);

    // Once the first run has finished, the round can be finalised again.
    mockFinalizeRoundStatus.mockResolvedValue(true);
    await expect(finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID)).resolves.toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ completed: true })
    );
  });

  it('still writes results and settles skins when the round is not complete yet', async () => {
    mockFinalizeRoundStatus.mockResolvedValue(false);

    await expect(finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID)).resolves.toEqual({
      completed: false,
      skinsGame: null,
      statusError: null,
      skinsError: null,
    });
    expect(mockRefinalize).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockFinalizeActiveSkins).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('returns the skins game it settled and refreshes the skins caches', async () => {
    mockFinalizeActiveSkins.mockResolvedValue({ finalized: true, game: SETTLED_GAME });

    const result = await finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID);

    expect(result.skinsGame).toBe(SETTLED_GAME);
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ queryKey: ['skins'] });
  });

  it('reports a skins error for retry without failing the round', async () => {
    const skinsFailure = new Error('payouts insert failed');
    mockFinalizeActiveSkins.mockResolvedValue({ finalized: false, error: skinsFailure });

    await expect(finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID)).resolves.toEqual({
      completed: true,
      skinsGame: null,
      statusError: null,
      skinsError: skinsFailure,
    });
  });

  it('reports a failed status write without rejecting, after results and skins ran, keeping the settled game', async () => {
    const failure = new Error('network down');
    mockFinalizeRoundStatus.mockRejectedValue(failure);
    mockFinalizeActiveSkins.mockResolvedValue({ finalized: true, game: SETTLED_GAME });

    await expect(finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID)).resolves.toEqual({
      completed: false,
      skinsGame: SETTLED_GAME,
      statusError: failure,
      skinsError: null,
    });
    expect(mockRefinalize).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockFinalizeActiveSkins).toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('does not reject even if the results step throws', async () => {
    mockRefinalize.mockRejectedValue(new Error('boom'));

    await expect(finalizeSubmittedRound(ROUND_ID)).resolves.toEqual(
      expect.objectContaining({ completed: true })
    );
    expect(mockFinalizeActiveSkins).toHaveBeenCalled();
```
