- [ ] **Step 1: Write the migration**

Create `supabase/migrations/20261007000200_end_round_early.sql`:

```sql
-- =====================================================
-- End a social round early
-- The Nineteenth
-- =====================================================
-- 1. rounds.holes_played: how many holes, counted from the round's first
--    hole, were played when a standalone round was ended early.
--    NULL = played as planned. A back-9 round ended after 6 = holes 10-15.
--    CHECK: only standalone rounds, and 1 <= N < planned holes.
-- 2. end_round_early(p_round_id, p_holes_played): SECURITY DEFINER. Called
--    by the client at confirm time (online), or by the queued 'end_early'
--    round sync item (offline). Sets holes_played, trims side-game and
--    multi-scorer rows after the last played hole, strips those holes from
--    the round's scorecards.scores, and nulls the round's handicap
--    differentials. skins_results can only be deleted by the skins-game
--    creator under RLS, so a participant ending the round needs the
--    definer's rights.
--    Error contract (the client maps these; it never retries them):
--      42501  not authenticated / competition round / not the owner or an
--             ACCEPTED round participant
--      P0002  round missing or soft-deleted
--      22023  HINT 'invalid_holes_played'  N outside 1..planned-1
--             HINT 'round_already_ended'   holes_played already set to a
--                                          different N (DETAIL = that N)
--             HINT 'round_completed'       round completed, never ended
--             HINT 'round_not_in_progress' round not started (upcoming)
--    The same N again is a no-op success (idempotent retries), whatever the
--    round's status.
--    scorecards.revision is NOT bumped and totals are NOT recomputed: totals
--    are client-owned, and the ending device's next write_scorecard_snapshot
--    (same stripped scores, the revision it already holds) must apply
--    cleanly instead of raising a false "changed on another device" conflict.
-- 2b. guard_rounds_holes_played (BEFORE UPDATE on rounds): holes_played can
--    only change inside end_round_early (transaction-local flag
--    app.ending_round = 'on'), and nine_type can't change once it is set.
-- 3. Extends the "only full scorecards count" rule from
--    20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql by replacing its shared
--    helper scorecard_eligible_for_differential(round_id, scores): a round
--    with holes_played set never yields a differential (even for {} /
--    multi-ball cards) and its cards can't be combined. Both A7 triggers pick
--    this up unchanged. This also neutralises old clients (1.14.x) that
--    recalculate null differentials on Home.
-- 4. get_activity_feed / get_round_feed_card also return holes_played and
--    nine_type, for the "Ended after N of M" label on the feed card.
--
-- DEPLOY ORDER: after 20260905000150 (UGC feed) and 20261007000100 (A7);
-- staging, then prod, BEFORE the app build that selects rounds.holes_played.
-- NEVER re-apply 20261007000100 after this file: it redefines
-- scorecard_eligible_for_differential without the holes_played rule. If A7
-- must be re-applied, re-apply this file straight after it (idempotent).
-- Apply with:
--   psql "$DB_URL" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 --single-transaction -f supabase/migrations/20261007000200_end_round_early.sql
-- =====================================================

-- Fail fast if A7's completeness functions are missing.
DO $$
BEGIN
  IF to_regprocedure('public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(jsonb, text)') IS NULL
     OR to_regprocedure('public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(uuid, jsonb)') IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Apply 20261007000100_full_scorecards_only_handicap.sql before 20261007000200_end_round_early.sql';
  END IF;
END $$;

-- =====================================================
-- 1. rounds.holes_played
-- =====================================================
ALTER TABLE rounds ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS holes_played SMALLINT;

DO $$ BEGIN
  ALTER TABLE rounds ADD CONSTRAINT rounds_holes_played_check
    CHECK (
      holes_played IS NULL
      OR (
        competition_id IS NULL
        AND holes_played > 0
        AND holes_played < CASE nine_type WHEN 'full' THEN 18 ELSE 9 END
      )
    );
EXCEPTION WHEN duplicate_object THEN NULL;
END $$;

COMMENT ON COLUMN rounds.holes_played IS
  'Holes played when a standalone round was ended early, counted from the round''s first hole (back9 + 6 = holes 10-15). NULL = played as planned. Written only by end_round_early(). A round with holes_played set never counts toward the handicap index.';

-- =====================================================
-- 2. end_round_early
-- =====================================================
-- The plan-v1 draft had a 3-argument signature (a front-9 conversion flag).
-- It was never deployed; drop it defensively so only the 2-argument
-- function exists.
DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS end_round_early(UUID, INT, BOOLEAN);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION end_round_early(
  p_round_id UUID,
  p_holes_played INT
)
RETURNS VOID
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SECURITY DEFINER
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_user UUID := auth.uid();
  v_owner UUID;
  v_competition_id UUID;
  v_nine_type TEXT;
  v_status TEXT;
  v_existing SMALLINT;
  v_planned INT;
  v_last_hole INT;
BEGIN
  IF v_user IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authenticated' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  SELECT user_id, competition_id, nine_type, status, holes_played
    INTO v_owner, v_competition_id, v_nine_type, v_status, v_existing
  FROM rounds
  WHERE id = p_round_id AND deleted_at IS NULL
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Round % not found', p_round_id USING ERRCODE = 'P0002';
  END IF;

  IF v_competition_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Only social rounds can be ended early' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  -- The owner, or an ACCEPTED participant. is_round_participant would also
  -- let pending and declined invitees in.
  IF v_owner IS DISTINCT FROM v_user
     AND NOT is_accepted_round_participant(p_round_id, v_user) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Not authorized to end round %', p_round_id USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;

  v_planned := CASE WHEN v_nine_type = 'full' THEN 18 ELSE 9 END;
  IF p_holes_played IS NULL OR p_holes_played < 1 OR p_holes_played >= v_planned THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'holes_played must be between 1 and % for a % round (got %)',
      v_planned - 1, v_nine_type, p_holes_played
      USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'invalid_holes_played';
  END IF;

  IF v_existing IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF v_existing = p_holes_played THEN
      -- Retry of a call that already landed (queued item, double tap,
      -- second device ending at the same hole): no-op success, any status.
      RETURN;
    END IF;
    -- First end wins. The client adopts the server's N from DETAIL.
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Round % was already ended after % holes', p_round_id, v_existing
      USING ERRCODE = '22023', DETAIL = v_existing::TEXT, HINT = 'round_already_ended';
  END IF;

  -- Only a round being played can be ended (the same-N retry above already
  -- returned, so a queued retry after completion still succeeds).
  IF v_status IS DISTINCT FROM 'in-progress' THEN
    IF v_status = 'completed' THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'Round % is already completed', p_round_id
        USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'round_completed';
    END IF;
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Round % is not in progress (status %)', p_round_id, v_status
      USING ERRCODE = '22023', HINT = 'round_not_in_progress';
  END IF;

  v_last_hole := (CASE WHEN v_nine_type = 'back9' THEN 9 ELSE 0 END) + p_holes_played;

  -- guard_rounds_holes_played (below) refuses any holes_played change unless
  -- this transaction-local flag is on. Set it around this one UPDATE only.
  PERFORM set_config('app.ending_round', 'on', true);
  UPDATE rounds
     SET holes_played = p_holes_played, updated_at = NOW()
   WHERE id = p_round_id;
  PERFORM set_config('app.ending_round', 'off', true);

  -- Rows for holes after the last played hole.
  DELETE FROM skins_results sr
   USING skins_games sg
   WHERE sr.skins_game_id = sg.id
     AND sg.round_id = p_round_id
     AND sr.hole_number > v_last_hole;

  DELETE FROM wolf_hole_decisions wd
   USING wolf_games wg
   WHERE wd.wolf_game_id = wg.id
     AND wg.round_id = p_round_id
     AND wd.hole_number > v_last_hole;

  DELETE FROM score_entries se
   WHERE se.round_id = p_round_id
     AND se.hole_number > v_last_hole;

  -- A pending mismatch on a removed hole would block multi-scorer submission
  -- readiness on another phone.
  DELETE FROM score_mismatches sm
   WHERE sm.round_id = p_round_id
     AND sm.hole_number > v_last_hole;

  -- shot_log feeds the v_sand_saves views; shots on unplayed holes must go.
  DELETE FROM shot_log sl
   WHERE sl.round_id = p_round_id
     AND sl.hole_number > v_last_hole;

  -- Score keys after the last played hole ('16', '17', '18' for a back 9
  -- ended after 6). Non-numeric keys and {} cards are left alone.
  -- Deliberately NOT touched: revision (only write_scorecard_snapshot bumps
  -- it; bumping it here would turn the ending device's own follow-up
  -- snapshot into a stale write and a false "changed on another device"
  -- conflict) and the totals (client-owned; that snapshot carries them,
  -- recomputed over the holes played).
  UPDATE scorecards sc
     SET scores = (
           SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_object_agg(e.key, e.value), '{}'::JSONB)
             FROM jsonb_each(sc.scores) AS e
            WHERE CASE WHEN e.key ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' THEN e.key::INT <= v_last_hole ELSE TRUE END
         )
   WHERE sc.round_id = p_round_id
     AND jsonb_typeof(sc.scores) = 'object'
     AND EXISTS (
           SELECT 1
             FROM jsonb_object_keys(sc.scores) AS k
            WHERE CASE WHEN k ~ '^[0-9]{1,3}$' THEN k::INT > v_last_hole ELSE FALSE END
         );

  -- No handicap impact at all (R13). A7's scorecards trigger (via the helper
  -- replaced in section 3) keeps it NULL on every later write.
  UPDATE scorecards
     SET handicap_differential = NULL
   WHERE round_id = p_round_id
     AND handicap_differential IS NOT NULL;
END;
$$;

REVOKE ALL ON FUNCTION end_round_early(UUID, INT) FROM PUBLIC;
GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION end_round_early(UUID, INT) TO authenticated;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION end_round_early(UUID, INT) IS
  'End an in-progress standalone round early (owner or accepted participant). Sets holes_played = N; deletes skins_results / wolf_hole_decisions / score_entries / score_mismatches / shot_log after the last played hole; strips those hole keys from the round''s scorecards.scores (revision and totals untouched: totals are client-owned); nulls the round''s handicap differentials. Same N again = no-op, any status. Errors: 42501 auth/competition, P0002 missing/deleted, 22023 with HINT invalid_holes_played | round_already_ended (DETAIL = existing N) | round_completed | round_not_in_progress. SECURITY DEFINER (skins_results RLS is creator-only).';

-- =====================================================
-- 2b. holes_played is written only by end_round_early
-- =====================================================
-- "Users can update rounds" / "Accepted players can update standalone
-- rounds" let the owner and accepted invitees UPDATE the row, and
-- protect_round_ownership_fields pins only user_id / competition_id /
-- deleted_at. A direct write of holes_played would skip the trims (or clear
-- an end), and changing nine_type after an end would move the played holes.
-- No service-role exemption: an admin fix runs
--   SELECT set_config('app.ending_round', 'on', true);
-- in the same transaction first. The flag is transaction-local, so it never
-- leaks across pooled connections, and clients can't set it through
-- PostgREST.

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_rounds_holes_played()
RETURNS TRIGGER
LANGUAGE plpgsql
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.holes_played IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.holes_played
     AND COALESCE(current_setting('app.ending_round', true), '') <> 'on' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'rounds.holes_played can only be changed by end_round_early()'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF OLD.holes_played IS NOT NULL AND NEW.nine_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.nine_type THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'The nine type of a round that was ended early cannot change'
      USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN NEW;
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.guard_rounds_holes_played() IS
  'BEFORE UPDATE guard on rounds: holes_played changes only inside end_round_early (transaction-local app.ending_round = on); nine_type is frozen once holes_played is set. Raises 42501.';

DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS trigger_guard_rounds_holes_played ON rounds;
CREATE TRIGGER trigger_guard_rounds_holes_played
  BEFORE UPDATE ON rounds
  FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION public.guard_rounds_holes_played();

-- =====================================================
-- 3. Extend the "only full scorecards count" rule (A7)
-- =====================================================
-- A7's two triggers (scorecards_full_card_differential on scorecards,
-- handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards on handicap_combined_rounds) both
-- delegate to scorecard_eligible_for_differential(round_id, scores). Replacing
-- only that helper extends both triggers; the trigger functions, their RAISE
-- text ('Both nines must be fully scored to combine') and ERRCODE (22023) are
-- untouched. The one change: a round with holes_played set is never eligible,
-- even for a card with no per-hole data ({} legacy / multi-ball).
-- CREATE OR REPLACE keeps A7's REVOKE on this function. Re-applying A7's
-- migration after this one would undo this replacement (see DEPLOY ORDER).

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(
  p_round_id UUID,
  p_scores JSONB
)
RETURNS BOOLEAN
LANGUAGE plpgsql
STABLE
SET search_path = public, pg_temp
AS $$
DECLARE
  v_nine_type TEXT;
  v_holes_played SMALLINT;
BEGIN
  SELECT r.nine_type, r.holes_played
    INTO v_nine_type, v_holes_played
    FROM rounds r
   WHERE r.id = p_round_id;
  RETURN v_holes_played IS NULL
     AND public.scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap(p_scores, COALESCE(v_nine_type, 'full'));
END;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(UUID, JSONB) IS
  'Single handicap-eligibility decision used by the scorecards_full_card_differential and handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards triggers: the round was not ended early (holes_played IS NULL) and the card is complete for its nine type. Replace this function (not the triggers) to add a rule.';

-- No data fix is needed here: holes_played is a new column, so no existing
-- card belongs to an ended-early round. A7 nulls existing incomplete cards.

-- =====================================================
-- 4. Activity feed RPCs: add holes_played + nine_type
-- =====================================================
-- Bodies reproduced verbatim from 20260905000150_ugc_moderation_feed.sql.
-- The ONLY change is two output columns appended at the end of RETURNS
-- TABLE and of each SELECT list (plus the CTE's SELECT/GROUP BY). Adding
-- columns changes the return type, which CREATE OR REPLACE cannot do, so
-- drop first (precedent: 20260616000000_activity_feed_course_id.sql). Safe:
-- these functions are only called from the client via rpc(); no policy,
-- view or function depends on them.

DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS get_activity_feed(INT, TIMESTAMPTZ);

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION get_activity_feed(
  p_limit  INT DEFAULT 20,
  p_before TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NULL
)
RETURNS TABLE (
  round_id         UUID,
  competition_id   UUID,
  course_id        UUID,
  club_id          UUID,
  course_name      TEXT,
  club_name        TEXT,
  club_location    TEXT,
  round_date       DATE,
  game_type        TEXT,
  is_team_round    BOOLEAN,
  activity_at      TIMESTAMPTZ,
  participants     JSONB,
  photos           JSONB,
  like_count       INT,
  comment_count    INT,
  viewer_has_liked BOOLEAN,
  holes_played     INT,
  nine_type        TEXT
)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  WITH visible_rounds AS (
    SELECT r.id, r.competition_id, r.course_id, r.date, r.game_type, r.is_team_round,
           r.holes_played, r.nine_type,
           MAX(sc.submitted_at) AS activity_at
    FROM rounds r
    JOIN scorecards sc ON sc.round_id = r.id
      AND sc.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND sc.status IN ('completed', 'confirmed')
      AND sc.submitted_at IS NOT NULL
    WHERE r.status = 'completed'
      AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND social_enabled()
      AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM scorecards f
        WHERE f.round_id = r.id
          AND f.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (f.player_id = auth.uid() OR is_friend(f.player_id))
      )
    GROUP BY r.id, r.competition_id, r.course_id, r.date, r.game_type, r.is_team_round,
             r.holes_played, r.nine_type
    HAVING (p_before IS NULL OR MAX(sc.submitted_at) < p_before)
    ORDER BY MAX(sc.submitted_at) DESC, r.id DESC
    LIMIT GREATEST(p_limit, 1)
  )
  SELECT
    vr.id,
    vr.competition_id,
    co.id,
    cl.id,
    co.name::TEXT,
    cl.name::TEXT,
    NULLIF(concat_ws(', ', cl.city, cl.state), '')::TEXT,
    vr.date,
    vr.game_type::TEXT,
    vr.is_team_round,
    vr.activity_at,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
               'player_id', p.id,
               'name', p.name,
               'photo_url', p.photo_url,
               'total_gross', sc.total_gross,
               'total_net', sc.total_net,
               'total_points', sc.total_points
             ) ORDER BY sc.total_points DESC NULLS LAST)
      FROM scorecards sc
      JOIN players p ON p.id = sc.player_id
      WHERE sc.round_id = vr.id
        AND sc.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND sc.status IN ('completed', 'confirmed')
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
               'id', ph.id,
               'storage_path', ph.storage_path,
               'width', ph.width,
               'height', ph.height,
               'uploader_id', ph.uploader_id
             ) ORDER BY ph.created_at)
      FROM round_photos ph
      WHERE ph.round_id = vr.id AND ph.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), ph.uploader_id)
        AND NOT is_reported_by_viewer('round_photo', ph.id)
    ), '[]'::jsonb),
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM round_likes rl
      WHERE rl.round_id = vr.id
        AND NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), rl.player_id))::INT,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM round_comments rc
      WHERE rc.round_id = vr.id AND rc.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND NOT is_blocked_pair(auth.uid(), rc.author_id)
        AND NOT is_reported_by_viewer('round_comment', rc.id))::INT,
    EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM round_likes rl WHERE rl.round_id = vr.id AND rl.player_id = auth.uid()),
    vr.holes_played::INT,
    vr.nine_type::TEXT
  FROM visible_rounds vr
  JOIN courses co ON co.id = vr.course_id
  JOIN clubs cl ON cl.id = co.club_id
  ORDER BY vr.activity_at DESC, vr.id DESC;
$$;

COMMENT ON FUNCTION get_activity_feed(INT, TIMESTAMPTZ) IS
  'Keyset-paginated activity feed: completed rounds where the viewer or an accepted friend has a submitted scorecard. SECURITY DEFINER; self-authorizing via is_friend(). Cursor = activity_at (MAX submitted_at). Returns course_id/club_id for course deep-linking and holes_played/nine_type for the "Ended after N of M" label.';

GRANT EXECUTE ON FUNCTION get_activity_feed(INT, TIMESTAMPTZ) TO authenticated;

LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
```

### Task B1a-2: Verification script for `end_round_early`

**Files:**
- Create: `supabase/tests/end_round_early_verify.sql` (runnable, rolled-back verification; same pattern as `supabase/tests/soft_delete_verify.sql`, fixtures as in `sand_save_views_verify.sql` for club/course)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: everything B1a-1 produces, and A7's `scorecard_is_complete_for_handicap` (the complete back-9 / front-9 fixture cards must count as complete under A7's rule).
- Produces: the script B11 runs on staging after A7 and B1a-1 are applied.

It covers:
- the back-9 offset (trims > 15, not > 6) on all five trimmed tables, and the round's differentials nulled (Review Focus #2);
- the score-key strip: a card's `scores` keeps holes 10–15 only, a `{}` card stays `{}`, and `revision` and `total_gross` are untouched; the `app.ending_round` flag is off again after the call;
- the trigger extension against an old-client write: a complete card, a `{}` card and a new card all stay NULL (Review Focus #5);
- the combine trigger: an ended-early card is rejected; a complete, not-ended pair still combines (positive control);
- same-N retry is a no-op; a different N is a conflict with `HINT round_already_ended` and `DETAIL '6'` (Review Focus #3);
- declined and pending invitees, an outsider and an unauthenticated call are rejected (`42501`);
- range checks (`0`, `18`, `19`, `NULL` on a full round);
- rounds not in progress: completed same N no-op, different N conflict, never-ended refused (`round_completed`); an `upcoming` round refused (`round_not_in_progress`);
- competition (`42501`), soft-deleted and missing rounds (`P0002`);
- the CHECK constraint (`18` and `0` on full, `9` on back 9, any value on a competition round), with the guard's flag on;
- the catalog: feed columns, a single 2-argument overload, `EXECUTE` granted to `authenticated`, `search_path = public, pg_temp` on the RPC and the helper, the guard trigger;
- the guard trigger: a direct `holes_played` write (set, change or clear; owner or superuser) and a `nine_type` change on an ended round are refused with `42501`; a `nine_type` change on a round that wasn't ended still works.

Every fixture `INSERT` was checked against the NOT NULL / CHECK constraints in the migrations as they stand: `competitions` needs `end_date` because `competition_type` defaults to `'event'` (`event_requires_end_date`, `20260228300000_rename_league_to_knockout.sql:13,19-23`); `skins_games` needs 2–4 `participant_ids` and the disclaimer columns; `wolf_games` needs 3–4 participants with a matching `wolf_order`; `score_mismatches`' legacy `self_*`/`partner_*` columns are nullable since `20260425000000`; `handicap_combined_rounds` needs `course_id` and distinct, unused front/back cards; `courses.holes` / `timezone` have defaults.

```sql
-- =====================================================
-- TEST 1: an accepted participant (not the owner) ends the back-9 round
--         after 6. Last played hole = 9 + 6 = 15 (Review Focus #2): rows
--         for holes 16-18 are deleted, rows for 10-15 are kept, score keys
--         16-18 are stripped from the cards (revision and totals untouched),
--         and the round's differentials are nulled.
-- =====================================================
SET LOCAL role authenticated;
SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims = '{"sub":"ee000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002","role":"authenticated"}';

DO $$ BEGIN
  PERFORM end_round_early('ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001', 6);
END $$;

RESET ROLE;

DO $$
DECLARE
  v_holes        SMALLINT;
  v_nine         TEXT;
  v_skins        INT;
  v_skins_max    INT;
  v_wolf_max     INT;
  v_entry_max    INT;
  v_mismatch_max INT;
  v_shots        INT;
  v_shot_max     INT;
  v_diffs        INT;
  v_sc1_keys     TEXT[];
  v_sc1_revision BIGINT;
  v_sc1_gross    INT;
  v_sc2_scores   JSONB;
BEGIN
  SELECT holes_played, nine_type INTO v_holes, v_nine
    FROM rounds WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001';
  SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(hole_number) INTO v_skins, v_skins_max
    FROM skins_results WHERE skins_game_id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0002-000000000001';
  SELECT MAX(hole_number) INTO v_wolf_max
    FROM wolf_hole_decisions WHERE wolf_game_id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0003-000000000001';
  SELECT MAX(hole_number) INTO v_entry_max
    FROM score_entries WHERE round_id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001';
  SELECT MAX(hole_number) INTO v_mismatch_max
    FROM score_mismatches WHERE round_id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001';
  SELECT COUNT(*), MAX(hole_number) INTO v_shots, v_shot_max
    FROM shot_log WHERE round_id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001';
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_diffs
    FROM scorecards
   WHERE round_id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001'
     AND handicap_differential IS NOT NULL;

  ASSERT v_holes = 6, 'Test 1 FAILED: holes_played should be 6, got ' || COALESCE(v_holes::TEXT, 'NULL');
  ASSERT v_nine = 'back9', 'Test 1 FAILED: nine_type should stay back9, got ' || v_nine;
  ASSERT v_skins = 6 AND v_skins_max = 15,
    'Test 1 FAILED: expected skins results for holes 10-15 only, got ' || v_skins || ' rows, max ' || v_skins_max;
  ASSERT v_wolf_max = 15, 'Test 1 FAILED: wolf max hole should be 15, got ' || COALESCE(v_wolf_max::TEXT, 'NULL');
  ASSERT v_entry_max = 15, 'Test 1 FAILED: score_entries max hole should be 15, got ' || COALESCE(v_entry_max::TEXT, 'NULL');
  ASSERT v_mismatch_max = 15, 'Test 1 FAILED: score_mismatches max hole should be 15, got ' || COALESCE(v_mismatch_max::TEXT, 'NULL');
  ASSERT v_shots = 6 AND v_shot_max = 15,
    'Test 1 FAILED: expected shot_log for holes 10-15 only, got ' || v_shots || ' rows, max ' || COALESCE(v_shot_max::TEXT, 'NULL');
  ASSERT v_diffs = 0, 'Test 1 FAILED: the round''s differentials should be NULL, ' || v_diffs || ' remain';

  -- Score keys after hole 15 are stripped; revision and totals are not
  -- touched (totals are client-owned; a revision bump would turn the ending
  -- device's next snapshot into a false conflict).
  SELECT ARRAY(SELECT k FROM jsonb_object_keys(scores) AS k ORDER BY k::INT), revision, total_gross
    INTO v_sc1_keys, v_sc1_revision, v_sc1_gross
    FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0007-000000000001';
  SELECT scores INTO v_sc2_scores FROM scorecards WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0007-000000000002';
  ASSERT v_sc1_keys = ARRAY['10', '11', '12', '13', '14', '15'],
    'Test 1 FAILED: SC1 should keep score keys 10-15 only, got ' || array_to_string(v_sc1_keys, ',');
  ASSERT v_sc1_revision = 1, 'Test 1 FAILED: revision must not be bumped, got ' || v_sc1_revision;
  ASSERT v_sc1_gross = 36, 'Test 1 FAILED: totals are client-owned and must not change, got ' || v_sc1_gross;
  ASSERT v_sc2_scores = '{}'::JSONB, 'Test 1 FAILED: a {} card should stay {}, got ' || v_sc2_scores::TEXT;

  -- The RPC turns the guard's flag back off after its UPDATE.
  ASSERT COALESCE(current_setting('app.ending_round', true), '') <> 'on',
    'Test 1 FAILED: app.ending_round should be off after end_round_early returns';
  RAISE NOTICE 'Test 1 PASSED: back-9 ended after 6 trims holes 16-18, strips their scores and nulls the differentials';
END $$;

  -- A7's handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards raises 22023

  );

END $$;

    FROM pg_proc
   WHERE proname IN ('get_activity_feed', 'get_round_feed_card')
     AND 'holes_played' = ANY (proargnames)
     AND 'nine_type' = ANY (proargnames);

  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'end_round_early';
  ASSERT v_count = 1, 'Test 12 FAILED: expected one end_round_early overload, got ' || v_count;
  ASSERT has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'end_round_early(uuid, integer)', 'EXECUTE'),
    'Test 12 FAILED: authenticated must be able to execute end_round_early';

  -- B1a-1 replaced A7's shared helper (not the triggers).
  ASSERT position('holes_played' IN pg_get_functiondef('public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(uuid, jsonb)'::regprocedure)) > 0,
    'Test 12 FAILED: scorecard_eligible_for_differential should check rounds.holes_played';
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
    FROM pg_trigger
   WHERE tgname IN ('scorecards_full_card_differential', 'handicap_combined_rounds_full_cards')
     AND NOT tgisinternal;
  ASSERT v_count = 2, 'Test 12 FAILED: expected A7''s two triggers, got ' || v_count;

  -- search_path pinned with pg_temp last on the definer RPC and the helper.
  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
    FROM pg_proc
   WHERE oid IN ('public.end_round_early(uuid, integer)'::regprocedure,
                 'public.scorecard_eligible_for_differential(uuid, jsonb)'::regprocedure)
     AND 'search_path=public, pg_temp' = ANY (proconfig);
  ASSERT v_count = 2, 'Test 12 FAILED: expected search_path=public, pg_temp on 2 functions, got ' || v_count;

  SELECT COUNT(*) INTO v_count
    FROM pg_trigger
   WHERE tgname = 'trigger_guard_rounds_holes_played'
     AND tgrelid = 'public.rounds'::regclass
     AND NOT tgisinternal;

  RAISE NOTICE 'Test 12 PASSED: catalog is as expected';
END $$;

-- =====================================================
-- TEST 13: holes_played is RPC-only, and nine_type is frozen once it is
--          set. Direct writes by the owner (RLS allows the row) and by a
--          superuser are refused with 42501; a nine_type change on a round
--          that wasn't ended still works (positive control).
-- =====================================================
SET LOCAL role authenticated;
SET LOCAL request.jwt.claims = '{"sub":"ee000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001","role":"authenticated"}';

DO $$
DECLARE
  v_case   TEXT;
  v_raised BOOLEAN;
BEGIN
  ASSERT COALESCE(current_setting('app.ending_round', true), '') <> 'on',
    'Test 13 FAILED: app.ending_round should be off before the guard checks';

  FOREACH v_case IN ARRAY ARRAY['set', 'change', 'clear', 'nine_type'] LOOP
    v_raised := FALSE;
    BEGIN
      IF v_case = 'set' THEN
        -- R2: full, in progress, never ended.
        UPDATE rounds SET holes_played = 5 WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000002';
      ELSIF v_case = 'change' THEN
        -- R1: back 9, ended after 6.
        UPDATE rounds SET holes_played = 7 WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001';
      ELSIF v_case = 'clear' THEN
        UPDATE rounds SET holes_played = NULL WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001';
      ELSE
        UPDATE rounds SET nine_type = 'front9' WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001';
      END IF;
    EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
      v_raised := TRUE;
    END;
    ASSERT v_raised, 'Test 13 FAILED: the owner''s direct write should raise 42501 (case ' || v_case || ')';
  END LOOP;

  -- Positive control: R2 was never ended, so its nine type can change.
  UPDATE rounds SET nine_type = 'front9' WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000002';
END $$;

RESET ROLE;

DO $$
DECLARE
  v_raised BOOLEAN := FALSE;
  v_r1     SMALLINT;
  v_r1nine TEXT;
  v_r2     SMALLINT;
  v_r2nine TEXT;
BEGIN
  -- No service-role exemption: without the flag even a superuser is refused.
  BEGIN
    UPDATE rounds SET holes_played = 3 WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000002';
  EXCEPTION WHEN insufficient_privilege THEN
    v_raised := TRUE;
  END;
  ASSERT v_raised, 'Test 13 FAILED: a superuser write without app.ending_round should raise 42501';

  SELECT holes_played, nine_type INTO v_r1, v_r1nine FROM rounds WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000001';
  SELECT holes_played, nine_type INTO v_r2, v_r2nine FROM rounds WHERE id = 'ee000000-0000-0000-0001-000000000002';
  ASSERT v_r1 = 6 AND v_r1nine = 'back9', 'Test 13 FAILED: R1 should still be back9 ended after 6';
  ASSERT v_r2 IS NULL AND v_r2nine = 'front9', 'Test 13 FAILED: R2 should be front9 (positive control) and not ended';
  RAISE NOTICE 'Test 13 PASSED: holes_played is RPC-only and nine_type is frozen once ended';
END $$;

DO $$
BEGIN
  RAISE NOTICE '============================================';
  RAISE NOTICE 'All end-round-early verification tests completed.';
  RAISE NOTICE 'Rolling back. No data will be persisted.';
  RAISE NOTICE '============================================';
END $$;

ROLLBACK;
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the B1a column and RPC; A5a's `fetchSkinsHoleCounts(roundId)` / `getSkinsHoleCounts(round)` (`getSkinsHoleCounts` already reads `holes_played`).
- Produces:
  - `Round.holes_played?: number | null`;
  - `SupabaseRoundData.holes_played?: number | null`; `ROUND_METADATA_SELECT` includes `holes_played`;
  - `RoundMetadata.holesPlayed: number | null`;
  - `ActivityFeedCard.holes_played?: number | null; nine_type?: NineType | null`;
  - `Database['public']['Functions']['end_round_early']` with `Args { p_round_id: string; p_holes_played: number }`, `Returns: undefined`. **This entry documents the shape only.** `createClient<Database>` (`src/services/supabase/client.ts:37`) resolves its schema to `never`, because the hand-written `Database` (`src/types/database/schema.ts`, `Row: Player` interfaces) doesn't satisfy supabase-js 2.80's `GenericSchema`: even the existing typed `supabase.rpc('get_player_scorer', {…})` fails type-check ("not assignable to parameter of type 'undefined'", result `PostgrestSingleResponse<never>`). So every `.rpc` call in the app is cast (`src/services/offline/sync/scorecardSync.ts:261` `(supabase.rpc as any)('write_scorecard_snapshot', …)`, `src/services/api/permissions.ts:29` `'…' as unknown as never`);
  - `fetchSkinsHoleCounts` selects `nine_type, holes_played`.
  - Consumers: B3c (init + mismatch guards read `metadata.data.holesPlayed`), B9a/B9d (round list, feed card), every skins settlement path (A5b/A6a), and B6b-1, which types its arguments from the entry and casts the call inline:
    ```ts
    type EndRoundEarlyArgs = Database['public']['Functions']['end_round_early']['Args'];
    const args: EndRoundEarlyArgs = { p_round_id: roundId, p_holes_played: holesPlayed };
    // createClient<Database> resolves rpc() to never (hand-written schema); the args stay typed above.
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    result = await (supabase.rpc as any)('end_round_early', args);
    ```
    Keep the cast inline: `(supabase.rpc as any)(…)` compiles to `supabase.rpc(…)` and keeps `this`; assigning `supabase.rpc` to a variable first loses it.

```tsx
/**

import { renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { useRoundMetadata } from '@/hooks/scorecard/useRoundMetadata';
import { ROUND_METADATA_SELECT } from '@/types/supabase/roundQueries';
import type { Database } from '@/types/database.types';

// Row returned by the `rounds` query; each test sets it.
let mockRoundRow: Record<string, unknown> = {};

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: {
    from: jest.fn((table: string) => {
      const chain: Record<string, jest.Mock> = {};
      chain.select = jest.fn(() => chain);
      chain.eq = jest.fn(() => chain);
      if (table === 'rounds') {
        chain.single = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ data: mockRoundRow, error: null }));
      } else {
        // round_players (standalone per-player tees): select → eq → not, awaited
        chain.not = jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve({ data: [], error: null }));
      }
      return chain;
    }),
  },
}));

jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => {
  const makeLogger = () => ({ info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() });
  return { roundDataLogger: makeLogger(), createModuleLogger: jest.fn(() => makeLogger()) };
});

// A standalone back-9 round with no course join (skips the tees query).
const BASE_ROW = {
  id: 'round-1',
  competition_id: null,
  status: 'in-progress',
  game_type: 'stroke',
  is_team_round: false,
  team_format: null,
  round_format: 'combined',
  scoring_pairs_required: false,
  ball_count: 1,
  handicap_source: 'profile',
  nine_type: 'back9',
  selected_tee: null,
  team_config: null,
  courses: null,
};

describe('useRoundMetadata — holes_played', () => {
  it('selects holes_played in the metadata query', () => {
    expect(ROUND_METADATA_SELECT).toMatch(/\bholes_played\b/);
  });

  it('maps holes_played to holesPlayed', async () => {
    mockRoundRow = { ...BASE_ROW, holes_played: 6 };

    const { result } = renderHook(() => useRoundMetadata('round-1'));
```

Create `src/__tests__/services/skins/fetchSkinsHoleCounts.holesPlayed.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * fetchSkinsHoleCounts — an ended-early round settles on the holes played.
 *
 * A5a reads only rounds.nine_type (the column didn't exist yet). Once B1a adds
 * rounds.holes_played, the fetch must select it too, or every settlement path
 * (finalizeSkinsGame, the queued finalise, useSkinsGameState's auto-finalise)
 * prices an ended-early round as if it had been played in full.
 *
 * @see src/services/skins/roundHoleCounts.ts
 */
import { fetchSkinsHoleCounts } from '@/services/skins/roundHoleCounts';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
}));

/**
 * Chainable builder; single() and maybeSingle() both resolve `row`, keeping
 * ONLY the columns named in select() — like PostgREST, so a fetch that
 * doesn't select holes_played never sees it.
 */
function mockRoundQuery(row: Record<string, unknown>) {
  let selected = '';
  const builder: Record<string, jest.Mock> = {};
  const resolve = () => {
    const columns = selected.split(',').map((c) => c.trim());
    const data = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(row).filter(([key]) => columns.includes(key)));
    return Promise.resolve({ data, error: null });
  };
  builder.select = jest.fn((columns: string) => {
    selected = columns;
    return builder;
  });
  builder.eq = jest.fn(() => builder);
  builder.single = jest.fn(resolve);
  builder.maybeSingle = jest.fn(resolve);
  mockFrom.mockReturnValue(builder);
  return builder;
}

describe('fetchSkinsHoleCounts — holes_played', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockFrom.mockReset();
  });

  it('selects holes_played alongside nine_type', async () => {
    const builder = mockRoundQuery({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: null });

    await fetchSkinsHoleCounts('r1');

    expect(mockFrom).toHaveBeenCalledWith('rounds');
    expect(builder.select).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const selected = String(builder.select.mock.calls[0][0]);
    expect(selected).toMatch(/\bnine_type\b/);
    expect(selected).toMatch(/\bholes_played\b/);
    expect(builder.eq).toHaveBeenCalledWith('id', 'r1');
  });

  it('settles an 18-hole round ended after 6 on 6 of 18 holes', async () => {
    mockRoundQuery({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: 6 });

    await expect(fetchSkinsHoleCounts('r1')).resolves.toEqual({ plannedHoles: 18, holesPlayed: 6 });
  });

  it('settles a back-9 round ended after 6 on 6 of 9 holes', async () => {
    mockRoundQuery({ nine_type: 'back9', holes_played: 6 });

    await expect(fetchSkinsHoleCounts('r1')).resolves.toEqual({ plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 6 });
  });

  it('keeps a round played as planned on its planned holes', async () => {
    mockRoundQuery({ nine_type: 'front9', holes_played: null });

    await expect(fetchSkinsHoleCounts('r1')).resolves.toEqual({ plannedHoles: 9, holesPlayed: 9 });
  });
});
```

Create `src/utils/holeTransformers.test.ts`:

```ts
import { filterHolesByNineType } from './holeTransformers';
import type { Hole } from '@/types';

const hole = (n: number): Hole => ({ number: n as Hole['number'], par: 4, strokeIndex: n });
const numbers = (holes: Hole[]) => holes.map((h) => h.number);

const EIGHTEEN: Hole[] = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => hole(i + 1));
// Scrambled order, as some course imports deliver holes.
const UNSORTED: Hole[] = [3, 1, 2, 12, 10, 11, 18, 9, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17].map(hole);

describe('filterHolesByNineType (characterization)', () => {
  it('returns the input array itself for full, without sorting', () => {
    expect(filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'full')).toBe(EIGHTEEN);
    expect(filterHolesByNineType(UNSORTED, 'full')).toBe(UNSORTED);
  });

  it('keeps holes 1–9 for front9, in input order', () => {
    expect(numbers(filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'front9'))).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9]);
    expect(numbers(filterHolesByNineType(UNSORTED, 'front9'))).toEqual([3, 1, 2, 9, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]);
  });

  it('keeps holes 10–18 for back9, in input order', () => {
    expect(numbers(filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'back9'))).toEqual([10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17, 18]);
    expect(numbers(filterHolesByNineType(UNSORTED, 'back9'))).toEqual([12, 10, 11, 18, 13, 14, 15, 16, 17]);
  });

  it('is idempotent', () => {
    const back = filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'back9');
    expect(filterHolesByNineType(back, 'back9')).toEqual(back);
    const front = filterHolesByNineType(EIGHTEEN, 'front9');
    expect(filterHolesByNineType(front, 'front9')).toEqual(front);
  });
});
```

```ts
import {
  resolveRoundShape,
  firstHoleNumber,
  lastPlayedHoleNumber,
  isHoleAfterEarlyEnd,
  isEndedEarly,
  formatEndedEarlyLabel,
} from './roundShape';

describe('resolveRoundShape', () => {
  it('uses the server row when there is no local value', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'back9', holes_played: 6 })).toEqual({ nineType: 'back9', holesPlayed: 6 });
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'front9', holes_played: null }, null)).toEqual({
      nineType: 'front9',
      holesPlayed: null,
    });
  });

  it('defaults to a full round played as planned when nothing is known', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape(null)).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
    expect(resolveRoundShape(undefined, undefined)).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
    expect(resolveRoundShape({}, {})).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
  });

  it('uses the local cards\' holesPlayed while the server has none (offline end not synced yet)', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: null }, { nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: 6 })).toEqual({
      nineType: 'full',
      holesPlayed: 6,
    });
  });

  it('the server holes_played wins over a different local value (another device ended first)', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: 6 }, { nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: 8 })).toEqual({
      nineType: 'full',
      holesPlayed: 6,
    });
  });

  it('takes the nine type from the server, then the local value, then full', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full' }, { nineType: 'back9' }).nineType).toBe('full');
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: null }, { nineType: 'front9' }).nineType).toBe('front9');
    expect(resolveRoundShape(null, { nineType: 'back9', holesPlayed: 6 })).toEqual({ nineType: 'back9', holesPlayed: 6 });
  });

  it('treats a non-positive holes_played on either side as not set', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: 0 })).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: 0 }, { holesPlayed: 5 })).toEqual({
      nineType: 'full',
      holesPlayed: 5,
    });
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full' }, { holesPlayed: -1 })).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
  });

  it('treats a non-integer holes_played as not set, like filterPlayableHoles', () => {
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: 2.5 })).toEqual({ nineType: 'full', holesPlayed: null });
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full', holes_played: 2.5 }, { holesPlayed: 4 })).toEqual({
      nineType: 'full',
      holesPlayed: 4,
    });
    expect(resolveRoundShape({ nine_type: 'full' }, { holesPlayed: Number.NaN })).toEqual({
      nineType: 'full',
      holesPlayed: null,
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

type Scores = Scorecard['scores'];

const hole = (n: number): Hole => ({ number: n as Hole['number'], par: 4, strokeIndex: n });
const range = (from: number, to: number) => Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => from + i);
const EIGHTEEN: Hole[] = range(1, 18).map(hole);

const SAM = { id: 'p-sam', name: 'Sam' };
const DAVE = { id: 'p-dave', name: 'Dave' };
const PLAYERS = [SAM, DAVE];

const strokesOn = (holeNumbers: number[], strokes = 4): Scores =>
  Object.fromEntries(holeNumbers.map((h) => [h, { strokes }]));

const plan = (byPlayer: Record<string, Scores>, nineType: NineType = 'full', holes: Hole[] = EIGHTEEN) =>
  planEndRoundEarly({
    holes,
    nineType,
    players: PLAYERS,
    scorecards: new Map(
      Object.entries(byPlayer).map(([id, scores]): [string, { scores: Scores }] => [id, { scores }])
    ),
  });

describe('isHoleScored', () => {
  it('is false for a missing or zero-stroke score', () => {
    expect(isHoleScored(null)).toBe(false);
    expect(isHoleScored(undefined)).toBe(false);
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 0 })).toBe(false);
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 0, didNotAttempt: true })).toBe(false);
  });

  it('is true for strokes > 0, including a pickup', () => {
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 4 })).toBe(true);
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 10 })).toBe(true);
    expect(isHoleScored({ strokes: 10, pickedUp: true })).toBe(true);
  });

  it('is true for a multi-ball score when any ball has strokes', () => {
    expect(isHoleScored({ balls: [{ strokes: 0 }, { strokes: 5 }] })).toBe(true);
    expect(isHoleScored({ balls: [{ strokes: 0 }] })).toBe(false);
    expect(isHoleScored({ balls: [] })).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe('planEndRoundEarly', () => {
  it('returns null when no hole is complete for every player', () => {
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 3)), [DAVE.id]: {} })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null when a player has no scorecard at all', () => {
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 3)) })).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns null when every planned hole is complete (that is a normal submit)', () => {
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 18)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 18)) })).toBeNull();
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 9)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 9)) }, 'front9')).toBeNull();
  });

  it('ends after the last hole every player has scored and drops a half-scored hole', () => {
    expect(plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 7)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)) })).toEqual({
      holesPlayed: 6,
      plannedHoles: 18,
      nineType: 'full',
      lastHoleNumber: 6,
      removedScores: [{ playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 7 }],
    });
  });

  it('stops at a skipped hole and removes every later score, hole by hole', () => {
    const both = strokesOn([...range(1, 5), 7, 8]);
    const result = plan({ [SAM.id]: both, [DAVE.id]: both });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(5);
    expect(result?.lastHoleNumber).toBe(5);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([
      { playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 7 },
      { playerId: DAVE.id, playerName: 'Dave', holeNumber: 7 },
      { playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 8 },
      { playerId: DAVE.id, playerName: 'Dave', holeNumber: 8 },
    ]);
  });

  it('does not count a did-not-attempt hole (strokes 0) as scored', () => {
    const result = plan({
      [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)),
      [DAVE.id]: { ...strokesOn(range(1, 3)), 4: { strokes: 0, didNotAttempt: true }, ...strokesOn([5, 6]) },
    });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(3);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([
      { playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 4 },
      { playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 5 },
      { playerId: DAVE.id, playerName: 'Dave', holeNumber: 5 },
      { playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 6 },
      { playerId: DAVE.id, playerName: 'Dave', holeNumber: 6 },
    ]);
  });

  it('counts a pickup on hole N as scored (Review Focus #4)', () => {
    const result = plan({
      [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)),
      [DAVE.id]: { ...strokesOn(range(1, 5)), 6: { strokes: 10 } },
    });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(6);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('removes a pickup alone on hole N+1 (Review Focus #4)', () => {
    const result = plan({
      [SAM.id]: { ...strokesOn(range(1, 6)), 7: { strokes: 10 } },
      [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)),
    });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(6);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([{ playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 7 }]);
  });

  it('numbers a back-9 round from hole 10 (Review Focus #2)', () => {
    const result = plan(
      { [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(10, 16)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(10, 15)) },
      'back9'
    );
    expect(result).toEqual({
      holesPlayed: 6,
      plannedHoles: 9,
      nineType: 'back9',
      lastHoleNumber: 15,
      removedScores: [{ playerId: SAM.id, playerName: 'Sam', holeNumber: 16 }],
    });
  });

  it('ignores front-nine scores on a back-9 round', () => {
    const result = plan(
      {
        [SAM.id]: { ...strokesOn(range(1, 9)), ...strokesOn(range(10, 12)) },
        [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(10, 12)),
      },
      'back9'
    );
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(3);
    expect(result?.lastHoleNumber).toBe(12);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('treats an 18-hole round ended after exactly 9 as an ordinary early end', () => {
    const result = plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 9)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 10)) });
    expect(result).toEqual({
      holesPlayed: 9,
      plannedHoles: 18,
      nineType: 'full',
      lastHoleNumber: 9,
      removedScores: [{ playerId: DAVE.id, playerName: 'Dave', holeNumber: 10 }],
    });
  });

  it('handles holes passed in any order', () => {
    const shuffled = [...EIGHTEEN].reverse();
    const result = plan({ [SAM.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 7)), [DAVE.id]: strokesOn(range(1, 6)) }, 'full', shuffled);
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(6);
    expect(result?.lastHoleNumber).toBe(6);
  });

  it('treats a multi-ball card as scored when any ball has strokes', () => {
    const result = planEndRoundEarly({
      holes: EIGHTEEN,
      nineType: 'full',
      players: [SAM],
      scorecards: new Map<string, { scores: Scores }>([
        [SAM.id, { scores: { 1: { balls: [{ strokes: 4 }, { strokes: 5 }] }, 2: { balls: [{ strokes: 0 }, { strokes: 4 }] } } }],
      ]),
    });
    expect(result?.holesPlayed).toBe(2);
    expect(result?.removedScores).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('returns null when there are no players or no planned holes', () => {
    expect(planEndRoundEarly({ holes: EIGHTEEN, nineType: 'full', players: [], scorecards: new Map() })).toBeNull();
    expect(planEndRoundEarly({ holes: [], nineType: 'full', players: PLAYERS, scorecards: new Map() })).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * The holes a round actually used: `filterHolesByNineType`, then, when the
 * round was ended early (`holesPlayed` is a positive integer), sorted by hole
 * number and cut to the first `holesPlayed`. A back-9 round ended after 6 →
 * holes 10–15.
 *
 * null / undefined / non-positive / non-integer ⇒ identical to
 * `filterHolesByNineType` (same array for 'full', no sort).
 *
 * Rendering, validation and "holes remaining" use this. Daily-handicap maths
 * must keep using the PLANNED holes (Σpar of the holes passed in) — see
 * docs/guides/SCORING_ARCHITECTURE.md.
 */
export function filterPlayableHoles(
  holes: Hole[],
  nineType: NineType,
  holesPlayed?: number | null
): Hole[] {
  const planned = filterHolesByNineType(holes, nineType);
  if (holesPlayed == null || !Number.isInteger(holesPlayed) || holesPlayed <= 0) {
    return planned;
  }
  return [...planned].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number).slice(0, holesPlayed);
}
```

Create `src/utils/roundShape.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Round shape — the planned nine type plus how many holes were actually played.
 *
 * A social round can be ended early (see docs/superpowers/specs/
 * 2026-10-07-end-round-early-design.md, Revision 3). The end is recorded in
 * two places:
 * - the server: `rounds.holes_played`, written by the `end_round_early` RPC at
 *   confirm time (or by the queued 'end_early' sync item when offline);
 * - this device: `holes_played` on the round's local SQLite scorecard rows,
 *   written by the store's `endRoundEarly(n)`.
 *
 * `resolveRoundShape` merges the two so an offline end that hasn't reached the
 * server yet isn't "corrected" back by the server row. Ending is final: there
 * is no way back to `holesPlayed = null` once either side has a value.
 */

import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { getHoleCount, getHoleRange } from '@/constants/scoring';

export interface RoundShape {
  nineType: NineType;
  holesPlayed: number | null;
}

/**
 * A positive integer holes-played count, or null ("played as planned").
 * Same rule as filterPlayableHoles, so a value it ignores (0, -3, 2.5, NaN)
 * never reads as "ended early" here either.
 */
function positiveOrNull(value: number | null | undefined): number | null {
  return value != null && Number.isInteger(value) && value > 0 ? value : null;
}

/**
 * - holesPlayed: the server's `holes_played` when set (the first end wins on
 *   the server, so a device that ended at a different N adopts it); otherwise
 *   the local value from the SQLite cards; otherwise null.
 * - nineType: server `nine_type` → local nine type → 'full'.
 * Non-positive or non-integer values on either side count as "not set".
 */
export function resolveRoundShape(
  server: { nine_type?: NineType | null; holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined,
  local?: { nineType?: NineType | null; holesPlayed?: number | null } | null
): RoundShape {
  return {
    nineType: server?.nine_type ?? local?.nineType ?? 'full',
    holesPlayed: positiveOrNull(server?.holes_played) ?? positiveOrNull(local?.holesPlayed),
  };
}

/** The round's first hole number: 10 for a back 9, otherwise 1. */
export function firstHoleNumber(nineType: NineType): number {
  return getHoleRange(nineType).start;
}

/** The hole number the round ended on: firstHoleNumber + N − 1 (back9 + 6 ⇒ 15). */
export function lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType: NineType, holesPlayed: number): number {
  return firstHoleNumber(nineType) + holesPlayed - 1;
}

/**
 * True when the round was ended early and `holeNumber` comes after its last
 * played hole. A hole BEFORE the round's first hole (hole 5 of a back 9) is
 * not "after the end": callers that must reject it check the planned hole
 * list as well (the store's closed-holes guard does).
 */
export function isHoleAfterEarlyEnd(
  nineType: NineType,
  holesPlayed: number | null | undefined,
  holeNumber: number
): boolean {
  const played = positiveOrNull(holesPlayed);
  if (played == null) return false;
  return holeNumber > lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, played);
}

/** True when the round row records an early end. */
export function isEndedEarly(round: { holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined): boolean {
  return positiveOrNull(round?.holes_played) != null;
}

/** "Ended after 6 of 9" — M is the planned hole count for the nine type. */
export function formatEndedEarlyLabel(holesPlayed: number, nineType: NineType): string {
  return `Ended after ${holesPlayed} of ${getHoleCount(nineType)}`;
}
```

Create `src/utils/endRoundEarly.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * End round early — planning.
 *
 * N is the number of leading holes (in hole order, from the round's first
 * hole) on which EVERY player has a score. A pickup (strokes = PICKUP_SCORE)
 * counts as scored. Scores after hole N are removed when the round is ended.
 * An 18-hole round ended after 9 is an ordinary early end (no conversion to a
 * front 9).
 *
 * Pure: the store (src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts) applies the plan, and the
 * confirmation sheet shows it.
 */

import type { Hole, Scorecard } from '@/types';
import type { HoleScore, MultiBallHoleScore } from '@/types/database/base';
import { isMultiBallScore } from '@/types/database/base';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { getHoleCount } from '@/constants/scoring';
import { filterHolesByNineType } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { lastPlayedHoleNumber } from '@/utils/roundShape';

export interface EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore {
  playerId: string;
  playerName: string;
  holeNumber: number;
}

export interface EndRoundEarlyPlan {
  holesPlayed: number; // N
  plannedHoles: number; // getHoleCount(nineType)
  nineType: NineType;
  lastHoleNumber: number; // lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, N)
  removedScores: EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore[];
}

/** strokes > 0 (any ball for multi-ball). A pickup (10) is scored; 0 / didNotAttempt is not. */
export function isHoleScored(score: HoleScore | MultiBallHoleScore | null | undefined): boolean {
  if (!score) return false;
  if (isMultiBallScore(score)) {
    return score.balls.some((ball) => (ball?.strokes ?? 0) > 0);
  }
  return (score.strokes ?? 0) > 0;
}

/** null when no hole is complete for every player, or when every planned hole is complete. */
export function planEndRoundEarly(input: {
  holes: Hole[]; // planned holes (store `holes`)
  nineType: NineType;
  players: { id: string; name: string }[];
  scorecards: Map<string, { scores: Scorecard['scores'] }>;
}): EndRoundEarlyPlan | null {
  const { holes, nineType, players, scorecards } = input;
  const plannedHoles = [...filterHolesByNineType(holes, nineType)].sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number);
  if (plannedHoles.length === 0 || players.length === 0) return null;

  const scoreFor = (playerId: string, holeNumber: number) => scorecards.get(playerId)?.scores[holeNumber];

  let holesPlayed = 0;
  for (const hole of plannedHoles) {
    const completeForEveryone = players.every((player) => isHoleScored(scoreFor(player.id, hole.number)));
    if (!completeForEveryone) break;
    holesPlayed += 1;
  }

  if (holesPlayed === 0 || holesPlayed >= plannedHoles.length) return null;

  const lastHoleNumber = lastPlayedHoleNumber(nineType, holesPlayed);
  const removedScores: EndRoundEarlyRemovedScore[] = [];
  for (const hole of plannedHoles) {
    if (hole.number <= lastHoleNumber) continue;
    for (const player of players) {
      if (isHoleScored(scoreFor(player.id, hole.number))) {
        removedScores.push({ playerId: player.id, playerName: player.name, holeNumber: hole.number });
      }
    }
  }

  return {
    holesPlayed,
    plannedHoles: getHoleCount(nineType),
    nineType,
    lastHoleNumber,
    removedScores,
  };
}
```

A score removed in memory comes back on the next load unless its row is deleted. On the server, `write_scorecard_snapshot` replaces `scores` wholesale, so the snapshot sync B3b-2 schedules carries the removal.

Keep it, and add directly after it:
```ts

/**
 * Delete given holes' scores from several scorecards in ONE transaction.
 *
 * Ending a round early removes every score after the last played hole from
 * every card of the round. `saveScorecard` only upserts hole rows and
 * `getScorecardsByRound` rebuilds `scores` from them, so a removed score must
 * be deleted here or it comes back on the next load. One transaction: either
 * every card loses its later holes or none does — never a half-ended round.
 * Rejects on failure so the caller can abort before changing any state.
 */
export async function deleteHoleScoresForCards(
  entries: { scorecardId: string; holeNumbers: number[] }[]
): Promise<void> {
  const work = entries.filter((entry) => entry.holeNumbers.length > 0);
  if (work.length === 0) return;

  const database = await getDb();
  await database.withTransactionAsync(async () => {
    for (const { scorecardId, holeNumbers } of work) {
      const placeholders = holeNumbers.map(() => '?').join(', ');
      await database.runAsync(
        `DELETE FROM ${TABLE_NAMES.HOLE_SCORES} WHERE scorecard_id = ? AND hole_number IN (${placeholders})`,
        [scorecardId, ...holeNumbers]
      );
    }
  });
}
```

```ts
// UUID v4 ids: loadFromOffline rejects non-UUID cached data.
const ROUND_ID = '123e4567-e89b-42d3-a456-426614174000';
const P1: Player = createTestPlayer({ id: '11111111-1111-4111-a111-111111111111', name: 'Sam', handicap: 0 });
const P2: Player = createTestPlayer({ id: '22222222-2222-4222-a222-222222222222', name: 'Dave', handicap: 0 });

const getStore = () => useScorecardStore.getState();
const range = (from: number, to: number) => Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => from + i);

async function score(playerId: string, holeNumbers: number[], strokes = 4): Promise<void> {
  for (const holeNumber of holeNumbers) {
    await getStore().setPlayerScore(playerId, holeNumber, strokes);
  }
}

// The payload `syncScorecard` received for a player at submit.
const submittedPayload = (playerId: string): Scorecard => {
  const call = (syncScorecard as jest.Mock).mock.calls.find(
    (args) => (args[0] as Scorecard).playerId === playerId
  );
  if (!call) throw new Error(`no submit payload for ${playerId}`);
  return call[0] as Scorecard;
};

beforeEach(() => {
  getStore().resetRound();
  supabaseMock.__resetRoundsResult();
  jest.clearAllMocks();
  (getHoles as jest.Mock).mockReset().mockResolvedValue([]);
  (getScorecardsByRound as jest.Mock).mockReset().mockResolvedValue([]);
  (deleteHoleScoresForCards as jest.Mock).mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined);
});

describe('characterization (pre end-round-early)', () => {
  it('submitScorecards stamps the planned coursePar 72, 18 syncHoles, syncNineType full and no holesPlayed', async () => {
    await getStore().initializeRound(ROUND_ID, [P1, P2], create18Holes());
    await score(P1.id, [1]);
    await score(P2.id, [1]);

    await getStore().submitScorecards();

    const payload = submittedPayload(P1.id);
    expect(payload.coursePar).toBe(72);
    expect(payload.syncHoles).toHaveLength(18);
    expect(payload.syncNineType).toBe('full');
    expect(payload).not.toHaveProperty('holesPlayed');
  });

  it('submitScorecards stamps coursePar 36 and 9 syncHoles for a front-9 round', async () => {
    await getStore().initializeRound(ROUND_ID, [P1, P2], create18Holes(), 'stableford', false, [], null, 'profile', new Map(), 'front9');
    await score(P1.id, [1]);

    await getStore().submitScorecards();

    const payload = submittedPayload(P1.id);
    expect(payload.coursePar).toBe(36);
    expect(payload.syncHoles).toHaveLength(9);
    expect(payload.syncNineType).toBe('front9');
  });
});
```

### Task B3b-2: `endRoundEarly(n)`: atomic removal, stamping, totals, syncs

**Files:**
- Create: `src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts`
- Modify: `src/store/scorecardStore.ts` (as B3b-1 leaves it): imports (the `initSlice` line), the interface (after `getPlayedHoles`), and the actions (after the `getPlayedHoles` getter)
- Test: `src/__tests__/store/scorecardStore.endRoundEarly.test.ts` (extend)
- Test: `src/__tests__/store/endRoundEarlySlice.test.ts` (new: `scoresEveryPlayer`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `filterPlayableHoles` (B2), `lastPlayedHoleNumber` (B2, `@/utils/roundShape`);
  - `deleteHoleScoresForCards`, `Scorecard.holesPlayed` (B3a);
  - store `holesPlayed` / `getPlayedHoles` (B3b-1);
  - `calculatePlayerTotals` (`src/store/utils/scorecardCalculations.ts:46`, already takes `nineType` on `main`);
  - `persistScorecardUpdate` (`src/store/scorecardPersistence.ts:40`), `debouncedQueueScorecardSync` (`src/store/scorecardSyncDebounce.ts:41`).
- Produces (contract):
  - `endRoundEarly: (n: number) => Promise<void>` on the store, and `endRoundEarly(get, set, n)` in `src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts` (B3c-1 adds an options argument and reconcile);
  - `export function scoresEveryPlayer(state: { allowedPlayerIds: readonly string[]; currentPlayers: readonly { id: string }[]; groupScorecards: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown> }): boolean` from `@/store/endRoundEarlySlice`. B6c's gate calls it with the store's fields, so the button and the store refuse on the same rule;
  - `export class EndRoundEarlyRoundChangedError extends Error` (`name = 'EndRoundEarlyRoundChangedError'`, `roundId`), thrown when the store's `currentRoundId` changed while the SQLite delete ran.

  Consumed by B6c (confirm, conflict adoption, the gate) and B3c-1 (reconcile).

**`endRoundEarly(n)`, in order:**
1. Validate: a round id; `n` an integer with 1 ≤ n < `holes.length` (planned); the device scores every player (Global Constraints). Throws and changes nothing otherwise.
2. No-op when already ended at `n`, nothing is left outside the played holes, and every card already says `holesPlayed: n` (idempotent).
3. **SQLite first:** one `deleteHoleScoresForCards` call for every card's keys outside `filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, n)`. A rejection propagates with nothing changed. After the `await`, if `get().currentRoundId` is no longer the round being ended (the store was reset or re-initialised for another round meanwhile), throw `EndRoundEarlyRoundChangedError` and change no state. The rows already deleted were later holes of the round being ended, which the caller was about to drop anyway.
4. Rebuild every card: keep only played-hole keys, set `holesPlayed: n`, set `teeData` to the player's tee (`playerTeeMap.get(id) ?? selectedTeeData`, the same as `getPlayerTee`), and recompute totals over the **planned** `holes` (the DHC stays the planned round's, R1). Then `set` the cards, `holesPlayed: n`, and `currentHole` clamped to the played holes.
5. Persist every card with `persistScorecardUpdate`, which logs and doesn't throw, as every store write does. Schedule `debouncedQueueScorecardSync` for each non-standalone card; `write_scorecard_snapshot` replaces `scores` wholesale, so the removals reach the server.

The store never touches the network. B6c calls the RPC (online) or queues `'end_early'` (offline) around this action.

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

Create `src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts`:
```ts
/**
 * endRoundEarlySlice - "End round early" for scorecardStore.
 *
 * The store keeps the PLANNED holes: every daily-handicap calculation derives
 * par from the holes passed in (docs/guides/SCORING_ARCHITECTURE.md), so
 * cutting `holes` to the played holes would inflate the DHC. Ending early
 * records `holesPlayed`; anything that renders, validates or counts holes
 * remaining slices via getPlayedHoles().
 *
 * Ending is final (R12). The end is stamped onto every card (holesPlayed +
 * the player's tee) and persisted to SQLite, so a relaunch keeps it (R15).
 * The server learns of it from B6c (end_round_early RPC, or a queued
 * 'end_early' round item) — this slice never touches the network.
 */

import type { Scorecard, Player, Hole, GameType, TeeBox } from '@/types';
import type { HandicapSource } from '@/types/database';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import { deleteHoleScoresForCards } from '@/services/offline/database';
import { storeLogger } from '@/utils/debugLogger';
import { filterPlayableHoles } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { lastPlayedHoleNumber } from '@/utils/roundShape';
import { persistScorecardUpdate } from './scorecardPersistence';
import { debouncedQueueScorecardSync } from './scorecardSyncDebounce';
import { calculatePlayerTotals } from './utils/scorecardCalculations';

interface StoreState {
  currentRoundId: string | null;
  currentPlayers: Player[];
  currentHole: number;
  holes: Hole[];
  nineType: NineType;
  holesPlayed: number | null;
  gameType: GameType;
  handicapSource: HandicapSource;
  selectedTeeData: TeeBox | null;
  playerTeeMap: Map<string, TeeBox>;
  groupScorecards: Map<string, Scorecard>;
  allowedPlayerIds: string[];
}

type GetFn = () => StoreState;
type SetFn = (
  partial: Partial<Pick<StoreState, 'holesPlayed' | 'groupScorecards' | 'currentHole'>>
) => void;

/**
 * Thrown when the store was reset or re-initialised for another round while
 * the SQLite delete ran. No store state changed. The rows already deleted
 * were later holes of the round being ended.
 */
export class EndRoundEarlyRoundChangedError extends Error {
  constructor(readonly roundId: string) {
    super(`Round ${roundId} was unloaded while it was being ended early`);
    this.name = 'EndRoundEarlyRoundChangedError';
  }
}

/**
 * Whether this device scores every player (Global Constraints, "Who can
 * end"). ScorecardEntryScreen always fills allowedPlayerIds, so "non-empty"
 * alone is not a refusal: it must cover every current player and every card.
 * Exported so useEndRoundEarly's gate (B6c) applies the same rule.
 */
export function scoresEveryPlayer(state: {
  allowedPlayerIds: readonly string[];
  currentPlayers: readonly { id: string }[];
  groupScorecards: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown>;
}): boolean {
  if (state.allowedPlayerIds.length === 0) return true;
  const allowed = new Set(state.allowedPlayerIds);
  return (
    state.currentPlayers.every((player) => allowed.has(player.id)) &&
    [...state.groupScorecards.keys()].every((playerId) => allowed.has(playerId))
  );
}

/** Score keys on `scorecard` that are not played holes, ascending. */
function keysOutside(scorecard: Scorecard, played: Set<number>): number[] {
  return Object.keys(scorecard.scores)
    .map(Number)
    .filter((holeNumber) => !played.has(holeNumber))
    .sort((a, b) => a - b);
}

/**
 * End the round after `n` holes. Idempotent. Order: one SQLite delete for
 * every card, then rebuild and stamp the cards, then persist and sync.
 * Throws (changing no store state) when `n` is out of range, the device
 * doesn't score every player, the SQLite delete fails, or the round was
 * unloaded during the delete (EndRoundEarlyRoundChangedError).
 */
export async function endRoundEarly(get: GetFn, set: SetFn, n: number): Promise<void> {
  const state = get();
  const { currentRoundId, holes, nineType } = state;

  if (!currentRoundId) {
    throw new Error('No round ID set');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(n) || n < 1 || n >= holes.length) {
    throw new Error(`Invalid holes played: ${n} (the round has ${holes.length} planned holes)`);
  }
  if (!scoresEveryPlayer(state)) {
    throw new Error('A round can only be ended early from a device that scores every player');
  }

  const played = new Set(filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, n).map((hole) => hole.number));
  const removals = [...state.groupScorecards.values()]
    .map((scorecard) => ({ scorecardId: scorecard.id, holeNumbers: keysOutside(scorecard, played) }))
    .filter((entry) => entry.holeNumbers.length > 0);
  const allStamped = [...state.groupScorecards.values()].every((scorecard) => scorecard.holesPlayed === n);
  if (state.holesPlayed === n && removals.length === 0 && allStamped) return;

  storeLogger.info('Ending round early', {
    roundId: currentRoundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
    holesPlayed: n,
    removedCardCount: removals.length,
  });

  // 1. SQLite first, every card in one transaction. A failure throws here,
  //    before any state changes (no half-ended round).
  if (removals.length > 0) {
    await deleteHoleScoresForCards(removals);
  }

  // 2. Re-read state after the await and rebuild every card. A score written
  //    after N while the delete ran is dropped here; its SQLite row (if any)
  //    is caught by the next load's reconcile.
  const current = get();
  if (current.currentRoundId !== currentRoundId) {
    // Reset or re-initialised for another round mid-end: never stamp this
    // round's end onto whatever the store holds now.
    throw new EndRoundEarlyRoundChangedError(currentRoundId);
  }
  const now = new Date();
  const nextScorecards = new Map<string, Scorecard>();
  for (const [playerId, scorecard] of current.groupScorecards) {
    const scores: Scorecard['scores'] = {};
    for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(scorecard.scores)) {
      const holeNumber = Number(key);
      if (played.has(holeNumber)) scores[holeNumber] = value;
    }
    const teeData = current.playerTeeMap.get(playerId) ?? current.selectedTeeData;
    const updated: Scorecard = { ...scorecard, scores, holesPlayed: n, teeData, updatedAt: now };
    // Totals over the PLANNED holes: unscored holes are skipped, and the
    // daily handicap stays the planned round's (R1).
    const totals = calculatePlayerTotals(updated, current.holes, current.gameType, {
      selectedTee: teeData,
      handicapSource: current.handicapSource,
      nineType: current.nineType,
    });
    updated.totalGross = totals.gross;
    updated.totalNet = totals.net;
    updated.total_par_score = totals.parScore;
    nextScorecards.set(playerId, updated);
  }

  set({
    groupScorecards: nextScorecards,
    holesPlayed: n,
    currentHole: played.has(current.currentHole)
      ? current.currentHole
      : lastPlayedHoleNumber(current.nineType, n),
  });

  // 3. Persist every card (the SQLite marker + tee) and schedule a snapshot
  //    sync: write_scorecard_snapshot replaces `scores` wholesale, so the
  //    removals reach the server.
  for (const [playerId, scorecard] of nextScorecards) {
    await persistScorecardUpdate({
      scorecard: { scorecardId: scorecard.id, scorecard },
      context: 'endRoundEarly',
    });
    if (!scorecard.isStandalone) {
      debouncedQueueScorecardSync(scorecard.id, () => get().groupScorecards.get(playerId));
    }
  }
}
```

### Task B3c-1: Store init paths resolve the round shape and reconcile

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/store/initializeRoundSlice.ts`:
  - imports `18-19`;
  - a new helper before `initializeRound` (line `83`);
  - `initializeRound` params and filter `95-102`, card creation `131-143`, and its final `set` (as B3b-1 leaves it);
  - `loadFromOffline` `352-356`, `373-374`, `389-392`, `443-449` and its final `set` (as B3b-1 leaves it).

- Modify: `src/store/scorecardStore.ts:90-92` (interface) and `:211-220` (init wrappers reconcile)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `resolveRoundShape`, `filterPlayableHoles` (B2);
  - `Scorecard.holesPlayed` (B3a);
  - store `holesPlayed` (B3b-1);
  - `endRoundEarlySlice.endRoundEarly` (B3b-2);
  - the `rounds.holes_played` column (B1a).
- Produces (contract):
  - `initializeRound(…, nineType?, startHole?, holesPlayed?: number | null)`;
  - both init paths resolve the shape with `resolveRoundShape(serverRow, { nineType, holesPlayed: max(cards' holesPlayed) })`, then reconcile: `endRoundEarly(N, { reconcile: true })` runs when a card holds a score after N or its marker isn't N (Appendix A, Store end-early note 4). Reconcile schedules a snapshot sync only for a card that lost scores; a re-stamp-only card is persisted locally;
  - `needsEndRoundEarlyReconcile(state): boolean` and `reconcileEndedEarly(get, set): Promise<void>` (`src/store/endRoundEarlySlice.ts`).

  Consumed by B3c-2 (the hooks pass `holesPlayed`), B6c and B6d (the round reopens ended).

**Why scores can't come back after N:**
- `saveScorecard` upserts only the kept keys, and B3b-2 deletes the later `hole_scores` rows in SQLite.
- `hydrateFromSupabase` (`useRoundData.ts:593-602`, `useMatchPlayData.ts:363-368`) merges only into cards with **no** local scores, and B3c-2 makes both merges skip keys after an early end.
- The snapshot RPC replaces `scores` wholesale.

That closes the fresh-device window: a second phone opening the round before the ending device's trimmed snapshot syncs (2 s debounce) gets `holes_played` from the server and drops the later keys at merge time.

```ts
  // Reconcile syncs only the cards that lost scores (`removals`; in reconcile
  // mode holesPlayed is already set, so the guard blocks new writes after N
  // during the delete). A re-stamp alone stays local.
  const cardsThatLostScores = new Set(removals.map((entry) => entry.scorecardId));
  for (const [playerId, scorecard] of nextScorecards) {
    await persistScorecardUpdate({
      scorecard: { scorecardId: scorecard.id, scorecard },
      context: options.reconcile ? 'endRoundEarly:reconcile' : 'endRoundEarly',
    });
    const shouldSync = !options.reconcile || cardsThatLostScores.has(scorecard.id);
    if (!scorecard.isStandalone && shouldSync) {
      debouncedQueueScorecardSync(scorecard.id, () => get().groupScorecards.get(playerId));
    }
  }
}

/**
 * True when the store says the round is ended but a card disagrees: it holds
 * a score outside the played holes, or its SQLite marker isn't N.
 */
export function needsEndRoundEarlyReconcile(state: StoreState): boolean {
  const n = state.holesPlayed;
  if (n == null) return false;
  const played = new Set(filterPlayableHoles(state.holes, state.nineType, n).map((hole) => hole.number));
  return [...state.groupScorecards.values()].some(
    (scorecard) => scorecard.holesPlayed !== n || keysOutside(scorecard, played).length > 0
  );
}

/**
 * Init reconcile (R14/R16), run after initializeRound / loadFromOffline set
 * the resolved holesPlayed: bring every card in line with it — another device
 * ended first, the server's N won over ours, or the RPC landed before the
 * local save. Logged, never thrown: a failed reconcile must not fail the load
 * (the closed-holes guard still applies; the next load retries).
 */
export async function reconcileEndedEarly(get: GetFn, set: SetFn): Promise<void> {
  const state = get();
  const n = state.holesPlayed;
  if (n == null || !needsEndRoundEarlyReconcile(state)) return;

  try {
    await endRoundEarly(get, set, n, { reconcile: true });
    storeLogger.info('Reconciled a round ended early', {
      roundId: state.currentRoundId?.substring(0, 8) + '...',
      holesPlayed: n,
    });
  } catch (error) {
    storeLogger.error('Failed to reconcile a round ended early', error, {
      roundId: state.currentRoundId?.substring(0, 8) + '...',
      holesPlayed: n,
    });
  }
}
```

```ts
/**
 * The end-early marker this device stamped on its SQLite cards (R15): the
 * largest holesPlayed any card carries, else null.
 */
function localHolesPlayedFromCards(cards: Scorecard[]): number | null {
  let max: number | null = null;
  for (const card of cards) {
    const n = card.holesPlayed;
    if (typeof n === 'number' && n > 0 && (max === null || n > max)) max = n;
  }
  return max;
}
```
