```ts
    expect(applyEndRoundEarly).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(database.markPendingSyncFailed).toHaveBeenCalledWith(21, 1, expect.stringContaining('Malformed'));
    expect(database.incrementSyncRetryCount).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('keeps a network failure pending without spending a retry, even on its last retry', async () => {
    // retryCount 2 = one below MAX_RETRY_COUNT: the normal path would retain it.
    (database.getPendingSyncs as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([createEndEarlySync({ retryCount: 2 })]);
    (applyEndRoundEarly as jest.Mock).mockRejectedValue(new EndRoundEarlyError('network', 'offline'));

    await syncAll();

    expect(database.incrementSyncRetryCount).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(database.markPendingSyncFailed).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(database.removePendingSync).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("runs before the same round's 'finalize' item, whatever their timestamps", async () => {
    // getPendingSyncs returns timestamp order: the finalize item first.
    (database.getPendingSyncs as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([
      createFinalizeSync(),
      createEndEarlySync({ timestamp: new Date('2025-01-15T10:00:00Z') }),
    ]);

    await syncAll();

    const [endEarly] = (applyEndRoundEarly as jest.Mock).mock.invocationCallOrder;
    const [finalize] = (finalizeSubmittedRound as jest.Mock).mock.invocationCallOrder;
    expect(endEarly).toBeLessThan(finalize);
    expect(database.removePendingSync).toHaveBeenCalledWith(21, 1);
    expect(database.removePendingSync).toHaveBeenCalledWith(7, 1);
  });

  describe("a retained 'end_early' row", () => {
    it("retains the round's 'finalize' item as failed too, without finalising", async () => {
      (database.getPendingSyncs as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([createFinalizeSync()]);
      (database.getFailedSyncs as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([
        createEndEarlySync({ status: 'failed', lastError: 'server said invalid' }),
      ]);

      await expect(syncAll()).resolves.toBe(false);

      expect(finalizeSubmittedRound).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
      expect(database.markPendingSyncFailed).toHaveBeenCalledWith(

        1,
        expect.stringContaining('end-round-early')
      );
      expect(database.incrementSyncRetryCount).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    it('fails both in the same drain when the server refuses the end', async () => {
      (database.getPendingSyncs as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([createFinalizeSync(), createEndEarlySync()]);
      (applyEndRoundEarly as jest.Mock).mockRejectedValue(
        new EndRoundEarlyError('invalid', 'server said invalid')
      );
      // The SQLite row is failed once markPendingSyncFailed(21, …) has run.
      (database.getFailedSyncs as jest.Mock).mockImplementation(async () =>
        (database.markPendingSyncFailed as jest.Mock).mock.calls.some(([id]) => id === 21)
          ? [createEndEarlySync({ status: 'failed' })]
          : []
      );

      await syncAll();

      expect(database.markPendingSyncFailed).toHaveBeenCalledWith(21, 1, 'server said invalid');
      expect(database.markPendingSyncFailed).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        7,
        1,
        expect.stringContaining('end-round-early')
      );
      expect(finalizeSubmittedRound).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("does not block another round's finalize", async () => {
      (database.getPendingSyncs as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([createFinalizeSync()]);
      (database.getFailedSyncs as jest.Mock).mockResolvedValue([
        createEndEarlySync({

          data: { id: 'other-round', action: 'end_early', holesPlayed: 6 },
          entityKey: 'round:other-round:end_early',
        }),
      ]);

      await syncAll();

      expect(finalizeSubmittedRound).toHaveBeenCalledWith(ROUND_ID);
      expect(database.removePendingSync).toHaveBeenCalledWith(7, 1);
    });
  });
});
```

Add these functions directly after `processRoundSync`'s closing `}`:

```ts
/**
 * Run a queued "end round early" item (queueRoundEndEarly): the
 * end_round_early RPC the scorer couldn't reach at confirm time.
 *
 * - Done (item removed): applied — also a same-N retry, the RPC is
 *   idempotent; 'conflict' — the server already holds another N, adopted
 *   into the open round now or by the next load's init reconcile;
 *   'not_found' — the round was deleted.
 * - Retained without retries (RoundSyncPermanentError): 'forbidden' /
 *   'invalid' (incl. 22023 round_completed), or a malformed item.
 * - Left pending without spending a retry (RoundSyncDeferredError): 'network'.
 *
 * Unlike 'finalize' it does not wait for this device's scorecards: the RPC
 * doesn't depend on them, and the sooner the server holds holes_played the
 * sooner other devices stop scoring holes after N.
 */
async function processRoundEndEarlySync(roundId: string, holesPlayed: unknown): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof holesPlayed !== 'number' || !Number.isInteger(holesPlayed) || holesPlayed <= 0) {
    throw new RoundSyncPermanentError(
      `Malformed end_early round item for ${roundId.substring(0, 8)}: holesPlayed ${String(holesPlayed)}`
    );
  }

  try {
    await applyEndRoundEarly(roundId, holesPlayed);
  } catch (error) {
    if (!(error instanceof EndRoundEarlyError)) throw error;

    switch (error.code) {
      case 'conflict':
        syncLogger.info('Queued end-round-early superseded by the server; adopting its N', {
          roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
          holesPlayed,
          serverHolesPlayed: error.serverHolesPlayed,
        });
        await adoptServerHolesPlayed(roundId, error.serverHolesPlayed);
        invalidateRoundShapeQueries(roundId);
        return;
      case 'not_found':
        syncLogger.info('Queued end-round-early: the round no longer exists; dropping it', {
          roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
        });
        return;
      case 'forbidden':
      case 'invalid':
        // The server will never accept this early end: retain it for the
        // user (Retained Uploads) without burning retries.
        throw new RoundSyncPermanentError(error.message);
      case 'network':
        // Idempotent: try again on the next drain, without spending a retry.
        throw new RoundSyncDeferredError(error.message);
      default:
        throw error;
    }
  }

  invalidateRoundShapeQueries(roundId);
}

/**
 * After a queued end conflicted: bring the open round in line with the
 * server's N. Only when this round is the one loaded in the scoring store —
 * any other round adopts it on its next load (B3c-1's init reconcile reads
 * rounds.holes_played). Never throws: the item is done either way.
 */
async function adoptServerHolesPlayed(
  roundId: string,
  serverHolesPlayed: number | null | undefined
): Promise<void> {
  if (typeof serverHolesPlayed !== 'number') return;

  try {
    // Lazy: the store imports the sync barrel (scorecardPersistence), so a
    // static import here would be circular.
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires, @typescript-eslint/no-require-imports -- circular import
    const { useScorecardStore } = require('@/store/scorecardStore') as typeof import('@/store/scorecardStore');
    const store = useScorecardStore.getState();
    if (store.currentRoundId !== roundId) return;
    // The store action has no reconcile option; this device queued the end,
    // so it passed the "scores every player" check when it did.
    await store.endRoundEarly(serverHolesPlayed);
  } catch (error) {
    syncLogger.warn("Could not adopt the server's holes played in the open round; the next load will", {
      roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...',
      serverHolesPlayed,
      error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
    });
  }
}

/**
 * The React Query caches that show a round's shape (as useEndRoundEarly
 * invalidates online). ScorecardEntryScreen's round-shape guard reads
 * useRoundMetadata (component state, not React Query), so this does not
 * refresh it: an open round adopts the server's N via adoptServerHolesPlayed
 * above, any other round on its next load.
 */
function invalidateRoundShapeQueries(roundId: string): void {
  void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: skinsKeys.holeCounts(roundId) });
  void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: roundKeys.detail(roundId) });
}
```

```ts
      scores,
      totalGross: 0,
      totalNet: 0,
      status,
      createdAt: new Date('2026-10-07T00:00:00Z'),
      updatedAt: new Date('2026-10-07T00:00:00Z'),

  return new Map([

  mockedFetchHolesPlayed.mockResolvedValue(null);
  mockStore();
});

describe('useEndRoundEarly — who can end', () => {
  it('offers the action on a standalone round with a complete hole and holes left to play', () => {
    const { result } = renderOpened();

    expect(result.current.canEndRoundEarly).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.isEnded).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.visible).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.plan).toEqual({
      holesPlayed: 6,
      plannedHoles: 18,
      nineType: 'full',
      lastHoleNumber: 6,
      removedScores: [],
    });
  });

  it('still offers it when the scoring scope lists every player', () => {
    // ScorecardEntryScreen always mirrors its on-screen players into allowedPlayerIds.
    mockStore({ allowedPlayerIds: ['p1', 'p2'] });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, onEnded: jest.fn() }));

    expect(result.current.canEndRoundEarly).toBe(true);
  });

  const hiddenCases: [string, Partial<UseEndRoundEarlyArgs>, Record<string, unknown>][] = [
    ['a competition round', { isStandalone: false }, {}],
    ['a round using scoring pairs', { scoringPairsEnabled: true }, {}],
    ['a device that scores only part of the round', {}, { allowedPlayerIds: ['p1'] }],
    [
      // The store's rule also checks the cards: a card outside the scope means
      // endRoundEarly(n) would refuse, so the action must not be offered.
      'a device holding a card outside its scoring scope',
      {},
      {
        allowedPlayerIds: ['p1', 'p2'],
        groupScorecards: new Map([
          ...cards(6),
          ['p3', { ...(cards(6).get('p1') as Scorecard), id: 'sc-p3', playerId: 'p3' }],
        ]),
      },
    ],
    ['a round already ended (holesPlayed set)', {}, { holesPlayed: 6 }],
    ['a round with a submitted card', {}, { groupScorecards: cards(6, 'completed') }],
    ['a round with no hole complete for every player', {}, { groupScorecards: cards(0) }],
    ['a round with every planned hole complete', {}, { groupScorecards: cards(18) }],
    ['a store still holding another round', {}, { currentRoundId: 'round-2' }],
  ];

  it.each(hiddenCases)('hides the action for %s', (_label, args, store) => {
    mockStore(store);
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, ...args, onEnded: jest.fn() })
    );

    expect(result.current.canEndRoundEarly).toBe(false);
    act(() => result.current.open());
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.visible).toBe(false);
  });

  it('reports isEnded once the store has holesPlayed for this round', () => {
    mockStore({ holesPlayed: 6 });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useEndRoundEarly({ ...baseArgs, onEnded: jest.fn() }));

    expect(result.current.isEnded).toBe(true);
  });
});

describe('useEndRoundEarly — result preview', () => {
  it('previews the net leader over the holes played', () => {
    const { result } = renderOpened();

    // handicapSource 'none' ⇒ net = gross: Alice 23, Bob 29.
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.resultPreview).toBe('Alice leads on net 23');
  });

  it('shows no preview for team stroke formats', () => {

    expect(result.current.sheetProps.resultPreview).toBeNull();
  });

  it('shows no preview for multi-ball rounds', () => {
    mockStore({ isMultiBall: true });

    expect(result.current.sheetProps.resultPreview).toBeNull();
  });

  it("previews the match result from the screen's match context", () => {
    const won = (winner: HoleResult['winner']): HoleResult => ({
      player1Score: 4,
      player2Score: 4,
      player1PickedUp: false,
      player2PickedUp: false,
      winner,
    });
    const getMatchContext = (): EndEarlyMatchContext => ({
      kind: 'singles',
      names: ['Alice', 'Bob'],
      holeResults: {
        1: won('player1'), 2: won('player1'), 3: won('halved'),
        4: won('halved'), 5: won('halved'), 6: won('halved'),
      },
    });
    const { result } = renderOpened({ gameType: 'match-play', getMatchContext });

    expect(result.current.sheetProps.resultPreview).toBe('Alice wins 2 UP');
  });

  it("measures the match against the round's own holes (9-hole course, nine_type 'full')", () => {
    // Holes 1–9 only, nine_type 'full': getHoleCount('full') would say 18, but
    // the match views use the 9 holes. Alice wins 1–5, hole 6 halved: after
    // hole 5 she is 5 up with 4 of 9 left ⇒ closed out "5&4". Against 18 it
    // would be "5 UP" (13 left, no close-out).
    mockStore({ holes: holes.slice(0, 9) });
    const won = (winner: HoleResult['winner']): HoleResult => ({
      player1Score: 4,
      player2Score: 4,
      player1PickedUp: false,
      player2PickedUp: false,
      winner,
    });
    const getMatchContext = (): EndEarlyMatchContext => ({
      kind: 'singles',
      names: ['Alice', 'Bob'],
      holeResults: {
        1: won('player1'), 2: won('player1'), 3: won('player1'),
        4: won('player1'), 5: won('player1'), 6: won('halved'),
      },
    });
    const { result } = renderOpened({ gameType: 'match-play', getMatchContext });

    expect(result.current.sheetProps.plan?.holesPlayed).toBe(6);
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.resultPreview).toBe('Alice wins 5&4');
  });
});

describe('useEndRoundEarly — confirm', () => {
  it('online: runs the RPC first, then ends locally, then hands N to the screen', async () => {
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6));
    expect(mockedApply).toHaveBeenCalledWith('round-1', 6);
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6);
    expect(mockedApply.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]).toBeLessThan(
      mockEndRoundEarly.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]
    );
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]).toBeLessThan(
      onEnded.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]
    );
    expect(mockedQueue).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.sheetProps.loading).toBe(false));
  });

  it('online success refreshes the skins hole counts and the round detail', async () => {
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6));
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      queryKey: ['skins', 'hole-counts', 'round-1'],
    });
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ queryKey: ['rounds', 'detail', 'round-1'] });
  });

  it('refreshes the round-shape queries only after the local end has finished', async () => {
    // A refetch mid-end would show the round-shape guard a server holes_played
    // while the store's holesPlayed is still null, and it would reset the round.
    let finishLocalEnd: () => void = () => {};
    mockEndRoundEarly.mockImplementation(
      () => new Promise<void>((resolve) => { finishLocalEnd = resolve; })
    );
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6));
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    await act(async () => finishLocalEnd());

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6));
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('offline: ends locally, then queues the end_early item', async () => {
    mockedCheckIsOnline.mockResolvedValue(false);
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6));
    expect(mockedApply).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6);
    expect(mockedQueue).toHaveBeenCalledWith('round-1', 6);
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]).toBeLessThan(
      mockedQueue.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]
    );
    // Nothing on the server changed yet.
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("a 'network' failure falls back to the offline path", async () => {
    mockedApply.mockRejectedValue(new MockEndRoundEarlyError('network'));
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6));
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6);
    expect(mockedQueue).toHaveBeenCalledWith('round-1', 6);
  });

  it("a slow request that times out as 'network' still ends locally and queues; Cancel waits, then the sheet closes", async () => {
    // applyEndRoundEarly bounds the request (B6b-1) and rejects with 'network'
    // when it gives up. Until then the sheet shows "Ending…" and ignores Cancel.
    let timeOut: (error: unknown) => void = () => {};
    mockedApply.mockImplementation(
      () => new Promise<void>((_resolve, reject) => { timeOut = reject; })
    );
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockedApply).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.loading).toBe(true);

    act(() => result.current.sheetProps.onCancel());
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.visible).toBe(true);

    await act(async () => timeOut(new MockEndRoundEarlyError('network')));

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6));
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6);
    expect(mockedQueue).toHaveBeenCalledWith('round-1', 6);
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.sheetProps.loading).toBe(false));
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.visible).toBe(false);
  });

  it("'conflict': adopts the server's N carried on the error, without a read-back", async () => {
    mockedApply.mockRejectedValue(new MockEndRoundEarlyError('conflict', 4));
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(4));
    expect(mockedFetchHolesPlayed).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(4);
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ queryKey: ['rounds', 'detail', 'round-1'] });
    // Adopted locally first, then the caches are refreshed.
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]).toBeLessThan(
      mockInvalidateQueries.mock.invocationCallOrder[0]
    );
    expect(mockedQueue).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("'conflict' without the server's N: reads it back, adopts it, says so, and routes with it", async () => {
    mockedApply.mockRejectedValue(new MockEndRoundEarlyError('conflict'));
    mockedFetchHolesPlayed.mockResolvedValue(4);
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(4));
    expect(mockedFetchHolesPlayed).toHaveBeenCalledWith('round-1');
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(4);
    expect(mockShowToast).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
      variant: 'info',
      title: 'Round already ended',
      message: 'This round was already ended after 4 holes on another device.',
    });
    expect(mockedQueue).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("'conflict' with no server end (round already completed): error, nothing changes", async () => {
    mockedApply.mockRejectedValue(new MockEndRoundEarlyError('conflict'));
    mockedFetchHolesPlayed.mockResolvedValue(null);
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(mockShowErrorToast).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Could not end the round',
        'This round can no longer be ended.'
      )
    );
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onEnded).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("'not_found': the server has nothing to end — ends locally, no queue", async () => {
    mockedApply.mockRejectedValue(new MockEndRoundEarlyError('not_found'));
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6));
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6);
    expect(mockedQueue).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("'conflict' whose read-back fails: error toast, nothing changes", async () => {
    mockedApply.mockRejectedValue(new MockEndRoundEarlyError('conflict'));
    mockedFetchHolesPlayed.mockRejectedValue(new Error('timeout'));
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(mockShowErrorToast).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
        'Could not end the round',
        'This round can no longer be ended.'
      )
    );
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onEnded).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it.each([
    ['forbidden', "You don't have permission to end this round."],
    ['invalid', "This round can't be ended right now."],
  ] as const)("'%s': error toast, no local change, sheet stays open", async (code, message) => {
    mockedApply.mockRejectedValue(new MockEndRoundEarlyError(code));
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(mockShowErrorToast).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Could not end the round', message)
    );
    await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.sheetProps.loading).toBe(false));
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockedQueue).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onEnded).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(result.current.sheetProps.visible).toBe(true);
  });

  it('a failing local end shows an error and does not navigate', async () => {
    mockEndRoundEarly.mockRejectedValue(new Error('disk full'));
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(mockShowErrorToast).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Could not end the round', 'Please try again.')
    );
    expect(onEnded).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    // The server already holds the end: refresh so the round-shape guard can adopt it.
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
  });

  it('offline: a local end that fails (the round was unloaded mid-end) queues nothing', async () => {
    mockedCheckIsOnline.mockResolvedValue(false);
    mockEndRoundEarly.mockRejectedValue(new EndRoundEarlyRoundChangedError('round-1'));
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(mockShowErrorToast).toHaveBeenCalledWith('Could not end the round', 'Please try again.')
    );
    expect(mockedQueue).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(onEnded).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(mockInvalidateQueries).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('ignores a second tap while the first confirm is running', async () => {
    let release: () => void = () => {};
    mockedApply.mockImplementation(() => new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; }));
    const { result, onEnded } = renderOpened();

    pressConfirm(result);
    pressConfirm(result);
    await waitFor(() => expect(mockedApply).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    await act(async () => release());

    await waitFor(() => expect(onEnded).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));
    expect(mockEndRoundEarly).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement the hook**

Create `src/hooks/scorecard/useEndRoundEarly.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * useEndRoundEarly
 *
 * Drives "End round early" on the three scoring screens (stroke / stableford /
 * par entry, singles match play, team match play):
 * - decides whether the ⋮ action is offered (canEndRoundEarly);
 * - builds the plan (N, removed scores) via planEndRoundEarly and the one-line
 *   preview via describeEndRoundEarlyResult;
 * - on confirm (R14): online → end_round_early RPC, then the local end, then
 *   onEnded(N). Offline, or a network failure → local end, then a queued
 *   'end_early' round item. 'conflict' (22023 round_already_ended: another
 *   device ended at a different N) → adopt the server's N. 'not_found'
 *   (P0002) → nothing to end on the server; end locally, no queue.
 *   'forbidden' (42501) / 'invalid' (other 22023) → error toast, nothing
 *   changes. Once the server holds the end (RPC success or an adopted
 *   conflict) the round-shape queries (skinsKeys.holeCounts, roundKeys.detail)
 *   are invalidated — only after the local end has run, so a refetch can't
 *   trip the round-shape guard's reset mid-end.
 * - tells the sheet whether this is a handicap round (R22).
 *
 * Ending is final — there is no Resume and no relaunch redirect; the scoring
 * screens show the "Ended after N of M · Finish" banner instead (B6d).
 */

import { useCallback, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { useScorecardStore } from '@/store/scorecardStore';
import { scoresEveryPlayer } from '@/store/endRoundEarlySlice';
import { useToast } from '@/context/ToastContext';
import { checkIsOnline } from '@/hooks/useOnlineStatus';
import { filterHolesByNineType, filterPlayableHoles } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import { calculatePlayerStats } from '@/utils/scorecardCalculations';
import {
  describeEndRoundEarlyResult,
  planEndRoundEarly,
  type EndEarlyMatchContext,
  type EndRoundEarlyPlan,
  type EndRoundEarlyStatsRow,
} from '@/utils/endRoundEarly';
import {
  applyEndRoundEarly,
  fetchRoundHolesPlayed,
  queueRoundEndEarly,
  EndRoundEarlyError,
  type EndRoundEarlyErrorCode,
} from '@/services/rounds/applyEndRoundEarly';
import { queryClient } from '@/services/queryClient';
import { roundKeys, skinsKeys } from '@/hooks/queryKeys';
import { scoringLogger } from '@/utils/debugLogger';
import type { EndRoundEarlySheetProps } from '@/components/scorecard/EndRoundEarlySheet';
import type { GameType, HandicapSource, NineType, TeamFormat } from '@/types/database/enums';
import type { Hole, Player, Scorecard, TeeBox } from '@/types';

export interface UseEndRoundEarlyArgs {
  roundId: string;
  /** From the round row (competition_id == null) when available — social rounds only. */
  isStandalone: boolean;
  gameType: GameType;
  /** Round team format. Team stroke formats get no result preview. */
  teamFormat?: TeamFormat | null;
  /** With scoring pairs, currentPlayers is only the paired subset — never offer the action. */
  scoringPairsEnabled: boolean;
  /** Match-play screens: the live match state (built with the screen's match handicaps). */
  getMatchContext?: () => EndEarlyMatchContext | null;
  /** Fires once the round is ended (N may be the server's N after a conflict). */
  onEnded: (holesPlayed: number) => void;
}

export interface UseEndRoundEarlyResult {
  canEndRoundEarly: boolean;
  /** The store holds this round and it has been ended early. */
  isEnded: boolean;
  open: () => void;
  sheetProps: EndRoundEarlySheetProps;
}

interface PreviewInputs {
  plan: EndRoundEarlyPlan;
  holes: Hole[];
  nineType: NineType;
  gameType: GameType;
  teamFormat: TeamFormat | null;
  isMultiBall: boolean;
  getMatchContext?: () => EndEarlyMatchContext | null;
  players: Player[];
  scorecards: Map<string, Scorecard>;
  playerTeeMap: Map<string, TeeBox>;
  selectedTeeData: TeeBox | null;
  handicapSource: HandicapSource;
}

/**
 * The preview runs the same maths as the finish screen: the round's PLANNED
 * holes plus holesPlayed — never a played-only slice — so the daily handicap
 * (derived from Σpar) is the one the round keeps. Multi-ball rounds get no
 * preview (calculatePlayerStats reads single-ball scores only).
 */
function buildResultPreview({
  plan,
  holes,
  nineType,
  gameType,
  teamFormat,
  isMultiBall,
  getMatchContext,
  players,
  scorecards,
  playerTeeMap,
  selectedTeeData,
  handicapSource,
}: PreviewInputs): string | null {
  const matchContext = getMatchContext?.() ?? null;
  if (matchContext) {
    const playedHoleNumbers = filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, plan.holesPlayed).map(
      (hole) => hole.number
    );
    return describeEndRoundEarlyResult({
      ...matchContext,
      playedHoleNumbers,
      // The same planned count the match views pass as totalHoles (B5b):
      // the round's own holes, so a 'full' round on a 9-hole course is
      // measured over 9, not getHoleCount('full') = 18.
      plannedHoles: filterHolesByNineType(holes, nineType).length,
      holesPlayed: plan.holesPlayed,
    });
  }

  if (teamFormat || isMultiBall) return null;
  if (gameType !== 'stroke' && gameType !== 'stableford' && gameType !== 'par') return null;

  const stats: EndRoundEarlyStatsRow[] = players.map((player) => {
    const scorecard = scorecards.get(player.id);
    const [playerStats] = calculatePlayerStats(
      [
        {
          id: player.id,
          playerId: player.id,
          player: {
            id: player.id,
            name: player.name,
            handicap: player.handicap ?? null,
            handicap_index: player.handicapIndex ?? null,
            gender: player.gender ?? null,
          },
          scores: scorecard?.scores ?? null,
          hasScorecard: !!scorecard,
        },
      ],
      holes,
      playerTeeMap.get(player.id) ?? selectedTeeData,
      handicapSource,
      { holesPlayed: plan.holesPlayed }
    );
    return playerStats;
  });

  return describeEndRoundEarlyResult({ kind: gameType, stats });
}

function endEarlyErrorCode(error: unknown): EndRoundEarlyErrorCode | null {
  return error instanceof EndRoundEarlyError ? error.code : null;
}

/** The server now holds holes_played: refresh what reads the round shape
 *  (useSkinsHoleCounts, Review's roundDetails / ViewRound's round row). */
function invalidateRoundShapeQueries(roundId: string): void {
  void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: skinsKeys.holeCounts(roundId) });
  void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: roundKeys.detail(roundId) });
}

const END_FAILED_TITLE = 'Could not end the round';

export function useEndRoundEarly({
  roundId,
  isStandalone,
  gameType,
  teamFormat = null,
  scoringPairsEnabled,
  getMatchContext,
  onEnded,
}: UseEndRoundEarlyArgs): UseEndRoundEarlyResult {
  const store = useScorecardStore();
  const {
    currentRoundId,
    holes,
    nineType,
    holesPlayed,
    startHole,
    currentPlayers,
    groupScorecards,
    playerTeeMap,
    selectedTeeData,
    handicapSource,
    isMultiBall,
    endRoundEarly,
  } = store;
  const { showErrorToast, showToast } = useToast();

  const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  // Guards a double tap: `loading` state is stale inside the running callback.
  const inFlightRef = useRef(false);

  const isLoadedForRound =
    currentRoundId === roundId && holes.length > 0 && currentPlayers.length > 0;
  const isEnded = currentRoundId === roundId && holesPlayed != null;

  // R11/R16: only a device that scores every player may end the round, or
  // another group's cards could hold more holes than N. The store's own rule
  // (the one endRoundEarly(n) enforces), so the action is offered exactly
  // when the end would be accepted. `allowedPlayerIds`, `currentPlayers` and
  // `groupScorecards` re-render this hook whenever the rule's inputs change.
  const deviceScoresEveryPlayer = scoresEveryPlayer(store);
  const handicapRound = handicapSource !== 'none';

  // "Round still in progress", decidable offline: nothing submitted yet.
  const anyCardSubmitted = useMemo(
    () =>
      Array.from(groupScorecards.values()).some(
        (card) => card.status === 'completed' || card.status === 'confirmed'
      ),
    [groupScorecards]
  );

  const plan = useMemo(() => {
    if (!isStandalone || scoringPairsEnabled || !isLoadedForRound || isEnded) return null;
    if (!deviceScoresEveryPlayer || anyCardSubmitted) return null;
    return planEndRoundEarly({
      holes,
      nineType,
      players: currentPlayers.map((player) => ({ id: player.id, name: player.name })),
      scorecards: groupScorecards,
    });
  }, [
    isStandalone,
    scoringPairsEnabled,
    isLoadedForRound,
    isEnded,
    deviceScoresEveryPlayer,
    anyCardSubmitted,
    holes,
    nineType,
    currentPlayers,
    groupScorecards,
  ]);

  // Built only while the sheet is open (the match getter reads live state).
  const resultPreview = useMemo(() => {
    if (!visible || !plan) return null;
    return buildResultPreview({
      plan,
      holes,
      nineType,
      gameType,
      teamFormat,
      isMultiBall,
      getMatchContext,
      players: currentPlayers,
      scorecards: groupScorecards,
      playerTeeMap,
      selectedTeeData,
      handicapSource,
    });
  }, [
    visible,
    plan,
    holes,
    nineType,
    gameType,
    teamFormat,
    isMultiBall,
    getMatchContext,
    currentPlayers,
    groupScorecards,
    playerTeeMap,
    selectedTeeData,
    handicapSource,
  ]);

  const open = useCallback(() => {
    if (plan) setVisible(true);
  }, [plan]);

  const handleCancel = useCallback(() => {
    if (!inFlightRef.current) setVisible(false);
  }, []);

  const runConfirm = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!plan || inFlightRef.current) return;
    const n = plan.holesPlayed;
    const logContext = { roundId: roundId.substring(0, 8) + '...', holesPlayed: n };
    inFlightRef.current = true;
    setLoading(true);
    // True once the server holds holes_played (RPC success or adopted
    // conflict). The round-shape queries are invalidated only AFTER the local
    // end has run: a refetch landing mid-end would show the round-shape guard
    // (useRoundData / useMatchPlayData, B3c-2) a server holes_played while
    // the store's holesPlayed is still null, and it would reset the round.
    let serverHoldsEnd = false;
    try {
      let queueForLater = false;

      if (await checkIsOnline()) {
        try {
          await applyEndRoundEarly(roundId, n);
          serverHoldsEnd = true;
        } catch (error) {
          const code = endEarlyErrorCode(error);
          if (code === 'network') {
            // Also how applyEndRoundEarly reports its own request timeout:
            // end locally and let the queue deliver it.
            queueForLater = true;
          } else if (code === 'not_found') {
            // P0002: the round has no server row to end — the server step is done.
            scoringLogger.warn('End round early: round not found on server', logContext);
          } else if (code === 'conflict') {
            // 22023 round_already_ended: another device already ended this
            // round — adopt its N (from the error's DETAIL, else read back).
            const carried = (error as EndRoundEarlyError).serverHolesPlayed;
            const serverHolesPlayed =
              typeof carried === 'number'
                ? carried
                : await fetchRoundHolesPlayed(roundId).catch(() => null);
            if (serverHolesPlayed == null) {
              showErrorToast(END_FAILED_TITLE, 'This round can no longer be ended.');
              return;
            }
            serverHoldsEnd = true;
            await endRoundEarly(serverHolesPlayed);
            invalidateRoundShapeQueries(roundId);
            setVisible(false);
            showToast({
              variant: 'info',
              title: 'Round already ended',
              message: `This round was already ended after ${serverHolesPlayed} holes on another device.`,
            });
            onEnded(serverHolesPlayed);
            return;
          } else if (code === 'forbidden') {
            showErrorToast(END_FAILED_TITLE, "You don't have permission to end this round.");
            return;
          } else if (code === 'invalid') {
            showErrorToast(END_FAILED_TITLE, "This round can't be ended right now.");
            return;
          } else {
            throw error;
          }
        }
      } else {
        queueForLater = true;
      }

      await endRoundEarly(n);
      if (serverHoldsEnd) invalidateRoundShapeQueries(roundId);
      if (queueForLater) await queueRoundEndEarly(roundId, n);
      setVisible(false);
      onEnded(n);
    } catch (error) {
      scoringLogger.error('End round early failed', error, logContext);
      // The local end failed after the server took it: refresh the React Query
      // round row so the match-play guards (useRoundDetails) adopt the server's
      // holes_played. ScorecardEntryScreen's guard reads useRoundMetadata (not
      // React Query), so there the next load's reconcile adopts it instead.
      if (serverHoldsEnd) invalidateRoundShapeQueries(roundId);
      showErrorToast(END_FAILED_TITLE, 'Please try again.');
    } finally {
      inFlightRef.current = false;
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [plan, roundId, endRoundEarly, onEnded, showErrorToast, showToast]);

  const handleConfirm = useCallback(() => {
    void runConfirm();
  }, [runConfirm]);

  return {
    canEndRoundEarly: plan !== null,
    isEnded,
    open,
    sheetProps: {
      visible: visible && plan !== null,
      plan,
      resultPreview,
      startHole,
      loading,
      handicapRound,
      onConfirm: handleConfirm,
      onCancel: handleCancel,
    },
  };
}
```

`scoresEveryPlayer(store)` passes the whole store state. B3b-2 types the parameter as `{ allowedPlayerIds: readonly string[]; currentPlayers: readonly { id: string }[]; groupScorecards: ReadonlyMap<string, unknown> }`, which the store state satisfies structurally.

Check `scoringLogger.warn(message, context)`. `createModuleLogger` loggers take `(message, data?)` for `warn`, as `matchPlayLogger.warn('SKINS: …', { error })` already does in `MatchPlayScoringScreen`.

```ts
/**
 * usePlayedHoleRange — once a round is ended early, the scoring screens only
 * navigate the played holes, and a current hole after the end is pulled back.
 */

import { renderHook } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { usePlayedHoleRange } from './usePlayedHoleRange';
import { useScorecardStore } from '@/store/scorecardStore';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';

jest.mock('@/store/scorecardStore', () => ({
  useScorecardStore: jest.fn(),
}));

const mockedUseScorecardStore = useScorecardStore as jest.MockedFunction<typeof useScorecardStore>;
const allHoles = create18Holes();
const backNine = allHoles.filter((hole) => hole.number >= 10);

function mockStore(state: { currentRoundId?: string | null; holesPlayed?: number | null; nineType?: string }) {
  mockedUseScorecardStore.mockReturnValue({
    currentRoundId: 'round-1',
    holesPlayed: null,
    nineType: 'full',
    ...state,
  } as any);
}

describe('usePlayedHoleRange', () => {
  beforeEach(() => jest.clearAllMocks());

  it('a round not ended passes the holes through unchanged', () => {
    mockStore({});
    const setCurrentHole = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      usePlayedHoleRange({ roundId: 'round-1', holes: allHoles, currentHole: 7, setCurrentHole })
    );

    expect(result.current.isEnded).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.holesPlayed).toBeNull();
    expect(result.current.navigableHoles).toBe(allHoles);
    expect(result.current.firstHoleNumber).toBe(1);
    expect(result.current.lastHoleNumber).toBe(18);
    expect(setCurrentHole).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('an 18-hole round ended after 6 navigates holes 1–6 and pulls hole 8 back to 6', () => {
    mockStore({ holesPlayed: 6 });
    const setCurrentHole = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      usePlayedHoleRange({ roundId: 'round-1', holes: allHoles, currentHole: 8, setCurrentHole })
    );

    expect(result.current.isEnded).toBe(true);
    expect(result.current.navigableHoles.map((h) => h.number)).toEqual([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6]);
    expect(result.current.firstHoleNumber).toBe(1);
    expect(result.current.lastHoleNumber).toBe(6);
    expect(setCurrentHole).toHaveBeenCalledWith(6);
  });

  it('a back nine ended after 6 navigates holes 10–15 (Review Focus #2)', () => {
    mockStore({ holesPlayed: 6, nineType: 'back9' });
    const setCurrentHole = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      usePlayedHoleRange({ roundId: 'round-1', holes: backNine, currentHole: 17, setCurrentHole })
    );

    expect(result.current.navigableHoles.map((h) => h.number)).toEqual([10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15]);
    expect(result.current.firstHoleNumber).toBe(10);
    expect(result.current.lastHoleNumber).toBe(15);
    expect(setCurrentHole).toHaveBeenCalledWith(15);
  });

  it('a current hole before the range moves to the first played hole', () => {
    mockStore({ holesPlayed: 6, nineType: 'back9' });
    const setCurrentHole = jest.fn();
    renderHook(() =>
      usePlayedHoleRange({ roundId: 'round-1', holes: backNine, currentHole: 1, setCurrentHole })
    );

    expect(setCurrentHole).toHaveBeenCalledWith(10);
  });

  it('leaves a current hole inside the played range alone', () => {
    mockStore({ holesPlayed: 6 });
    const setCurrentHole = jest.fn();
    renderHook(() =>
      usePlayedHoleRange({ roundId: 'round-1', holes: allHoles, currentHole: 4, setCurrentHole })
    );

    expect(setCurrentHole).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('ignores holesPlayed while the store still holds another round', () => {
    mockStore({ currentRoundId: 'round-2', holesPlayed: 6 });
    const setCurrentHole = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      usePlayedHoleRange({ roundId: 'round-1', holes: allHoles, currentHole: 8, setCurrentHole })
    );

    expect(result.current.isEnded).toBe(false);
    expect(result.current.lastHoleNumber).toBe(18);
    expect(setCurrentHole).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('falls back to 1–18 bounds while holes are empty', () => {
    mockStore({ holesPlayed: 6 });
    const setCurrentHole = jest.fn();
    const { result } = renderHook(() =>
      usePlayedHoleRange({ roundId: 'round-1', holes: [], currentHole: 8, setCurrentHole })
    );

    expect(result.current.firstHoleNumber).toBe(1);
    expect(result.current.lastHoleNumber).toBe(18);
    expect(setCurrentHole).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});
```

```tsx
/**
 * EndedEarlyBanner — "Ended after N of M" strip for a round ended early.
 *
 * Scoring screens pass onFinish (→ their finish screen) to show a "Finish"
 * action; the finish screens (Review, Match Play Scorecard — B7a) omit it.
 * Ending is final: there is no Resume.
 */

import React from 'react';
import { View, StyleSheet, TouchableOpacity } from 'react-native';
import { Text, Icon } from 'react-native-paper';
import { useThemeColors } from '@/context/ThemeContext';
import { spacing, typography, borderRadius } from '@/constants/theme';
import { formatEndedEarlyLabel } from '@/utils/roundShape';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

export interface EndedEarlyBannerProps {
  holesPlayed: number;
  nineType: NineType;
  onFinish?: () => void;
}

export function EndedEarlyBanner({ holesPlayed, nineType, onFinish }: EndedEarlyBannerProps) {
  const colors = useThemeColors();

  return (
    <View
      style={[styles.banner, { backgroundColor: colors.infoLight, borderBottomColor: colors.border }]}
      testID="ended-early-banner"
    >
      <Icon source="flag-checkered" size={18} color={colors.info} />
      <Text style={[styles.label, { color: colors.textPrimary }]}>
        {formatEndedEarlyLabel(holesPlayed, nineType)}
      </Text>
      {onFinish ? (
        <TouchableOpacity
          onPress={onFinish}
          style={[styles.finishButton, { backgroundColor: colors.primary }]}
          activeOpacity={0.8}
          accessibilityRole="button"
          accessibilityLabel="Finish"
          testID="ended-early-finish"
        >
          <Text style={[styles.finishLabel, { color: colors.white }]}>Finish</Text>
        </TouchableOpacity>
      ) : null}
    </View>
  );
}

const styles = StyleSheet.create({
  banner: {
    flexDirection: 'row',
    alignItems: 'center',
    gap: spacing.sm,
    paddingVertical: spacing.sm,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    borderBottomWidth: 1,
  },
  label: {
    ...typography.bodyBold,
    flex: 1,
  },
  finishButton: {
    minHeight: 44,
    minWidth: 88,
    paddingHorizontal: spacing.lg,
    borderRadius: borderRadius.lg,
    alignItems: 'center',
    justifyContent: 'center',
  },
  finishLabel: {
    ...typography.bodyBold,
  },
});

export default EndedEarlyBanner;
```

Create `src/hooks/scorecard/usePlayedHoleRange.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * usePlayedHoleRange
 *
 * Once a round is ended early (store holesPlayed set for THIS round), the
 * scoring screens are closed after hole N (R17): hole navigation, swiping and
 * progress strips are limited to the played holes, and a current hole after
 * the end is pulled back to the last played hole.
 *
 * Maths never uses this — daily handicaps keep the planned `holes`. Until the
 * round is ended, `navigableHoles` is `holes` itself (same reference) and the
 * bounds are exactly the screens' existing `holes[0]` / last-hole fallbacks.
 */

import { useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useScorecardStore } from '@/store/scorecardStore';
import { filterPlayableHoles } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';
import type { Hole } from '@/types';

export interface PlayedHoleRange {
  isEnded: boolean;
  holesPlayed: number | null;
  nineType: NineType;
  /** The played holes once ended; otherwise the screen's holes unchanged. */
  navigableHoles: Hole[];
  firstHoleNumber: number;
  lastHoleNumber: number;
}

export function usePlayedHoleRange({
  roundId,
  holes,
  currentHole,
  setCurrentHole,
}: {
  roundId: string;
  holes: Hole[];
  currentHole: number;
  setCurrentHole: (hole: number) => void;
}): PlayedHoleRange {
  const { currentRoundId, holesPlayed: storeHolesPlayed, nineType } = useScorecardStore();
  const holesPlayed = currentRoundId === roundId ? storeHolesPlayed : null;
  const isEnded = holesPlayed != null;

  const navigableHoles = useMemo(
    () => (holesPlayed != null ? filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, holesPlayed) : holes),
    [holes, nineType, holesPlayed]
  );
  const firstHoleNumber = navigableHoles[0]?.number ?? 1;
  const lastHoleNumber = navigableHoles[navigableHoles.length - 1]?.number ?? 18;

  // Pull a current hole outside the played range back inside it.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!isEnded || navigableHoles.length === 0) return;
    if (currentHole > lastHoleNumber) {
      setCurrentHole(lastHoleNumber);
    } else if (currentHole < firstHoleNumber) {
      setCurrentHole(firstHoleNumber);
    }
  }, [isEnded, navigableHoles.length, currentHole, firstHoleNumber, lastHoleNumber, setCurrentHole]);

  return { isEnded, holesPlayed, nineType, navigableHoles, firstHoleNumber, lastHoleNumber };
}
```

A2a's own clamp effect (planned bounds, resets to `firstHoleNumber`) and `usePlayedHoleRange`'s clamp (played bounds) don't fight. Any hole inside the played range is also inside the planned range, so A2a's effect is a no-op whenever ours has moved the hole.

Writes after N are already no-ops in the store (B3b's closed-holes guard). B6d only stops the user from reaching those holes.

```bash
'Ended after N of M' banner with Finish, limit hole navigation, swiping and
progress strips to the played holes (pulling the current hole back inside),
and route Submit to the finish screen (Review, or Match Play Scorecard for
singles) instead of submitting against the planned hole count.
```

The memos, lines 87-103. Current:

```ts
  // Calculate player statistics (with daily handicap if tee data available)
  const playerStats = useMemo(
    () => calculatePlayerStats(players, holes, selectedTeeData, handicapSource),
    [players, holes, selectedTeeData, handicapSource]
  );

  // Calculate course par for daily handicap

```

Replacement:

```ts
  // Rows render the holes actually played: every planned hole, or the first N
  // (from the round's first hole) once the round was ended early.
  const playedHoles = useMemo(
    () => filterPlayableHoles(Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : [], nineType, holesPlayed),
    [holes, nineType, holesPlayed]
  );

  // Calculate player statistics (with daily handicap if tee data available).
  // Planned holes + holesPlayed: the daily handicap derives from Σpar of the
  // planned holes; net is per hole over the played ones.
  const playerStats = useMemo(
    () => calculatePlayerStats(players, holes, selectedTeeData, handicapSource, { holesPlayed }),
    [players, holes, selectedTeeData, handicapSource, holesPlayed]
  );

  // Par totals for the rows shown
  const parTotals = useMemo(() => calculateParTotals(playedHoles), [playedHoles]);

  // Course par for the daily handicap — always the planned holes
  const coursePar = useMemo(
    () => (Array.isArray(holes) ? holes : []).reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0),
    [holes]
  );

  // Split the rows shown
  const { front9, back9 } = useMemo(() => splitHolesByNine(playedHoles), [playedHoles]);
```

```ts
/**
 * useScoreReview — submit validation over the holes that count.
 */

import { renderHook, act } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { useScoreReview } from './useScoreReview';
import { useScorecardStore } from '@/store/scorecardStore';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';
import type { Hole, Player, Scorecard } from '@/types';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

jest.mock('@/store/scorecardStore', () => ({
  useScorecardStore: jest.fn(),
}));

const mockedUseScorecardStore = useScorecardStore as jest.MockedFunction<typeof useScorecardStore>;

const alice = { id: 'p1', name: 'Alice', email: 'alice@test.com' } as Player;
const bob = { id: 'p2', name: 'Bob', email: 'bob@test.com' } as Player;

const range = (from: number, to: number) =>
  Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => from + i);

function card(player: Player, holeNumbers: number[]): Scorecard {
  const scores: Scorecard['scores'] = {};
  for (const holeNumber of holeNumbers) scores[holeNumber] = { strokes: 4 };
  return {
    id: `sc-${player.id}`,
    roundId: 'round-1',
    playerId: player.id,
    scores,
    totalGross: 0,
    totalNet: 0,
    status: 'in-progress',
    createdAt: new Date('2026-10-07T00:00:00Z'),
    updatedAt: new Date('2026-10-07T00:00:00Z'),
  };
}

function mockStore({
  holes,
  aliceHoles,
  bobHoles,
  nineType = 'full',
  holesPlayed = null,
}: {
  holes: Hole[];
  aliceHoles: number[];
  bobHoles: number[];
  nineType?: NineType;
  holesPlayed?: number | null;
}) {
  mockedUseScorecardStore.mockReturnValue({
    currentRoundId: 'round-1',
    currentPlayers: [alice, bob],
    groupScorecards: new Map([
      [alice.id, card(alice, aliceHoles)],
      [bob.id, card(bob, bobHoles)],
    ]),
    holes,
    gameType: 'stroke',
    getPlayerScore: jest.fn(),
    submitScorecards: jest.fn(),
    resetRound: jest.fn(),
    setCurrentHole: jest.fn(),
    selectedTeeData: null,
    handicapSource: 'profile',
    startHole: 1,
    allowedPlayerIds: [],
    isMultiBall: false,
    ballCount: 1,
    nineType,
    holesPlayed,
  } as any);
}

describe('useScoreReview — validateScores', () => {
  it('reports every planned hole a player is missing (locks current behaviour)', () => {
    mockStore({ holes: create18Holes(), aliceHoles: range(1, 18), bobHoles: range(1, 17) });
    const { result } = renderHook(() => useScoreReview({}));

    let incomplete: ReturnType<typeof result.current.validateScores> = [];
    act(() => {
      incomplete = result.current.validateScores();
    });

    expect(incomplete).toEqual([
      { holeNumber: 18, missingPlayers: [{ id: 'p2', name: 'Bob' }] },
    ]);
  });
});
```

### Task B7b: Finish screens: played versus planned holes per tab

**Review tab routing.** Math gets the planned holes plus `holesPlayed`. Views that only render get the played holes.

| Component (Review `index.tsx`) | Receives | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `MatchScorecardTabContent` / `MatchPlayLeaderboardTab` | planned `holes` (unchanged) | Match status needs the planned count for close-outs. They read `holesPlayed` from the store (B5b). |
| `ScorecardTabContent` | planned `holes` + `nineType` + `holesPlayed` (B7a-1) | `calculatePlayerStats` derives the daily handicap from Σpar of `holes`. |
| `StatsTab` | **played** | Render-only per-hole stats. |
| `ContributionsTabContent` | **played** | Per-hole contributions. |
| `SubMatchLeaderboardTab` | planned (unchanged) | Split rounds are competition-only, so an ended round never reaches it. |
| `ScrambleLeaderboardTab` | **played** | Team handicap comes from members; strokes are per hole. |
| `LeaderboardTabContent` | **played** | Per-hole net/points off `dailyHandicaps`, which come from the **planned** `holes` (memo kept). `coursePar` is the played Σpar, so to-par is right. |
| `SkinsTabContent` / `PayoutsTabContent` | `holeCounts={skinsHoleCounts}` (A5d-1; unchanged here, B8-2 adjusts the memo) | Skins pricing needs both the planned and the played count. |
| `WolfTabContent` / `usePartnerStatus` / `useScoreSubmission` | `holeCount` = played count (B8-1 also passes `playedHoleNumbers` to `useScoreSubmission`) | "of N holes" copy; readiness count. |
| `ShotLogList` | `holeNumbers` = played hole numbers | Back 9 ended after 6 shows holes 10–15, not 1–6. |
| `leaderboardDailyHandicaps` memo | planned `holes` (unchanged) | The daily handicap comes from Σpar. A comment is added. |

```ts
  // Calculate if all holes are complete (both players have scores for all holes)
  const isAllComplete = useMemo(() => {
    if (holes.length === 0) return false;
    const completedCount = getCompletedHolesCount();
    return completedCount === holes.length;

```

Replacement:

```ts
  // Holes the match is settled over: every planned hole, or the first N once
  // the round has been ended early (holes after N were removed).
  const playedHoles = useMemo(
    () => filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, holesPlayed),
    [holes, nineType, holesPlayed]
  );

  // Played holes complete for every player in scope (the store's own rule).
  // groupScorecards in deps re-evaluates on every score change.
  const completedPlayedHoleCount = useMemo(
    () => playedHoles.filter((hole) => isHoleComplete(hole.number)).length,
    [playedHoles, isHoleComplete, groupScorecards]
  );

  // Review & Submit is offered once every played hole is complete.
  const isAllComplete =
    playedHoles.length > 0 && completedPlayedHoleCount === playedHoles.length;
```

### Task B8-1: Submit readiness limited to the played holes

- **Readiness is limited to the played holes, not skipped** (R16).
  - Two phones in a group of four or fewer both see every player, so mismatch detection on holes 1–N must still run.
  - The other phone may still hold `score_entries`, or a pending `score_mismatches` row, for holes after N, written before it learned of the end. Those rows must neither block the submit nor count towards another scorer's completeness.
  - So `checkSubmissionReadiness` takes the played hole numbers, and the multi-scorer path filters entries and pending mismatches to them.

`src/services/scoreMismatch/submission.ts`, lines 29-49. Current:

```ts
/**
 * Check if user can submit. Dispatches based on scoring mode:
 *  - Scoring pairs enabled → checkPairsReadiness (self vs assigned partner)
 *  - Otherwise → checkMultiScorerReadiness (auto-detected: only kicks in
 *    when 2+ distinct scorers have written entries for the round)
 */
export async function checkSubmissionReadiness(
  roundId: string,
  userId: string,
  scoringPairsEnabled: boolean,
  holeCount: number = 18,
  groupPlayerIds?: string[]
): Promise<SubmissionReadiness> {
  if (!roundId || !userId) {
    throw createError('Round ID and User ID are required', 'VALIDATION');
  }

  return scoringPairsEnabled
    ? checkPairsReadiness(roundId, userId, holeCount, groupPlayerIds)
    : checkMultiScorerReadiness(roundId, userId, holeCount, groupPlayerIds);
}
```

Replacement:

```ts
/**
 * Check if user can submit. Dispatches based on scoring mode:
 *  - Scoring pairs enabled → checkPairsReadiness (self vs assigned partner)
 *  - Otherwise → checkMultiScorerReadiness (auto-detected: only kicks in
 *    when 2+ distinct scorers have written entries for the round)
 *
 * @param playedHoleNumbers Set for a round ended early: only these holes'
 *   score entries and pending mismatches count, and completeness expects one
 *   entry per played hole. Rounds with scoring pairs can't be ended early, so
 *   the pairs path ignores it.
 */
export async function checkSubmissionReadiness(
  roundId: string,
  userId: string,
  scoringPairsEnabled: boolean,
  holeCount: number = 18,
  groupPlayerIds?: string[],
  playedHoleNumbers?: number[]
): Promise<SubmissionReadiness> {
  if (!roundId || !userId) {
    throw createError('Round ID and User ID are required', 'VALIDATION');
  }

  return scoringPairsEnabled
    ? checkPairsReadiness(roundId, userId, holeCount, groupPlayerIds)
    : checkMultiScorerReadiness(roundId, userId, holeCount, groupPlayerIds, playedHoleNumbers);
}
```

After `filterMismatchesToPlayers` (it ends at line 63 with `  return mismatches.filter((m) => groupSet.has(m.player_id));\n}`), add:

```ts

/**
 * Keep only rows on the holes that count. A round ended early can still hold
 * score entries / mismatches after its last played hole, written by another
 * device before it learned of the end; they must neither block nor satisfy
 * the readiness check. No list ⇒ rows unchanged.
 */
function filterToPlayedHoles<T extends { hole_number: number }>(
  rows: T[],
  playedHoleNumbers?: number[]
): T[] {
  if (!playedHoleNumbers || playedHoleNumbers.length === 0) return rows;
  const played = new Set(playedHoleNumbers);
  return rows.filter((row) => played.has(row.hole_number));
}
```

```ts
async function checkMultiScorerReadiness(
  roundId: string,
  userId: string,
  holeCount: number,
  groupPlayerIds?: string[],
  playedHoleNumbers?: number[]
): Promise<SubmissionReadiness> {
  const allEntries = await getRoundScoreEntries(roundId);

  // Scope to the players this device is submitting (its group). With no group
  // supplied, fall back to round-wide (legacy behaviour).
  const groupSet =
    groupPlayerIds && groupPlayerIds.length > 0 ? new Set(groupPlayerIds) : null;
  const groupEntries = groupSet
    ? allEntries.filter((e) => groupSet.has(e.player_id))
    : allEntries;
  // A round ended early is judged on its played holes only.
  const entries = filterToPlayedHoles(groupEntries, playedHoleNumbers);
  const holesToScore =
    playedHoleNumbers && playedHoleNumbers.length > 0 ? playedHoleNumbers.length : holeCount;
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Implement the skins previews**

Both screens read the round's hole counts from the server row, which only gains `holes_played` once the `end_early` RPC has run. While that item is still queued offline, the store's `holesPlayed` (stamped locally by `endRoundEarly`) stands in, so the preview already settles on the holes played.

**`src/screens/scoring/MatchPlayScorecardScreen/index.tsx`.** A5c-2's line sits above the store destructure (TDZ: the memo that reads `holesPlayed` must go below it). Current (as A5c-2 leaves it):

```tsx
  // Skins are priced on the round's planned holes (read from the round, not the store)
  const skinsHoleCounts = useSkinsHoleCounts(roundId);
```

Replacement:

```tsx
  // Skins are priced on the round's planned holes (read from the round, not the store)
  const roundSkinsHoleCounts = useSkinsHoleCounts(roundId);
```

Then, directly after the store destructure's closing `} = useScorecardStore();` (as B7b leaves it, with `nineType` and `holesPlayed`), insert:

```tsx

  // A round ended early settles on the holes played — the counts every
  // settlement path reads via fetchSkinsHoleCounts. The server's holes_played
  // lags while an offline end_early item is queued; the store's stands in.
  const skinsHoleCounts = useMemo(
    () =>
      holesPlayed != null &&
      roundSkinsHoleCounts.holesPlayed === roundSkinsHoleCounts.plannedHoles
        ? { plannedHoles: roundSkinsHoleCounts.plannedHoles, holesPlayed }
        : roundSkinsHoleCounts,
    [roundSkinsHoleCounts, holesPlayed]
  );
```

`<SkinsResultsCard … holeCounts={skinsHoleCounts} />` (A5c-2) is unchanged.

**`src/screens/scoring/ReviewScorecardScreen/index.tsx`.** `holesPlayed` comes from the `useScoreReview` destructure at the top of the component (B7a-2), above this memo. `holeCount` is the played count after B7b, so the loading fallback takes the planned count from `holes`. Current (as A5d-1 leaves it):

```tsx

    () =>
      roundDetails
        ? getSkinsHoleCounts(roundDetails)
        : { plannedHoles: holeCount, holesPlayed: holeCount },
    [roundDetails, holeCount]
  );
```

Replacement:

```tsx
  const skinsHoleCounts = useMemo(
    () =>
      roundDetails
        ? getSkinsHoleCounts({
            nine_type: roundDetails.nine_type,
            // The server's holes_played lags while an offline end_early item
            // is queued; the store's holesPlayed stands in until it arrives.
            holes_played: roundDetails.holes_played ?? holesPlayed,
          })
        : { plannedHoles: holes.length || 18, holesPlayed: holeCount },
    [roundDetails, holes.length, holeCount, holesPlayed]
  );
```

Create `src/screens/rounds/RoundListScreen/hooks/roundListMeta.test.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * roundListMeta — the per-round hole lists the Rounds list feeds the match
 * pill and calculatePlayerStats.
 *
 * - plannedHoles: the course narrowed to the round's nine_type (match pill).
 * - statsHoles: what calculatePlayerStats gets — the raw course holes for a
 *   round played as planned (unchanged), the planned holes for one ended early
 *   (B4 slices the first N of them).
 */
import { buildRoundListMeta, type RoundListMetaSource } from './roundListMeta';
import {
  computeStandaloneMatchResult,
  type ScorecardForMatchPlay,
} from '@/utils/matchPlayResult';
import { calculatePlayerStats } from '@/utils/scorecardCalculations';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';
import type { HoleScore, TeeBox } from '@/types/database/base';

const TEE: TeeBox = { name: 'White', color: 'white', courseRating: 72, slopeRating: 125 };

const range = (from: number, to: number) =>
  Array.from({ length: to - from + 1 }, (_, i) => from + i);
const numbers = (holes: { number: number }[]) => holes.map((h) => h.number);

function source(overrides: Partial<RoundListMetaSource> = {}): RoundListMetaSource {
  return {
    nine_type: 'full',
    holes_played: null,
    handicap_source: null,
    selected_tee: TEE,
    courses: { holes: create18Holes() },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** A match-play card with gross strokes keyed by hole number. DHC 0 ⇒ no shots given. */
function card(id: string, name: string, strokes: Record<number, number>): ScorecardForMatchPlay {
  const scores: Record<string, HoleScore> = {};
  for (const [hole, value] of Object.entries(strokes)) {
    scores[hole] = { strokes: value };
  }
  return { player_id: id, scores, daily_handicap_used: 0, player: { id, name } };
}

/** Sam shoots 4 on every hole; Bob shoots 5 on `bobLoses`, 4 elsewhere. */
function match(holeNumbers: number[], bobLoses: number[]) {
  const sam: Record<number, number> = {};
  const bob: Record<number, number> = {};
  for (const n of holeNumbers) {
    sam[n] = 4;
    bob[n] = bobLoses.includes(n) ? 5 : 4;
  }
  return [card('sam', 'Sam', sam), card('bob', 'Bob', bob)] as const;
}

describe('buildRoundListMeta', () => {
  it('keeps every course hole for a full round played as planned', () => {
    const meta = buildRoundListMeta(source());

    expect(numbers(meta.courseHoles)).toEqual(range(1, 18));
    expect(numbers(meta.plannedHoles)).toEqual(range(1, 18));
    expect(meta.statsHoles).toBe(meta.courseHoles);
    expect(meta.holesPlayed).toBeNull();
    expect(meta.selectedTee).toBe(TEE);
    expect(meta.handicapSource).toBe('profile');
  });

  it('plans holes 1–9 for a front-9 round but leaves the stats holes as they were', () => {
    const meta = buildRoundListMeta(source({ nine_type: 'front9' }));

    expect(numbers(meta.plannedHoles)).toEqual(range(1, 9));
    // Unchanged from today: the raw course holes (no nine-aware DHC in this plan).
    expect(numbers(meta.statsHoles)).toEqual(range(1, 18));
  });

  it('plans holes 10–18 for a back-9 round', () => {
    expect(numbers(buildRoundListMeta(source({ nine_type: 'back9' })).plannedHoles)).toEqual(
      range(10, 18)
    );
  });

  it('treats a null nine_type as a full round', () => {
    expect(buildRoundListMeta(source({ nine_type: null })).plannedHoles).toHaveLength(18);
  });

  it('feeds the planned holes to the stats, and carries holes_played, for a round ended early', () => {
    const meta = buildRoundListMeta(source({ nine_type: 'back9', holes_played: 6 }));

    expect(numbers(meta.statsHoles)).toEqual(range(10, 18));
    expect(meta.statsHoles).toBe(meta.plannedHoles);
    expect(meta.holesPlayed).toBe(6);
  });

  it('returns no holes when the course has no hole data', () => {
    const noCourse = buildRoundListMeta(source({ courses: null }));
    expect(noCourse.courseHoles).toEqual([]);
    expect(noCourse.plannedHoles).toEqual([]);
    expect(noCourse.statsHoles).toEqual([]);
    expect(buildRoundListMeta(source({ courses: { holes: null } })).plannedHoles).toEqual([]);
  });

  it('keeps an explicit handicap source', () => {
    expect(buildRoundListMeta(source({ handicap_source: 'none' })).handicapSource).toBe('none');
  });
});

describe('round-list match pill fed from buildRoundListMeta', () => {
  it('settles a front-9 match won 2 up on holes 8 and 9 as "2 UP"', () => {
    // Level through 7; Sam wins 8 (1 up, 1 left) and 9 (2 up, 0 left) ⇒ "2 UP".
    const [sam, bob] = match(range(1, 9), [8, 9]);
    const meta = buildRoundListMeta(source({ nine_type: 'front9' }));

    expect(computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, bob, meta.plannedHoles, meta.holesPlayed)).toMatchObject({
      winnerId: 'sam',
      winnerName: 'Sam',
      margin: '2 UP',
    });
  });

  it('settles an 18-hole match ended after 6 on the final lead — "2 UP", never "N&M"', () => {
    // Sam wins 1 and 2, holes 3–6 halved; 2 up with 12 planned holes left is no close-out.
    const [sam, bob] = match(range(1, 6), [1, 2]);
    const meta = buildRoundListMeta(source({ holes_played: 6 }));
    const result = computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, bob, meta.plannedHoles, meta.holesPlayed);

    expect(result).toMatchObject({ winnerId: 'sam', winnerName: 'Sam', margin: '2 UP' });
    expect(result?.margin).not.toContain('&');
  });

  it('halves a level match that was ended early', () => {
    const [sam, bob] = match(range(1, 6), []);
    const meta = buildRoundListMeta(source({ holes_played: 6 }));

    expect(computeStandaloneMatchResult(sam, bob, meta.plannedHoles, meta.holesPlayed)).toMatchObject({
      winnerId: null,
      margin: 'A/S',
    });
  });
});

    // Hand check (create18Holes, holes 1–6):
    //   stroke index 7, 15, 1, 11, 5, 17 → at DHC 9 a stroke on SI ≤ 9:
    //   holes 1, 3, 5 ⇒ 3 strokes received; holes 2, 4, 6 ⇒ 0.
    //   gross = 6 × 5 = 30; net = Σ(gross − strokes) = 30 − 3 = 27
    //   (not 30 − 9 = 21: the full DHC would credit 9 holes never played).
    expect(stats.dailyHandicap).toBe(9);
    expect(stats.handicap).toBe(10);
    expect(stats.totalGross).toBe(30);
    expect(stats.totalNet).toBe(27);
    expect(stats.totalStableford).toBe(13);
  });
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Implement `roundListMeta.ts`**

Create `src/screens/rounds/RoundListScreen/hooks/roundListMeta.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * Per-round hole metadata for the Rounds list.
 *
 * The list re-runs calculatePlayerStats and the match-play pill for completed
 * rounds so its totals match the scorecard view.
 *
 * - plannedHoles: the course narrowed to the round's nine_type. The match pill
 *   is decided against these (a 9-hole match fed 18 holes reads unfinished).
 * - statsHoles: what calculatePlayerStats receives. For a round played as
 *   planned this is the raw course holes, exactly as before (the daily-handicap
 *   fallback derives Σpar from them; nine-aware DHC is out of scope). For a
 *   round ended early it is plannedHoles, because calculatePlayerStats with
 *   { holesPlayed } totals the FIRST N holes of the list it is given — on raw
 *   holes a back-9 round would be scored on holes 1–N.
 * - holesPlayed: rounds.holes_played, set when a social round was ended early.
 */

import { standaloneMatchHoles } from '@/utils/matchPlayResult';
import type { Hole, TeeBox } from '@/types/database/base';
import type { HandicapSource } from '@/types/database/enums';

export interface RoundListMeta {
  /** The course's holes as stored. */
  courseHoles: Hole[];
  /** Planned holes: the course narrowed to the round's nine_type. */
  plannedHoles: Hole[];
  /** Holes handed to calculatePlayerStats (see the file header). */
  statsHoles: Hole[];
  selectedTee: TeeBox | null;
  handicapSource: HandicapSource;
  /** rounds.holes_played — set when the round was ended early, else null. */
  holesPlayed: number | null;
}

/** The slice of a rounds row (with its course) the list selects. */
export interface RoundListMetaSource {
  nine_type: string | null;
  holes_played?: number | null;
  handicap_source: HandicapSource | null;
  selected_tee: TeeBox | null;
  courses: { holes: unknown[] | null } | null;
}

export function buildRoundListMeta(round: RoundListMetaSource): RoundListMeta {
  const courseHoles = Array.isArray(round.courses?.holes)
    ? (round.courses!.holes as Hole[])
    : [];
  // A1b's helper: the course narrowed to the round's nine; anything other
  // than 'front9' / 'back9' (including null) means the full card.
  const plannedHoles = standaloneMatchHoles(courseHoles, round.nine_type);
  const holesPlayed = round.holes_played ?? null;
  return {
    courseHoles,
    plannedHoles,
    statsHoles: holesPlayed != null ? plannedHoles : courseHoles,
    selectedTee: round.selected_tee,
    handicapSource: round.handicap_source ?? 'profile',
    holesPlayed,
  };
}
```

### Task B9b-1: ViewRound tabs — `holesPlayed` props (planned holes for math, played holes for rows)

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/components/rounds/ViewRound/RoundScorecardTab.tsx`:
  - import (30);
  - props (58-63);
  - `IndividualScorecardView` (69-92);
  - main component (283-297, 359-361, 374-376, 388-404).
- Modify: `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/tabs/StatsTab.tsx` (17, 44-59)
- Modify: `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/tabs/MatchTab.tsx` (41-43, 56-58, 90-96)
- Test: `src/components/rounds/ViewRound/RoundScorecardTab.test.tsx` (mock 20-45; new describe before `describe('Snapshots')` at 1035; deliberate snapshot update)
- Create: `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/tabs/StatsTab.test.tsx`
- Create: `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/tabs/MatchTab.test.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `filterHolesByNineType` (existing) and `filterPlayableHoles(holes, nineType, holesPlayed?)` (B2);
  - `calculatePlayerStats(…, options?: { holesPlayed })` (B4);
  - `ScorecardTableProps.holesPlayed?: number | null` (B7a);
  - `MatchPlayScorecardTableProps.holesPlayed?: number | null` (B5b).
- Produces (B9b-2 wires them):
  - `RoundScorecardTab` prop `holesPlayed?: number | null`;
  - `StatsTab` prop `holesPlayed?: number | null`;
  - `MatchTab` prop `holesPlayed?: number | null`.

B9b is split in two (Appendix A, Displays note 14): B9b-1 adds the tab props, and B9b-2 derives the hole lists on ViewRound and wires them.


**The rule applied here (scoring guardrail notes):**
- Anything that derives a daily handicap from Σpar, or decides a match against the planned length, gets the **planned** holes plus `holesPlayed`: `RoundScorecardTab` (both views call `calculatePlayerStats`) and `MatchTab` → `MatchPlayScorecardTable`.
- Anything that only renders or iterates holes gets the **played** holes:
  - `StatsTab` (no handicap math);
  - the scramble tabs (`ScrambleTeamLeaderboard` takes its team handicap from member handicaps; `ScrambleScorecardTable` receives `teamHandicap` as a prop);
  - shamble and scramble contributions;
  - the shot picker.
- **Verified and intentionally unchanged:**
  - `StrokePlayLeaderboardTab` / `StablefordLeaderboardFull` / `ParLeaderboardFull` / `IndividualTeamLeaderboardTab` iterate holes but skip unscored ones, and take the DHC from `vm.leaderboardDailyHandicaps`. Scores after N are removed, so their totals already cover only the holes played.

**b) StatsTab.** Create `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/tabs/StatsTab.test.tsx`:
```tsx
/**
 * StatsTab — rendered holes for 9-hole and ended-early rounds. StatsTab does
 * no handicap math, so it simply renders the played holes.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { render, screen } from '@/__tests__/utils/renderHelpers';
import { StatsTab } from './StatsTab';
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';
import type { ScorecardTablePlayer } from '@/components/scorecard/ScorecardTable/types';

jest.mock('@/components/subscription/FeatureLockCompact', () => ({
  FeatureLockCompact: ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => children,
}));

const holes = create18Holes();
const STATS_OFF = {
  showPutts: false,
  showFairwayHit: false,
  showGreenInRegulation: false,
  showBunkerShots: false,
  showHazards: false,
};

/** One player who made bogey on each of `holeNumbers`. */
function soloPlayer(holeNumbers: number[]): ScorecardTablePlayer[] {
  const scores: Record<string, { strokes: number }> = {};
  for (const hole of holes.filter((h) => holeNumbers.includes(h.number))) {
    scores[String(hole.number)] = { strokes: hole.par + 1 };
  }
  return [{ id: 'sc-1', playerId: 'p1', player: { id: 'p1', name: 'Sam' }, scores, hasScorecard: true }];
}

describe('StatsTab hole rows', () => {
  it('renders OUT, IN and a 72 par total for a full round played as planned', () => {
    render(<StatsTab displayPlayers={soloPlayer([1, 2, 3])} holes={holes} statsVisibility={STATS_OFF} />);

    expect(screen.getByText('OUT')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('IN')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('72')).toBeTruthy();
  });

  it('renders only holes 1–6 for a full round ended after 6', () => {
    // create18Holes pars 4,3,5,4,4,3 = 23; bogey on each = 29.
    render(
      <StatsTab
        displayPlayers={soloPlayer([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6])}
        holes={holes}
        statsVisibility={STATS_OFF}
        holesPlayed={6}
      />
    );

    expect(screen.queryByText('IN')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByText('7')).toBeNull(); // hole 7 row is gone
    expect(screen.getAllByText('23')).toHaveLength(2); // OUT par + TOT par
    expect(screen.getAllByText('29')).toHaveLength(2); // OUT score + TOT score
  });

  it('renders holes 10–15 for a back-9 round ended after 6', () => {
    render(
      <StatsTab
        displayPlayers={soloPlayer([10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15])}
        holes={holes}
        statsVisibility={STATS_OFF}
        nineType="back9"
        holesPlayed={6}
      />
    );

    expect(screen.queryByText('OUT')).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.getByText('IN')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.getByText('15')).toBeTruthy();
    expect(screen.queryByText('16')).toBeNull();
  });
});
```
(Hand check for the back-9 case: holes 10–15 have pars 4,3,5,4,4,3, so IN/TOT par is 23 and bogey scores are 5,4,6,5,5,4, totalling 29. No rendered value is "16".)

```tsx
/**

    expect(props.holesPlayed).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

Replace with:
```ts
interface IndividualScorecardViewProps {
  displayPlayers: ScorecardTablePlayer[];
  /** Planned holes — the daily handicap is derived from these. */
  holes: Hole[];
  /** Holes actually played — the only holes rendered (and summed for par).
   *  Equals `holes` unless the round was ended early. */
  playedHoles: Hole[];
  /** rounds.holes_played when the round was ended early, else null. */
  holesPlayed?: number | null;
  /** Selected tee data for daily handicap calculation */
  selectedTeeData?: TeeBox | null;
  /** Game type — used to hide the Stableford Pts row for stroke play */
  gameType?: string;
}

const IndividualScorecardView = React.memo(function IndividualScorecardView({
  displayPlayers,
  holes,
  playedHoles,
  holesPlayed = null,
  selectedTeeData,
  gameType,
}: IndividualScorecardViewProps) {
  const showStableford = gameType !== 'stroke';
  const colors = useThemeColors();

  // Render (and par-total) only the holes played; the stats get the planned
  // holes plus holesPlayed so the daily handicap isn't derived from a short Σpar.
  const { front9, back9 } = useMemo(() => splitHolesByNine(playedHoles), [playedHoles]);
  const parTotals = useMemo(() => calculateParTotals(playedHoles), [playedHoles]);
  const playerStats = useMemo(
    () => calculatePlayerStats(displayPlayers, holes, selectedTeeData, undefined, { holesPlayed }),
    [displayPlayers, holes, selectedTeeData, holesPlayed]
  );
```

```ts
export function StatsTab({ displayPlayers: displayPlayersProp, scorecards, roundPlayers, holes: rawHoles, statsVisibility, canEditStats, onEditStats, onUpgradePress, nineType = 'full' }: StatsTabProps) {
  const colors = useThemeColors();
  const [selectedPlayerIndex, setSelectedPlayerIndex] = useState(0);

  const holes = useMemo(() => {
    const base =
      Array.isArray(rawHoles) && rawHoles.length > 0
```

Replace with:
```ts
  /** Which holes the round is being played over. Filters the rendered
   *  hole rows and OUT/IN subtotals. Defaults to 'full'. */
  nineType?: NineType;
  /** rounds.holes_played for a social round that was ended early: only the
   *  first `holesPlayed` holes are rendered. StatsTab does no handicap math,
   *  so the played holes are all it needs. Null/undefined = as planned. */
  holesPlayed?: number | null;
}

export function StatsTab({ displayPlayers: displayPlayersProp, scorecards, roundPlayers, holes: rawHoles, statsVisibility, canEditStats, onEditStats, onUpgradePress, nineType = 'full', holesPlayed = null }: StatsTabProps) {
  const colors = useThemeColors();
  const [selectedPlayerIndex, setSelectedPlayerIndex] = useState(0);

  const holes = useMemo(() => {
    const base =
      Array.isArray(rawHoles) && rawHoles.length > 0
        ? rawHoles
        : generateDefaultHoles();
    return filterPlayableHoles(base, nineType, holesPlayed);
  }, [rawHoles, nineType, holesPlayed]);
```
