- [ ] **Step 4: Implement `viewRoundHoles.ts` and wire `ViewRoundScreen/index.tsx`**

Create `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/viewRoundHoles.ts`:

```ts
/**
 * The two hole lists ViewRound hands its tabs.
 *
 * - plannedHoles: the course narrowed to the round's nine_type. Anything that
 *   derives a daily handicap from Σpar, or decides a match against the planned
 *   length, gets these (plus holesPlayed). A played-only Σpar would inflate the
 *   daily handicap by tens of strokes.
 * - playedHoles: plannedHoles cut to rounds.holes_played when a social round
 *   was ended early (identical otherwise). Anything that only renders or
 *   iterates holes gets these.
 *
 * Display-time only: the course holes in the round payload stay intact.
 */

import { filterHolesByNineType, filterPlayableHoles } from '@/utils/holeTransformers';
import type { Hole } from '@/types';
import type { NineType } from '@/types/database/enums';

export interface ViewRoundHoles {
  plannedHoles: Hole[];
  playedHoles: Hole[];
  /** rounds.holes_played — null when the round was played as planned. */
  holesPlayed: number | null;
}

export function getViewRoundHoles(round: {
  nine_type?: NineType | null;
  holes_played?: number | null;
  course?: { holes?: Hole[] | null } | null;
}): ViewRoundHoles {
  const courseHoles = Array.isArray(round.course?.holes) ? round.course!.holes! : [];
  const nineType: NineType = round.nine_type ?? 'full';
  const holesPlayed = round.holes_played ?? null;
  return {
    plannedHoles: filterHolesByNineType(courseHoles, nineType),
    playedHoles: filterPlayableHoles(courseHoles, nineType, holesPlayed),
    holesPlayed,
  };
}
```

```bash
team match on ViewRound is now decided over its 9 holes instead of 18, and
because SubMatchLeaderboardTab takes Σpar from the holes it is given, its
playing handicaps now come from the 9-hole par (as Review already does).
```

```ts
  // Holes the daily-handicap fallback derives Σpar from. Live: the store's
  // planned holes. Read-only: the raw course holes, exactly as before —
  // submitted cards carry daily_handicap_used, so this only matters for a card
  // without one. Never put played-only holes here: an ended-early round's
  // short Σpar would inflate the daily handicap.
  const courseHoles: Hole[] = useMemo(() => {
    const sourceHoles = isLive ? storeHoles : roRound?.course?.holes;
    if (sourceHoles && sourceHoles.length > 0) {
      return sourceHoles;
    }

    // Default holes with standard pars and stroke indexes
    const defaultHoles: Hole[] = [];
    const pars: (3 | 4 | 5)[] = [4, 4, 3, 5, 4, 4, 3, 4, 5, 4, 4, 3, 5, 4, 4, 3, 4, 5];
    const strokeIndexes = [7, 15, 11, 1, 5, 9, 17, 13, 3, 8, 16, 12, 2, 6, 10, 18, 14, 4];

    for (let i = 1; i <= 18; i++) {
      defaultHoles.push({
        number: i as Hole['number'],
        par: pars[i - 1],
        strokeIndex: strokeIndexes[i - 1],
        yardages: { white: 380 },
      });
    }
    return defaultHoles;
  }, [isLive, storeHoles, roRound]);

  // Holes the card renders and totals: the round's nine, cut to holes_played
  // when a social round was ended early. A 9-hole round viewed read-only no
  // longer shows the unplayed nine, and par totals stop covering holes that
  // were never played.
  const holes: Hole[] = useMemo(() => {
    if (isLive) {
      return filterPlayableHoles(courseHoles, storeNineType ?? 'full', storeHolesPlayed);
    }
    return filterPlayableHoles(courseHoles, roRound?.nine_type ?? 'full', roRound?.holes_played);
  }, [isLive, courseHoles, storeNineType, storeHolesPlayed, roRound]);

  // Calculate course par for daily handicap calculation (planned holes).
  const coursePar = useMemo(() => {
    return Array.isArray(courseHoles) ? courseHoles.reduce((sum, hole) => sum + hole.par, 0) : 0;
  }, [courseHoles]);
```

```ts
    completed_at: null,
    participants: PLAYERS,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** A decided decision on `hole` awarding `points` (calculated unless told otherwise). */
function decision(
  hole: number,
  points: Record<string, number>,
  calculated = true
): WolfDecisionWithDetails {
  return {

    is_blind_wolf: false,
    partner_id: null,

    is_tie: false,

    points_awarded: points,
    decided_at: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z',

    wolf: PLAYERS[0],
    partner: null,
  };
}

  });

      []
    );

    // p1 4, p2 2, p3 2 ⇒ ranks 1, 2, 2. Calculated: holes 1–2. Decided: holes 1–3.
    expect(ranks(s)).toEqual([['p1', 4, 1], ['p2', 2, 2], ['p3', 2, 2]]);

      game({ pot_enabled: true, pot_value_per_point: 1 }),
```

```ts

/**
 * Keep only the decisions on holes the round actually played. A round ended
 * early can still hold decisions for later holes on a device that hasn't
 * synced the end_round_early trim yet, so the Review previews ignore them.
 *
 * @param lastHoleNumber - The round's last played hole number; null/undefined keeps all.
 */
export function filterDecisionsThroughHole<T extends Pick<WolfHoleDecision, 'hole_number'>>(
  decisions: T[],
  lastHoleNumber: number | null | undefined
): T[] {
  if (lastHoleNumber == null) return decisions;
  return decisions.filter((d) => d.hole_number <= lastHoleNumber);
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Wolf Game Summary
 *
 * Builds the display summary (standings, net results, hole counts) for a Wolf
 * game. Extracted unchanged from useWolfSummary's memo so it can be unit
 * tested, plus an optional cut to a round's last played hole (rounds ended
 * early).
 */

import type {
  WolfDecisionWithDetails,
  WolfGameSummary,
  WolfGameWithParticipants,
  WolfPayoutWithPlayer,
} from '@/types/database/wolf.types';
import { calculateWolfPayouts } from './payouts';
import {
  calculateWolfStandings,
  filterDecisionsThroughHole,
  getSortedStandings,
} from './standings';

export function buildWolfGameSummary(
  game: WolfGameWithParticipants,
  allDecisions: WolfDecisionWithDetails[],
  payouts: WolfPayoutWithPlayer[],
  lastHoleNumber: number | null = null
): WolfGameSummary {
  const decisions = filterDecisionsThroughHole(allDecisions, lastHoleNumber);

  // Create player name map
  const playerNames: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const participant of game.participants) {
    playerNames[participant.id] = participant.name;
  }

  // Calculate standings
  const standingsMap = calculateWolfStandings(decisions, game.participant_ids);
  const standings = getSortedStandings(standingsMap, playerNames);

  // Calculate net_result for each standing entry when pot is enabled
  if (game.pot_enabled && game.pot_value_per_point) {
    const payoutCalcs = calculateWolfPayouts(standingsMap, game.pot_value_per_point);
    for (const entry of standings) {
      entry.net_result = payoutCalcs[entry.player_id]?.netResult ?? 0;
    }
  }

  // Count completed holes (have calculated_at) and decided holes
  const holesCompleted = decisions.filter((d) => d.calculated_at !== null).length;
  const holesDecided = decisions.filter((d) => d.decided_at !== null).length;

  return {
    game,
    decisions,
    payouts,
    standings,
    holes_completed: holesCompleted,
    holes_decided: holesDecided,
  };
}
```

```ts
/**
 * Query hook to fetch complete Wolf game summary
 *
 * Combines game, decisions, and payouts with calculated standings.
 *
 * @param gameId - Wolf game UUID
 * @returns Query result with WolfGameSummary
 */
export function useWolfSummary(gameId: string | undefined) {
  const gameQuery = useWolfGame(gameId);
  const decisionsQuery = useWolfHoleDecisions(gameId);
  const payoutsQuery = useWolfPayouts(gameId);

  const game = gameQuery.data;

  // Compute summary using useMemo
  const summary = useMemo((): WolfGameSummary | null => {
    if (!game) return null;
    const decisions = decisionsQuery.data ?? [];
    const payouts = payoutsQuery.data ?? [];

    // Create player name map
    const playerNames: Record<string, string> = {};
    for (const participant of game.participants) {
      playerNames[participant.id] = participant.name;
    }

    // Calculate standings
    const standingsMap = calculateWolfStandings(decisions, game.participant_ids);
    const standings = getSortedStandings(standingsMap, playerNames);

    // Calculate net_result for each standing entry when pot is enabled
    if (game.pot_enabled && game.pot_value_per_point) {
      const payoutCalcs = calculateWolfPayouts(standingsMap, game.pot_value_per_point);
      for (const entry of standings) {
        entry.net_result = payoutCalcs[entry.player_id]?.netResult ?? 0;
      }
    }

    // Count completed holes (have calculated_at) and decided holes
    const holesCompleted = decisions.filter((d) => d.calculated_at !== null).length;
    const holesDecided = decisions.filter((d) => d.decided_at !== null).length;

    return {
      game,
      decisions,
      payouts,
      standings,
      holes_completed: holesCompleted,
      holes_decided: holesDecided,
    };
  }, [game, decisionsQuery.data, payoutsQuery.data]);
```

Replace with:
```ts
/**
 * Query hook to fetch complete Wolf game summary
 *
 * Combines game, decisions, and payouts with calculated standings.
 *
 * @param gameId - Wolf game UUID
 * @param options.lastHoleNumber - The round's last played hole when it was
 *   ended early; decisions after it are ignored. Null/omitted = every hole.
 * @returns Query result with WolfGameSummary
 */
export function useWolfSummary(
  gameId: string | undefined,
  options?: { lastHoleNumber?: number | null }
) {
  const gameQuery = useWolfGame(gameId);
  const decisionsQuery = useWolfHoleDecisions(gameId);
  const payoutsQuery = useWolfPayouts(gameId);

  const game = gameQuery.data;
  const lastHoleNumber = options?.lastHoleNumber ?? null;

  // Compute summary using useMemo
  const summary = useMemo((): WolfGameSummary | null => {
    if (!game) return null;
    return buildWolfGameSummary(
      game,
      decisionsQuery.data ?? [],
      payoutsQuery.data ?? [],
      lastHoleNumber
    );
  }, [game, decisionsQuery.data, payoutsQuery.data, lastHoleNumber]);
```

Replace with:
```ts
/** Row type for FlatList rendering */
export type WolfResultRow =
  | { type: 'header' }
  | { type: 'hole'; holeNumber: number; decision: WolfDecisionWithDetails | null }
  | { type: 'subtotal'; label: string; holeRange: string }
  | { type: 'legend' };
type ResultRow = WolfResultRow;

/** Holes 1–18: the rows drawn when the caller doesn't narrow them. */
const ALL_HOLE_NUMBERS = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => i + 1);

/**
 * Table rows: header, the listed front-nine holes + "FRONT 9" subtotal, the
 * listed back-nine holes + "BACK 9" subtotal, legend. A nine with no listed
 * holes gets no section. The default (1–18) is the fixed grid this card has
 * always drawn.
 */
export function buildWolfResultRows(
  decisionsMap: Map<number, WolfDecisionWithDetails>,
  holeNumbers: number[] = ALL_HOLE_NUMBERS
): WolfResultRow[] {
  const rows: WolfResultRow[] = [{ type: 'header' }];
  const sorted = [...holeNumbers].sort((a, b) => a - b);

  const pushSection = (holes: number[], label: string) => {
    if (holes.length === 0) return;
    for (const hole of holes) {
      rows.push({ type: 'hole', holeNumber: hole, decision: decisionsMap.get(hole) ?? null });
    }
    rows.push({ type: 'subtotal', label, holeRange: `${holes[0]}-${holes[holes.length - 1]}` });
  };

  pushSection(sorted.filter((n) => n <= 9), 'FRONT 9');
  pushSection(sorted.filter((n) => n >= 10), 'BACK 9');
  rows.push({ type: 'legend' });
  return rows;
}
```

Replace with:
```tsx
interface WolfTabContentProps {
  wolfGameId: string;
  /** Holes the round actually plays (9 for front/back nine, 18 for full;
   *  the played count once ended early). Drives the "x of N holes" copy and
   *  the in-progress gate. */
  totalHoles: number;
  /** Hole numbers the round played, e.g. 10–15 for a back nine ended after 6.
   *  The result rows, and the summary ignores decisions after the last one.
   *  Omitted = holes 1–18, nothing cut. */
  holeNumbers?: number[];
  isRefreshing: boolean;
  onRefresh: () => void;
  bottomInset: number;
}

export function WolfTabContent({ wolfGameId, totalHoles, holeNumbers, isRefreshing, onRefresh, bottomInset }: WolfTabContentProps) {
  const colors = useThemeColors();
  // Review can still see decisions for holes a round ended early removed
  // (offline before the queued end_early drains, or a stale cache).
  const lastHoleNumber =
    holeNumbers && holeNumbers.length > 0 ? Math.max(...holeNumbers) : null;
  const {
    data: summary,
    isLoading: isSummaryLoading,
    refetch: refetchSummary,
  } = useWolfSummary(wolfGameId, { lastHoleNumber });
```

### Task B9g: Lock the nine-type sheet once a round has `holes_played`

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/components/rounds/ViewRound/RoundDetailsTab/index.tsx` (`canEditNineType` 90-99; `EditNineTypeSheet` props 539-544)
- Modify: `src/components/rounds/ViewRound/RoundDetailsTab/sheets/EditNineTypeSheet.tsx` (props 33-38; destructure 114-119; `handleSelect` 188-197; helper 222-224; options 226-247)
- Test: `src/components/rounds/ViewRound/RoundDetailsTab/RoundDetailsTab.test.tsx` (new describe before `describe('Snapshots')`, after B9c's `describe('Ended-early label')`)
- Create: `src/components/rounds/ViewRound/RoundDetailsTab/sheets/EditNineTypeSheet.test.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `Round.holes_played` (B1b).
- Produces: `EditNineTypeSheetProps.holesPlayed?: number | null`.

**Why.** Once `rounds.holes_played` is set, changing `nine_type` would pair N with a different nine: holes 10–15 for a round that played 1–6. The RPC's CHECK (`holes_played < planned`) could also refuse it. So the Holes row stops opening the sheet, and the sheet refuses the change as a belt. There is no local record (R15): an offline end becomes visible here once the queued `'end_early'` item drains (see Follow-ups).

Not on the CLAUDE.md scoring-guard list.

Runs **before B9f**: B9f consumes this task's `statsFixtures.ts`, the `holes_played` selects, the per-card `endedEarly` locals and `endedEarlySummaries`.

**Files:**
- Modify: `src/hooks/playerStatistics/advancedHelpers.ts:106-189`: `calculateBunkerStats` / `calculateHazardStats` gain an optional `roundAverageScores` parameter.
- Modify: `src/hooks/playerStatistics/queries.ts`:
  - `:15`: import.
  - `:113-116`: select `holes_played`.
  - `:239-240`, `:255-256`, `:275-276`: accumulators.
  - `:314-317`: `endedEarly`.
  - `:375-379`: putts.
  - `:397-410`: enriched scores.
  - `:438-441`: bucket.
  - `:482-483`: trends.
  - `:625-630`: per-hole average.
  - `:659`: recent rounds.
  - `:664-668`: putts per round.
  - `:700-701`: bunker/hazard.
- Create: `src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/statsFixtures.ts` (shared rows and a query stub; not a test file — `jest.config.js` `testMatch` only picks up `*.test.ts(x)`)
- Create: `src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/advancedHelpers.test.ts`
- Create: `src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/usePlayerStatistics.endedEarly.test.tsx`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `isEndedEarly(round: { holes_played?: number | null } | null | undefined): boolean` (B2, `src/utils/roundShape.ts`);
  - the `rounds.holes_played` column (B1a) and `Round.holes_played` (B1b).
- Produces:
  - `calculateBunkerStats(allScores: EnrichedHoleScore[], roundsPlayed: number, roundAverageScores?: EnrichedHoleScore[]): BunkerStats`;
  - `calculateHazardStats(allScores: EnrichedHoleScore[], roundsPlayed: number, roundAverageScores?: EnrichedHoleScore[]): HazardStats`.

  Omitting `roundAverageScores` gives output identical to today. When it is passed, the per-round average is `null` ("—") unless some hole in `roundAverageScores` tracked the stat, so rounds that are left out can't turn "not tracked" into a 0.
- Produces for B10a-2 and B9f:
  - `statsFixtures.ts` exports `PLAYER_ID`, `COURSE_ID`, `range`, `buildStatsCard` (its `putts` is optional: omitted = not tracked), `FULL_CARD`, `NINE_CARD`, `ENDED_EARLY_CARD`, `UNTRACKED_FULL_CARD`, `STATS_CARDS`, `resolvingQuery`;
  - in `queries.ts`: the per-card local `const endedEarly = isEndedEarly(round);`, declared right after the `if (!round || !course) return;` guard and before `isStandaloneRound`; and the `endedEarlySummaries` list feeding `recentRounds`.

**Rules (spec §3 Stats and R11).** An early-ended card (`rounds.holes_played != null`):
- **counts** in `roundsPlayed`;
- **keeps** every per-hole stat: distribution, par-type stats, FIR/GIR, putts per hole, and the bunker/hazard per-hole totals;
- is **excluded** from:
  - the 18-hole and 9-hole buckets (average/best/worst, YTD, course bests, `nineHoleRoundsPlayed`, `averageNineHoleScore`, `bestNineHoleRound`);
  - `perRoundStats` → `roundTrends`;
  - putts per round (numerator and denominator);
  - the bunker/hazard per-round averages;
  - the "is this stat tracked?" checks of those per-round averages: when only ended-early rounds recorded putts / bunker shots / hazards, the average is `null` ("—"), not 0;
- **adds** its gross to the per-hole-average numerator through its own accumulator (its holes are already in the denominator);
- **appears** in `recentRounds` through its own summaries list.

Every "Current" snippet below was re-checked against the rebased `main`; none moved. The handicap/practice classification of an ended-early round is B9f's job, not this task's.

```ts
// src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/advancedHelpers.test.ts
import {
  calculateBunkerStats,
  calculateHazardStats,
  type EnrichedHoleScore,
} from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/advancedHelpers';

function hole(overrides: Partial<EnrichedHoleScore> = {}): EnrichedHoleScore {
  return {
    strokes: 4,
    par: 4,
    gir: null,
    putts: null,
    fairwayHit: null,
    fairwayMissDirection: undefined,
    greenMissDirection: undefined,
    bunkerShots: undefined,
    hazards: undefined,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe('calculateBunkerStats', () => {
  const holes = [hole({ bunkerShots: 2 }), hole({ bunkerShots: 0 }), hole({ bunkerShots: 1 })];

  it('averages bunker shots over every round by default (locks current behaviour)', () => {
    const stats = calculateBunkerStats(holes, 2);
    expect(stats.totalBunkerShots).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBe(1.5);
    expect(stats.holesWithBunkersPercentage).toBe(66.7);
  });

  it('takes the per-round numerator from the round-average holes only', () => {
    const stats = calculateBunkerStats(holes, 1, [holes[1]]);
    expect(stats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBe(0);
    // Per-hole figures still span every hole.
    expect(stats.totalBunkerShots).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.holesWithBunkersPercentage).toBe(66.7);
  });

  it('returns a null per-round average when no round is eligible', () => {
    expect(calculateBunkerStats(holes, 0, []).averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBeNull();
  });

  it('returns a null per-round average when only left-out rounds tracked bunkers', () => {
    // One eligible round that didn't track bunkers; the tracked holes are all left out.
    const stats = calculateBunkerStats(holes, 1, [hole()]);
    expect(stats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBeNull();
    expect(stats.totalBunkerShots).toBe(3);
  });
});

describe('calculateHazardStats', () => {
  const holes = [
    hole({ hazards: [{ type: 'water' }, { type: 'ob' }] }),
    hole({ hazards: [] }),
    hole({ hazards: [{ type: 'lateral' }] }),
  ];

  it('averages hazards over every round by default (locks current behaviour)', () => {
    const stats = calculateHazardStats(holes, 2);
    expect(stats.totalHazards).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBe(1.5);
  });

  it('takes the per-round numerator from the round-average holes only', () => {
    const stats = calculateHazardStats(holes, 1, [holes[1]]);
    expect(stats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBe(0);
    expect(stats.totalHazards).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.holesWithHazards).toBe(2);
  });

  it('returns a null per-round average when only left-out rounds tracked hazards', () => {
    const stats = calculateHazardStats(holes, 1, [hole()]);
    expect(stats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBeNull();
    expect(stats.totalHazards).toBe(3);
  });
});
```

In `src/hooks/playerStatistics/advancedHelpers.ts`, replace lines 106-132:

```ts
/**
 * Calculate bunker statistics
 */
export function calculateBunkerStats(
  allScores: EnrichedHoleScore[],
  roundsPlayed: number
): BunkerStats {
  let totalBunkerShots = 0;
  let holesWithBunkers = 0;
  let totalHolesTracked = 0;

  for (const score of allScores) {
    if (typeof score.bunkerShots === 'number') {
      totalHolesTracked++;
      totalBunkerShots += score.bunkerShots;
      if (score.bunkerShots > 0) holesWithBunkers++;
    }
  }

  return {
    totalBunkerShots,
    holesWithBunkers,
    totalHolesTracked,
    averageBunkerShotsPerRound:
      roundsPlayed > 0 && totalHolesTracked > 0
        ? Math.round((totalBunkerShots / roundsPlayed) * 10) / 10
        : null,
```

with:

```ts
/**
 * Calculate bunker statistics
 *
 * @param allScores - every hole score; drives the per-hole figures.
 * @param roundsPlayed - rounds in the per-round average's denominator.
 * @param roundAverageScores - hole scores feeding the per-round numerator.
 *   Defaults to `allScores`. Callers pass a subset (with a matching
 *   `roundsPlayed`) to keep early-ended rounds out of the per-round average.
 */
export function calculateBunkerStats(
  allScores: EnrichedHoleScore[],
  roundsPlayed: number,
  roundAverageScores: EnrichedHoleScore[] = allScores
): BunkerStats {
  let totalBunkerShots = 0;
  let holesWithBunkers = 0;
  let totalHolesTracked = 0;

  for (const score of allScores) {
    if (typeof score.bunkerShots === 'number') {
      totalHolesTracked++;
      totalBunkerShots += score.bunkerShots;
      if (score.bunkerShots > 0) holesWithBunkers++;
    }
  }

  // The per-round average reads only roundAverageScores, including its
  // "tracked" check: holes from left-out rounds can't turn "not tracked" into 0.
  let roundAverageBunkerShots = 0;
  let roundAverageHolesTracked = 0;
  for (const score of roundAverageScores) {
    if (typeof score.bunkerShots === 'number') {
      roundAverageHolesTracked++;
      roundAverageBunkerShots += score.bunkerShots;
    }
  }

  return {
    totalBunkerShots,
    holesWithBunkers,
    totalHolesTracked,
    averageBunkerShotsPerRound:
      roundsPlayed > 0 && roundAverageHolesTracked > 0
        ? Math.round((roundAverageBunkerShots / roundsPlayed) * 10) / 10
        : null,
```

With the default `roundAverageScores = allScores`, `roundAverageHolesTracked === totalHolesTracked` and the output is unchanged.

```ts
// src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/statsFixtures.ts
/**
 * Scorecard rows shared by the player/course statistics hook tests: a full
 * 18, a 9-hole round and a social round ended early after 6 holes — all
 * standalone, completed, on the same course.
 */
import { create18Holes } from '@/__tests__/utils/testFixtures';

export const PLAYER_ID = 'player-1';
export const COURSE_ID = 'course-1';

const HOLES = create18Holes();

export const range = (start: number, end: number): number[] =>
  Array.from({ length: end - start + 1 }, (_, i) => start + i);

interface StatsCardOptions {
  id: string;
  date: string;
  holeNumbers: number[];
  strokes: number;
  /** Putts recorded on every hole (omitted = not tracked). */
  putts?: number;
  /** Bunker shots recorded on every hole (omitted = not tracked). */
  bunkerShots?: number;
  /** Record a hazards array on every hole (empty except hole 1 when hazardOnFirstHole). */
  trackHazards?: boolean;
  hazardOnFirstHole?: boolean;
  holesPlayed: number | null;
  points: number;
}

export function buildStatsCard(opts: StatsCardOptions) {
  const scores: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
  opts.holeNumbers.forEach((n, index) => {
    scores[String(n)] = {
      strokes: opts.strokes,
      ...(opts.putts !== undefined && { putts: opts.putts }),
      ...(opts.bunkerShots !== undefined && { bunkerShots: opts.bunkerShots }),
      ...(opts.trackHazards && {
        hazards: opts.hazardOnFirstHole && index === 0 ? [{ type: 'water' }] : [],
      }),
    };
  });
  return {
    id: opts.id,
    round_id: `round-${opts.id}`,
    player_id: PLAYER_ID,
    scores,
    total_gross: opts.strokes * opts.holeNumbers.length,
    total_net: 0,
    total_points: opts.points,
    status: 'completed',
    submitted_at: `${opts.date}T08:00:00Z`,
    rounds: {
      id: `round-${opts.id}`,
      competition_id: null,
      round_number: 1,
      course_id: COURSE_ID,
      date: opts.date,
      game_type: 'stroke',
      team_format: null,
      handicap_source: 'profile',
      status: 'completed',
      holes_played: opts.holesPlayed,
      courses: {
        id: COURSE_ID,
        name: 'Test Course',
        holes: HOLES,
        clubs: { id: 'club-1', name: 'Test Club' },
      },
      competitions: null,
    },
  };
}

/** 18 holes × 5 = 90; 2 putts and 0 bunker shots per hole; hazards tracked, none. */
export const FULL_CARD = buildStatsCard({
  id: 'full', date: '2026-09-01', holeNumbers: range(1, 18), strokes: 5, putts: 2,
  bunkerShots: 0, trackHazards: true, holesPlayed: null, points: 30,
});

/** 9 holes × 5 = 45; 2 putts per hole; bunkers/hazards not tracked. */
export const NINE_CARD = buildStatsCard({
  id: 'nine', date: '2026-09-05', holeNumbers: range(1, 9), strokes: 5, putts: 2,
  holesPlayed: null, points: 15,
});

/** Ended early after 6 holes: 6 × 4 = 24; 1 putt and 1 bunker shot per hole; water on hole 1. */
export const ENDED_EARLY_CARD = buildStatsCard({
  id: 'ended', date: '2026-09-10', holeNumbers: range(1, 6), strokes: 4, putts: 1,
  bunkerShots: 1, trackHazards: true, hazardOnFirstHole: true, holesPlayed: 6, points: 12,
});

export const STATS_CARDS = [FULL_CARD, NINE_CARD, ENDED_EARLY_CARD];

/** 18 holes × 5 = 90 with no putts, bunkers or hazards tracked. */
export const UNTRACKED_FULL_CARD = buildStatsCard({
  id: 'untracked', date: '2026-09-01', holeNumbers: range(1, 18), strokes: 5,
  holesPlayed: null, points: 30,
});

/** supabase.from() stub: every chain method passes through; awaiting resolves `result`. */
export function resolvingQuery(result: { data: unknown; error: unknown }) {
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  const passthrough = () => chain;
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'in', 'is', 'not', 'order', 'limit']) {
    chain[method] = passthrough;
  }
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(result).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}
```

```tsx
// src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/usePlayerStatistics.endedEarly.test.tsx
/**
 * usePlayerStatistics — early-ended social rounds (rounds.holes_played set).
 *
 * An early-ended round counts as a round played and feeds every per-hole
 * metric, but stays out of every per-round aggregate: the 18- and 9-hole
 * buckets, the trend sparkline and the per-round putts / bunker / hazard
 * averages. It still shows in recent rounds.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { usePlayerStatistics } from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/queries';
import type { PlayerStatistics } from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/types';
import { ENDED_EARLY_CARD, PLAYER_ID, STATS_CARDS, UNTRACKED_FULL_CARD, resolvingQuery } from './statsFixtures';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
}));

function makeWrapper() {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  return function Wrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

async function loadStats(cards: unknown[] = STATS_CARDS): Promise<PlayerStatistics> {
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) =>
    resolvingQuery(
      table === 'scorecards' ? { data: cards, error: null } : { data: [], error: null },
    ),
  );
  const { result } = renderHook(() => usePlayerStatistics(PLAYER_ID), { wrapper: makeWrapper() });
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
  return result.current.data!;
}

describe('usePlayerStatistics — early-ended rounds', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockFrom.mockReset();
  });

  it('counts the early-ended round and its holes in every per-hole stat (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats();

    expect(stats.roundsPlayed).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.holesPlayed).toBe(33);
    expect(stats.averageGrossScore).toBe(90);
    // (90 + 45 + 24) / 33 holes
    expect(stats.averageScorePerHole).toBe(4.82);
    // 60 putts / 33 holes
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerHole).toBe(1.82);
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.totalBunkerShots).toBe(6);
    expect(stats.hazardStats.totalHazards).toBe(1);
    expect(stats.recentRounds.map((r) => r.roundId)).toEqual([
      'round-ended',
      'round-nine',
      'round-full',
    ]);
  });

  it('keeps the early-ended round out of the 9-hole bucket', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats();

    // Before: 2 rounds / 34.5 / 'round-ended' — the 6-hole card was bucketed as a 9-hole round.
    expect(stats.nineHoleRoundsPlayed).toBe(1);
    expect(stats.averageNineHoleScore).toBe(45);
    expect(stats.bestNineHoleRound?.roundId).toBe('round-nine');
  });

  it('keeps the early-ended round out of the trend sparkline', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats();

    expect(stats.roundTrends.map((t) => t.roundId)).toEqual(['round-full', 'round-nine']);
  });

  it('leaves the early-ended round out of the per-round putts, bunker and hazard averages', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats();

    // Before: 60 / 3 = 20, 6 / 3 = 2, 1 / 3 = 0.3.
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerRound).toBe(27); // (60 − 6) / 2
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBe(0);
    expect(stats.hazardStats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBe(0);
  });

  it('shows no per-round average ("—") when only the early-ended round tracked the stat', async () => {
    const stats = await loadStats([UNTRACKED_FULL_CARD, ENDED_EARLY_CARD]);

    // Before: 3 / 3 / 0.5 (every round in the average). Excluding the ended
    // round without also excluding it from the "tracked" check would give 0.
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerRound).toBeNull();
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBeNull();
    expect(stats.hazardStats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBeNull();
    // Per-hole figures still use the ended card's holes.
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerHole).toBe(1);
  });
});
```

```tsx
// src/__tests__/hooks/playerStatistics/useCourseStatistics.endedEarly.test.tsx
/**
 * useCourseStatistics — early-ended social rounds follow the same rules as
 * usePlayerStatistics: counted and in every per-hole stat, out of every
 * per-round aggregate, still in recent rounds.
 */
import React from 'react';
import { renderHook, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react-native';
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from '@tanstack/react-query';
import { useCourseStatistics } from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/courseQueries';
import type { CourseStatisticsData } from '@/hooks/playerStatistics/types';
import {
  COURSE_ID,
  ENDED_EARLY_CARD,
  PLAYER_ID,
  STATS_CARDS,
  UNTRACKED_FULL_CARD,
  resolvingQuery,
} from './statsFixtures';

const mockFrom = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (...args: unknown[]) => mockFrom(...args) },
}));

function makeWrapper() {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  return function Wrapper({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

async function loadCourseStats(cards: unknown[] = STATS_CARDS): Promise<CourseStatisticsData> {
  mockFrom.mockImplementation(() => resolvingQuery({ data: cards, error: null }));
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useCourseStatistics(PLAYER_ID, COURSE_ID), {
    wrapper: makeWrapper(),
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
  return result.current.data!;
}

describe('useCourseStatistics — early-ended rounds', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockFrom.mockReset();
  });

  it('counts the early-ended round and its holes in every per-hole stat (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    const stats = await loadCourseStats();

    expect(stats.timesPlayed).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.averageGrossScore).toBe(90);
    expect(stats.bestGrossScore).toBe(90);
    expect(stats.averageScorePerHole).toBe(4.82);
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerHole).toBe(1.82);
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.totalBunkerShots).toBe(6);
    expect(stats.holeStats.find((h) => h.holeNumber === 1)?.timesPlayed).toBe(3);
    expect(stats.recentRounds.map((r) => r.roundId)).toEqual([
      'round-ended',
      'round-nine',
      'round-full',
    ]);
  });

  it('keeps the early-ended round out of the trend sparkline', async () => {
    const stats = await loadCourseStats();

    expect(stats.roundTrends.map((t) => t.roundId)).toEqual(['round-full', 'round-nine']);
  });

  it('leaves the early-ended round out of the per-round putts, bunker and hazard averages', async () => {
    const stats = await loadCourseStats();

    // Before: 20, 2, 0.3.
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerRound).toBe(27);
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBe(0);
    expect(stats.hazardStats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBe(0);
  });

  it('shows no per-round average ("—") when only the early-ended round tracked the stat', async () => {
    const stats = await loadCourseStats([UNTRACKED_FULL_CARD, ENDED_EARLY_CARD]);

    // Before: 3 / 3 / 0.5 (the ended card's 6 putts, 6 bunker shots, 1 hazard over 2 rounds).
    expect(stats.averagePuttsPerRound).toBeNull();
    expect(stats.bunkerStats.averageBunkerShotsPerRound).toBeNull();
    expect(stats.hazardStats.averageHazardsPerRound).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });

    return <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>;
  };
}

function byRoundId(rounds: RoundSummary[]): Record<string, RoundSummary> {
  return Object.fromEntries(rounds.map((r) => [r.roundId, r]));
}

async function loadPlayerStats(cards: unknown[]) {
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) =>
    resolvingQuery(table === 'scorecards' ? { data: cards, error: null } : { data: [], error: null }),
  );
  const { result } = renderHook(() => usePlayerStatistics(PLAYER_ID), { wrapper: makeWrapper() });
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
  return result.current.data!;
}

async function loadCourseStats(cards: unknown[]) {
  mockFrom.mockImplementation(() => resolvingQuery({ data: cards, error: null }));
  const { result } = renderHook(() => useCourseStatistics(PLAYER_ID, COURSE_ID), {
    wrapper: makeWrapper(),
  });
  await waitFor(() => expect(result.current.isSuccess).toBe(true));
  return result.current.data!;
}

describe('stats — ended-early round shape on recent rounds', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockFrom.mockReset();
  });

  it('carries the round shape on usePlayerStatistics summaries', async () => {
    const stats = await loadPlayerStats(CARDS);
    const recent = byRoundId(stats.recentRounds);

    expect(recent['round-ended']).toMatchObject({ roundHolesPlayed: 6, nineType: 'full' });
    expect(recent['round-back9']).toMatchObject({ roundHolesPlayed: 6, nineType: 'back9' });
    expect(recent['round-full']).toMatchObject({ roundHolesPlayed: null });
    expect(recentRoundEndedEarlyLabel(recent['round-back9'])).toBe('Ended after 6 of 9');
    expect(recentRoundEndedEarlyLabel(recent['round-full'])).toBeNull();
  });

  it('carries the round shape on useCourseStatistics summaries', async () => {
    const stats = await loadCourseStats(CARDS);
    const recent = byRoundId(stats.recentRounds);

    expect(recent['round-ended']).toMatchObject({ roundHolesPlayed: 6, nineType: 'full' });
    expect(recent['round-back9']).toMatchObject({ roundHolesPlayed: 6, nineType: 'back9' });
    expect(recent['round-nine']).toMatchObject({ roundHolesPlayed: null });
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Recent-rounds helpers for rounds ended early (rounds.holes_played).
 *
 * Ended-early rounds stay in the "Recent rounds" lists with an
 * "Ended after N of M" label, but they are kept out of the score-trend charts:
 * a 6-hole gross would otherwise plot as a career-best round.
 */

import { formatEndedEarlyLabel } from '@/utils/roundShape';
import type { RoundSummary } from './types';

export function recentRoundEndedEarlyLabel(
  round: Pick<RoundSummary, 'roundHolesPlayed' | 'nineType'>
): string | null {
  return round.roundHolesPlayed != null
    ? formatEndedEarlyLabel(round.roundHolesPlayed, round.nineType ?? 'full')
    : null;
}

export function excludeEndedEarly<T extends Pick<RoundSummary, 'roundHolesPlayed'>>(
  rounds: T[]
): T[] {
  return rounds.filter((r) => r.roundHolesPlayed == null);
}
```

- Test: `src/components/rounds/RoundListCard/RoundListCard.test.tsx` (new case after the `"Handicap Round"` case, which ends at line 321)
- Modify: `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/hooks/useViewRoundHandlers.ts:10` (import) and `:209-211` (`getHeaderTitle`, the solo standalone title)
- Create: `src/screens/rounds/ViewRoundScreen/hooks/useViewRoundHandlers.test.tsx`
- Modify: `src/screens/rounds/RoundSettingsScreen.tsx:51` (import) and `:141-143` (`derivedRoundTitle`, the same title)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - the per-card `endedEarly` locals in `queries.ts` / `courseQueries.ts` (B10a-1 / B10a-2);
  - `RoundListCardData.holesPlayed?: number | null` (B9a; `RoundItem` re-exports it);
  - `isEndedEarly(round)` (B2) and `Round.holes_played` (B1b; `RoundWithCourse` extends `Round`);
  - `statsFixtures.ts` (`STATS_CARDS`, `resolvingQuery`, `PLAYER_ID`, `COURSE_ID`; B10a-1).
- Produces: no new exports. `RoundSummary.isHandicapRound` / `isPracticeRound`, `handicapRoundsPlayed` / `practiceRoundsPlayed`, the Rounds-list filters and the solo standalone round title (ViewRound header, round-settings name placeholder) change for ended-early rounds only.

**Rules (spec R20, R21, R22).**
- Ended-early rows don't carry the "Handicap" badge (`RecentRoundRow.tsx:109`) and aren't counted in `handicapRoundsPlayed` (`queries.ts:333-335`). They are **Practice** rounds (not tracked for handicap), so Practice + Handicap + Competition still add up to Rounds Played.
- The My Stats tiles tap through to the Rounds-list filters (`OverviewStats.tsx:114,132,141` → `AllRounds` `initialFilter`). The `practice` / `handicap` / `ninehole` filters treat ended-early rounds as the tiles count them: Practice yes, Handicap no, 9-Hole no (B10a keeps them out of `nineHoleRoundsPlayed`).
- The round-list card's subtitle, the ViewRound header title and the round-settings title (the name placeholder) read "Practice Round", not "Handicap Round" (spec R22). The header and settings titles apply only to a solo standalone round with no custom name; a competition round can't be ended early.

Every fixture card in `statsFixtures.ts` is a standalone round with `handicap_source: 'profile'`, so before this task all three of `STATS_CARDS` are "Handicap" rounds.

```tsx
import type { RootStackParamList } from '@/navigation/types';
import type { RoundWithCourse } from '@/hooks/useRoundDetails';

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({ supabase: { from: jest.fn() } }));

import { useViewRoundHandlers } from './useViewRoundHandlers';

// Minimal round factory — only the fields getHeaderTitle reads matter.
function makeRound(overrides: Partial<RoundWithCourse> = {}): RoundWithCourse {
  return {
    id: 'round-1',
    name: null,
    competition_id: null,
    status: 'completed',
    nine_type: 'full',
    handicap_source: 'profile',
    holes_played: null,
    ...overrides,
  } as unknown as RoundWithCourse;
}

function headerTitle(round: RoundWithCourse) {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient();
  const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
    <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>{children}</QueryClientProvider>
  );
  const noop = jest.fn();
  const { result } = renderHook(
    () =>
      useViewRoundHandlers({
        roundId: 'round-1',
        navigation: {} as NativeStackNavigationProp<RootStackParamList, 'ViewRound'>,
        isStandalone: true,
        isMatchPlayRound: false,
        isTeamMatchPlayRound: false,
        hasSkinsGame: false,
        hasWolfGame: false,
        round,
        scorecards: [],
        roundPlayers: [{ id: 'player-1' }],
        refetchRound: noop,
        refetchScorecards: noop,
        refetchPlayers: noop,
        refetchMatchPlay: noop,
        refetchSkinsResults: noop,
        refetchSkinsGame: noop,
        refetchWolfSummary: noop,
        setShowCourseModal: noop,
        setCourseSearchQuery: noop,
        setShowTagLeagueSheet: noop,
      }),
    { wrapper },
  );
  return result.current.getHeaderTitle();
}

describe('useViewRoundHandlers — solo round header title', () => {
  it('titles a solo round by its handicap source (locks current behaviour)', () => {
    expect(headerTitle(makeRound())).toBe('Handicap Round');
    expect(headerTitle(makeRound({ handicap_source: 'none' }))).toBe('Practice Round');
  });

  it('titles a solo handicap round that was ended early "Practice Round"', () => {
    // Before: 'Handicap Round'.
    expect(headerTitle(makeRound({ holes_played: 6 }))).toBe('Practice Round');
  });
});
```

```ts
function filterByType(rounds: RoundItem[], filter: RoundTypeFilter): RoundItem[] {
  if (filter === 'all') return rounds;

  return rounds.filter((round) => {
    switch (filter) {
      case 'skins':
        return round.hasSkins === true;
      case 'wolf':
        return round.hasWolf === true;
      case 'match':
        return !round.hasSkins && !round.hasWolf && round.players && round.players.length > 1;
      case 'matchplay':
        return round.gameType === 'match-play';
      case 'practice':
        // Practice = round not tracked for handicap (source 'none'), matching the
        // "Practice" breakdown card in My Stats.
        return round.handicapSource === 'none';
      case 'handicap':
        // Handicap = round tracked for handicap (any source other than 'none';
        // a null source defaults to 'profile'), matching the "Handicap" card.
        return round.handicapSource !== 'none';
      case 'ninehole':
        return (
          round.nineType === 'front9' || round.nineType === 'back9' || round.totalHoles === 9
        );
      default:
        return true;
    }
  });
}
```
Replace with:
```ts
function filterByType(rounds: RoundItem[], filter: RoundTypeFilter): RoundItem[] {
  if (filter === 'all') return rounds;

  return rounds.filter((round) => {
    // A round ended early (rounds.holes_played set) never counts toward the
    // handicap index, so — like the My Stats tiles — it is Practice, never
    // Handicap, and never a 9-hole round.
    const endedEarly = round.holesPlayed != null;
    switch (filter) {
      case 'skins':
        return round.hasSkins === true;
      case 'wolf':
        return round.hasWolf === true;
      case 'match':
        return !round.hasSkins && !round.hasWolf && round.players && round.players.length > 1;
      case 'matchplay':
        return round.gameType === 'match-play';
      case 'practice':
        // Practice = round not tracked for handicap (source 'none', or ended
        // early), matching the "Practice" breakdown card in My Stats.
        return round.handicapSource === 'none' || endedEarly;
      case 'handicap':
        // Handicap = round tracked for handicap (any source other than 'none';
        // a null source defaults to 'profile'), matching the "Handicap" card.
        return round.handicapSource !== 'none' && !endedEarly;
      case 'ninehole':
        return (
          !endedEarly &&
          (round.nineType === 'front9' || round.nineType === 'back9' || round.totalHoles === 9)
        );
      default:
        return true;
    }
  });
}
```

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes:
  - `useScorecardStore.getState().holesPlayed: number | null` (B3b);
  - `isEndedEarly(round)` (B2);
  - the `rounds.holes_played` column (B1a) and `Round.holes_played` (B1b), so the typed `rounds!inner(… holes_played …)` select resolves.
- Produces:
  - `buildRoundAchievementEventData(params: RoundAchievementEventParams): AchievementEventData`, where `RoundAchievementEventParams = { roundId: string; gameType: string; courseId: string | undefined; isCompetition: boolean; scoreStats: RoundAchievementScoreStats; totalNet: number | undefined; endedEarly?: boolean }` and `RoundAchievementScoreStats` mirrors `calculateScoreStats`'s return;

**Rules (spec §3, R11).**
- The achievement event for an ended-early round omits `gross_score` and `net_score` (so `LOW_SCORER` and `NET_MASTER` skip it) **and `hole_count`**. `18_HOLES_OF_GLORY` / `NINE_HOLE_SPECIALIST` read only `hole_count` (`src/services/achievements/progressCalculation.ts:160-167`, `=== 18` / `=== 9`), so an 18-hole round ended after exactly 9 must not advance the 9-hole achievement. `ROUND_VETERAN`, `PRACTICE_MAKES_PERFECT`, `COMPETITOR` and the course achievements don't read `hole_count` and still count the round.
- League tagging (`getEligibleScorecards`) never offers a card whose round has `holes_played` set: filtered in the query (`.is('rounds.holes_played', null)`) and, as a belt, on the returned rows.

```ts
/**
 * Round-achievement event payload for a submitted scorecard.
 *
 * Extracted from useScoreSubmission.checkRoundAchievements so the payload
 * rules are unit-testable without the submit hook.
 */
import type { AchievementEventData } from '@/types/database/achievement.types';

/** Per-scorecard counts gathered by useScoreSubmission's calculateScoreStats. */
export interface RoundAchievementScoreStats {
  birdies: number;
  eagles: number;
  pars: number;
  bogeys: number;
  doubleBogeys: number;
  albatross: number;
  holeInOne: boolean;
  totalGross: number;
  /** Holes actually scored on the card. */
  holesPlayed: number;
}

export interface RoundAchievementEventParams {
  roundId: string;
  gameType: string;
  courseId: string | undefined;
  isCompetition: boolean;
  scoreStats: RoundAchievementScoreStats;
  /** The store's live net total (stableford overloads it with points). */
  totalNet: number | undefined;
}

export function buildRoundAchievementEventData(
  params: RoundAchievementEventParams,
): AchievementEventData {
  const { roundId, gameType, courseId, isCompetition, scoreStats, totalNet } = params;
  return {
    round_id: roundId,
    game_type: gameType,
    course_id: courseId,
    is_competition: isCompetition,
    hole_count: scoreStats.holesPlayed,
    gross_score: scoreStats.totalGross,
    net_score: totalNet || undefined,
    birdies: scoreStats.birdies,
    eagles: scoreStats.eagles,
    albatrosses: scoreStats.albatross,
    pars: scoreStats.pars,
    bogeys: scoreStats.bogeys,
    double_bogeys: scoreStats.doubleBogeys,
    hole_in_one: scoreStats.holeInOne,
  };
}
```

```ts
export function buildRoundAchievementEventData(
  params: RoundAchievementEventParams,
): AchievementEventData {
  const { roundId, gameType, courseId, isCompetition, scoreStats, totalNet, endedEarly = false } = params;
  return {
    round_id: roundId,
    game_type: gameType,
    course_id: courseId,
    is_competition: isCompetition,
    // 18_HOLES_OF_GLORY / NINE_HOLE_SPECIALIST read only hole_count (=== 18 /
    // === 9). An early-ended round counts towards neither — not even an

    hole_count: endedEarly ? undefined : scoreStats.holesPlayed,
    // A short total would trip the score-threshold achievements (LOW_SCORER on
    // gross, NET_MASTER on net), so an early-ended round sends neither.
    gross_score: endedEarly ? undefined : scoreStats.totalGross,
    net_score: endedEarly ? undefined : totalNet || undefined,
```

```ts
/**
 * The scoring-store fields useScoreSubmission.checkRoundAchievements reads.
 * Separate from roundAchievementEvent.ts so the payload builder's tests don't
 * load the store.
 */
import { useScorecardStore } from '@/store/scorecardStore';

type ScorecardStoreState = ReturnType<typeof useScorecardStore.getState>;

export interface RoundAchievementStoreInputs {
  holes: ScorecardStoreState['holes'];
  gameType: ScorecardStoreState['gameType'];
  userScorecard: ReturnType<ScorecardStoreState['groupScorecards']['get']>;
  /** The round was ended early (store holesPlayed set, B3b). */
  endedEarly: boolean;
}

export function readRoundAchievementStore(playerId: string): RoundAchievementStoreInputs {
  const { holes, gameType, groupScorecards, holesPlayed } = useScorecardStore.getState();
  return {
    holes,
    gameType,
    userScorecard: groupScorecards.get(playerId),
    // resetRound clears holesPlayed only after checkRoundAchievements has run.
    endedEarly: holesPlayed != null,
  };
}
```

`calculateScoreStats(userScorecard, storeHoles)` iterates the planned holes, but `endRoundEarly` (B3b) removes every score after N. So `holesPlayed` / `totalGross` are already the played-hole figures and need no change.

`hole_count` is omitted for an ended-early round, so neither `18_HOLES_OF_GLORY` nor `NINE_HOLE_SPECIALIST` (`progressCalculation.ts:160-167`, the only readers of `hole_count`) advances — including an 18-hole round ended after exactly 9. This refines spec R11 ("hole_count = holes played"); `ROUND_VETERAN` and the course achievements still count the round.

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/api/leagueQueries.test.ts
/**
 * getEligibleScorecards — early-ended rounds are never offered for league

const mockGetUser = jest.fn();
const mockFrom = jest.fn();

import { getEligibleScorecards } from '@/services/api/leagues/queries';

type Call = { method: string; args: unknown[] };

/** Chainable + thenable stub that records every call. */
function recordingQuery(result: { data: unknown; error: unknown }, calls: Call[]) {
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'in', 'is', 'not', 'order']) {
    chain[method] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      calls.push({ method, args });
      return chain;
    };
  }
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(result).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}

function eligibleRow(id: string, holesPlayed: number | null) {

    id,
    round_id: `round-${id}`,
    player_id: 'user-1',

    total_gross: 90,
    rounds: {
      date: '2026-09-10',
      course_id: 'course-1',
      holes_played: holesPlayed,
      courses: { name: 'Test Course' },
    },
  };
}

let scorecardCalls: Call[] = [];

function wireTables(rows: unknown[]) {
  scorecardCalls = [];
  mockFrom.mockImplementation((table: string) =>
    table === 'scorecards'
      ? recordingQuery({ data: rows, error: null }, scorecardCalls)
      : recordingQuery({ data: [], error: null }, []),
  );
}

describe('getEligibleScorecards — early-ended rounds', () => {

    jest.clearAllMocks();

  });

    ]);
  });

  it('filters early-ended rounds out in the query', async () => {
    wireTables([]);

    await getEligibleScorecards('league-1');

    const select = scorecardCalls.find((c) => c.method === 'select');
    expect(String(select?.args[0])).toContain('holes_played');
    expect(scorecardCalls).toContainEqual({ method: 'is', args: ['rounds.holes_played', null] });
  });

    const eligible = await getEligibleScorecards('league-1');

    expect(eligible.map((s) => s.id)).toEqual(['sc-full']);
  });
});
```

```ts

// =====================================================
// ELIGIBLE SCORECARDS (tagging flow)
// =====================================================

/** A completed scorecard that can be tagged to a partnership league. */
export interface PartnershipEligibleCard {
  id: string;
  playerId: string;
  totalGross: number;
  courseName: string;
  courseId: string | null;
  courseRating: number | null;
  slopeRating: number | null;
  par: number | null;
  datePlayed: string | null;
  dailyHandicap: number | null;
}

/**
 * Completed scorecards for the given players, newest first, for the
 * TagPartnershipRound flow. Throws the PostgREST error on failure.
 */
export async function getPartnershipEligibleCards(
  playerIds: string[]
): Promise<PartnershipEligibleCard[]> {
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('scorecards')
    .select(`
      id, player_id, total_gross, status, daily_handicap_used,
      course_rating_used, slope_rating_used,
      rounds!inner ( date, course_id, par, courses ( name ) )
    `)
    .in('player_id', playerIds)
    .in('status', ['completed', 'confirmed'])
    .not('total_gross', 'is', null)
    .is('rounds.deleted_at', null)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false });

  if (error) throw error;

  interface ScorecardRow {
    id: string;
    player_id: string;
    total_gross: number;
    status: string;
    daily_handicap_used: number | null;
    course_rating_used: number | null;
    slope_rating_used: number | null;
    rounds: { date: string | null; course_id: string | null; par: number | null; courses: { name: string } | null };
  }

  return ((data ?? []) as unknown as ScorecardRow[]).map((sc) => ({
    id: sc.id,
    playerId: sc.player_id,
    totalGross: sc.total_gross,
    courseName: sc.rounds?.courses?.name ?? 'Unknown',
    courseId: sc.rounds?.course_id ?? null,
    courseRating: sc.course_rating_used ?? null,
    slopeRating: sc.slope_rating_used ?? null,
    par: sc.rounds?.par ?? null,
    datePlayed: sc.rounds?.date ?? null,
    dailyHandicap: sc.daily_handicap_used ?? null,
  }));
}
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex.endedEarly.test.ts
/**
 * updatePlayerHandicapIndex — early-ended rounds never feed the index.
 *
 * The card gate (A3) and the server trigger (A7/B1a) keep their differentials
 * null; this belt also excludes any round with rounds.holes_played set, in the
 * query and in the loop. Every card has scores: {} (legacy, no per-hole data),
 * so A3's completeness belt passes it and only the holes_played belt decides.
 */

interface RecordedQuery {
  table: string;
  calls: { method: string; args: unknown[] }[];
}

const mockQueries: RecordedQuery[] = [];
const mockResults: Record<string, { data?: unknown; error: unknown }> = {};

/** Chainable + thenable stub recording every call; awaiting resolves mockResults[table]. */
function mockRecordingQuery(table: string) {
  const recorded: RecordedQuery = { table, calls: [] };
  mockQueries.push(recorded);
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'in', 'not', 'is', 'order', 'limit', 'update']) {
    chain[method] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      recorded.calls.push({ method, args });
      return chain;
    };
  }
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(mockResults[table] ?? { data: [], error: null }).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockRecordingQuery(table) },
}));

jest.mock('@/services/queryClient', () => ({
  queryClient: { invalidateQueries: jest.fn() },
}));

jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => ({
  syncLogger: { info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() },
}));

import { updatePlayerHandicapIndex } from '@/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex';

function indexRow(differential: number, date: string, holesPlayed: number | null) {
  return {
    handicap_differential: differential,
    submitted_at: `${date}T08:00:00Z`,
    scores: {},
    rounds: { nine_type: 'full', game_type: 'stroke', team_format: null, holes_played: holesPlayed },
  };
}

function seed(rows: unknown[]) {
  mockQueries.length = 0;
  mockResults.scorecards = { data: rows, error: null };
  mockResults.handicap_combined_rounds = { data: [], error: null };
  // Both the index write and A3-2's clear (`.update().eq().not().select('id')`)
  // resolve this; the clear sees no changed rows and skips invalidation.
  mockResults.players = { data: [], error: null };
}

const scorecardQuery = () => mockQueries.find((q) => q.table === 'scorecards')!;
const indexWritten = () =>
  (mockQueries.find((q) => q.table === 'players')?.calls.find((c) => c.method === 'update')
    ?.args[0] ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>;

describe('updatePlayerHandicapIndex — rounds that ended early', () => {
  it('derives the index from 18-hole differentials (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    seed([indexRow(10, '2026-09-01', null)]);

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    // 1 round → best 1 → 10 × 0.96 = 9.6
    expect(indexWritten().handicap_index).toBe(9.6);
  });

  it('excludes early-ended rounds in the query', async () => {
    seed([]);

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    const select = scorecardQuery().calls.find((c) => c.method === 'select');
    expect(String(select?.args[0])).toContain('holes_played');
    expect(scorecardQuery().calls).toContainEqual({ method: 'is', args: ['rounds.holes_played', null] });
  });

  it('ignores an early-ended differential that slipped through', async () => {
    seed([indexRow(10, '2026-09-01', null), indexRow(-38.4, '2026-09-10', 6)]);

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    // Before: 2 rounds → best 1 → −38.4 × 0.96 = −36.864 → −36.9
    expect(indexWritten().handicap_index).toBe(9.6);
  });

  it('clears the index when an early-ended round was the only one', async () => {
    seed([indexRow(-38.4, '2026-09-10', 6)]);

    await updatePlayerHandicapIndex('player-1');

    // Every row skipped by a belt → A3-2's clearHandicapIndex. Before: −36.9.
    expect(indexWritten().handicap_index).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/fetchHandicapHistory.endedEarly.test.ts
/**
 * fetchHandicapHistory — early-ended rounds stay out of the history, the
 * index shown with it, and the retroactive-recalculation candidates
 * (otherwise the same never-eligible cards would be re-picked every session
 * inside the candidate limit).
 *
 * Every card has scores: {} (legacy, no per-hole data), so A3's completeness
 * belt passes it and only the holes_played belt decides.
 */

interface RecordedQuery {
  table: string;
  calls: { method: string; args: unknown[] }[];
}

const mockQueries: RecordedQuery[] = [];
const mockQueue: Record<string, { data: unknown; error: unknown }[]> = {};

/** Chainable + thenable stub; each from(table) call takes the next queued result. */
function mockRecordingQuery(table: string) {
  const recorded: RecordedQuery = { table, calls: [] };
  mockQueries.push(recorded);
  const result = mockQueue[table]?.shift() ?? { data: [], error: null };
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'in', 'not', 'is', 'order', 'limit']) {
    chain[method] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      recorded.calls.push({ method, args });
      return chain;
    };
  }
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(result).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockRecordingQuery(table) },
}));

const mockRecalculate = jest.fn();
jest.mock('@/services/handicap/recalculateScorecardDifferential', () => ({
  recalculateScorecardDifferential: (...args: unknown[]) => mockRecalculate(...args),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/handicap/loadCombinedAndPairs', () => ({
  fetchCombinedHandicapRounds: () => Promise.resolve([]),
  fetchCombinableNinePairs: () => Promise.resolve([]),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex', () => ({
  updatePlayerHandicapIndex: () => Promise.resolve(),
}));

jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => ({
  syncLogger: { info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() },
}));

import { fetchHandicapHistory } from '@/hooks/player/handicapHistory';

function historyRow(id: string, differential: number, date: string, holesPlayed: number | null) {
  return {
    id,
    player_id: 'player-1',
    round_id: `round-${id}`,
    total_gross: 90,
    daily_handicap_used: 19,
    handicap_differential: differential,
    course_rating_used: 72.5,
    slope_rating_used: 125,
    submitted_at: `${date}T08:00:00Z`,
    scores: {},
    rounds: {
      id: `round-${id}`,
      date,
      nine_type: 'full',
      game_type: 'stroke',
      team_format: null,
      holes_played: holesPlayed,
      courses: { id: 'course-1', name: 'Test Course', clubs: { id: 'club-1', name: 'Test Club' } },
    },
  };
}

/** A recalculation candidate row (null differential) as A3-3's select returns it. */
function candidateRow(id: string, holesPlayed: number | null) {
  return { id, scores: {}, rounds: { nine_type: 'full', holes_played: holesPlayed } };
}

/** Queue results for the scorecards queries in call order: main, recalc candidates, refresh. */
function queueScorecards(...results: unknown[][]) {
  mockQueries.length = 0;
  mockQueue.scorecards = results.map((data) => ({ data, error: null }));
}

const scorecardQueries = () => mockQueries.filter((q) => q.table === 'scorecards');
const selectOf = (q: RecordedQuery) => String(q.calls.find((c) => c.method === 'select')?.args[0] ?? '');
const filtersEarlyEnded = (q: RecordedQuery) =>
  q.calls.some(
    (c) => c.method === 'is' && c.args[0] === 'rounds.holes_played' && c.args[1] === null,
  );

describe('fetchHandicapHistory — rounds that ended early', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    jest.clearAllMocks();
    mockRecalculate.mockResolvedValue({ handicapDifferential: 12 });
  });

  it('lists 18-hole rounds with a differential (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    queueScorecards([historyRow('a', 10, '2026-09-01', null)], []);

    const summary = await fetchHandicapHistory('player-1');

    expect(summary.rounds.map((r) => r.scorecardId)).toEqual(['a']);
    // 10 × 0.96
    expect(summary.handicapIndex).toBe(9.6);
  });

  it('excludes an early-ended round from the history and its index', async () => {
    queueScorecards(
      [historyRow('a', 10, '2026-09-01', null), historyRow('b', -38.4, '2026-09-10', 6)],
      [],
    );

    const summary = await fetchHandicapHistory('player-1');

    expect(filtersEarlyEnded(scorecardQueries()[0])).toBe(true);
    // Before: ['b', 'a'] and an index of −38.4 × 0.96 = −36.9.
    expect(summary.rounds.map((r) => r.scorecardId)).toEqual(['a']);
    expect(summary.handicapIndex).toBe(9.6);
  });

  it('never picks an early-ended card for retroactive recalculation', async () => {
    queueScorecards(
      [],
      [candidateRow('cand-ended-1', 6), candidateRow('cand-legacy-1', null)],
      [],
    );

    await fetchHandicapHistory('player-1');

    const candidates = scorecardQueries()[1];
    expect(selectOf(candidates)).toContain('holes_played');
    expect(filtersEarlyEnded(candidates)).toBe(true);
    // The JS belt drops a row the SQL filter missed.
    expect(mockRecalculate).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    expect(mockRecalculate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('cand-legacy-1');
  });

  it('keeps the early-ended filter on the refreshed history', async () => {
    queueScorecards(
      [],
      [candidateRow('cand-legacy-2', null)],
      [historyRow('c', 12, '2026-09-05', null), historyRow('d', -38.4, '2026-09-10', 6)],
    );

    const summary = await fetchHandicapHistory('player-1');

    const refresh = scorecardQueries()[2];
    expect(selectOf(refresh)).toContain('holes_played');
    expect(filtersEarlyEnded(refresh)).toBe(true);
    expect(summary.rounds.map((r) => r.scorecardId)).toEqual(['c']);
  });
});
```

- Produces: no new exports. `recalculateScorecardDifferential` treats an ended-early round as incomplete (writes `null`, never throws); `previewCombinedDifferential` / `combineHandicapRounds` reject a pair with an ended-early nine with A4a's message; `fetchCombinableNinePairs` never offers an ended-early nine.

**Why a `holes_played` belt here.** A multi-ball card's server `scores` is `{}` (`scorecardSync.ts` writes single-ball holes only), and a legacy import has no per-hole data either. Both pass `isCompleteForHandicap` under the legacy rule. If such a card's round was ended early, only `rounds.holes_played` says so (spec R21). Every test below uses a `scores: {}` card on a round with `holes_played` set — the case A3/A4a can't catch.

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/combineHandicapRounds.endedEarly.test.ts
/**
 * Combine-two-nines validation — a nine whose round was ended early never
 * combines, even when its card has no per-hole data (multi-ball / legacy),
 * which the card-level completeness check (A4a) lets through.
 */

// supabase.from(table) → a chain whose first .eq(column, value) picks the row
// mockRows[table][value]; .single() resolves it (or a not-found error).
// Every select() column list is recorded in mockSelects[table].
const mockRows: Record<string, Record<string, unknown>> = {};
const mockSelects: Record<string, string[]> = {};

function mockQuery(table: string) {
  let key: string | undefined;
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  chain.select = (columns: string) => {
    mockSelects[table] = [...(mockSelects[table] ?? []), columns];
    return chain;
  };
  chain.eq = (_column: string, value: string) => {
    if (key === undefined) key = value;
    return chain;
  };
  chain.single = () => {
    const row = key === undefined ? undefined : mockRows[table]?.[key];
    return Promise.resolve(
      row ? { data: row, error: null } : { data: null, error: { message: 'not found' } },
    );
  };
  chain.maybeSingle = () => Promise.resolve({ data: null, error: null });
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockQuery(table) },
}));

jest.mock('@/services/queryClient', () => ({
  invalidateHandicapCache: jest.fn(),
}));

jest.mock('@/services/handicap/updatePlayerHandicapIndex', () => ({
  updatePlayerHandicapIndex: jest.fn(() => Promise.resolve()),
}));

jest.mock('@/utils/debugLogger', () => ({
  syncLogger: { info: jest.fn(), debug: jest.fn(), warn: jest.fn(), error: jest.fn() },
}));

import { previewCombinedDifferential } from '@/services/handicap/combineHandicapRounds';

const PLAYER_ID = 'player-1';
const TEE_ID = 'tee-1';

/** 18 × par 4, stroke indexes 1..18 in hole order. */
const COURSE_HOLES = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, i) => ({
  number: i + 1,
  par: 4,
  strokeIndex: i + 1,
}));

/**
 * Seed a front9 + back9 pair on the same course and tee. Both cards have
 * scores: {} (no per-hole data) and a gross of 45.
 */
function seedPair(frontHolesPlayed: number | null, backHolesPlayed: number | null) {
  const card = (id: string, roundId: string) => ({
    id,
    player_id: PLAYER_ID,
    round_id: roundId,
    total_gross: 45,
    ga_handicap_used: null,
    status: 'completed',
    scores: {},
  });
  const round = (id: string, nineType: string, holesPlayed: number | null) => ({
    id,
    course_id: 'course-1',
    nine_type: nineType,
    holes_played: holesPlayed,
    selected_tee: { tee_id: TEE_ID, name: 'Blue', color: 'blue' },
    courses: { holes: COURSE_HOLES },
  });

  mockSelects.rounds = [];
  mockRows.scorecards = {
    'sc-front': card('sc-front', 'round-front'),
    'sc-back': card('sc-back', 'round-back'),
  };
  mockRows.rounds = {
    'round-front': round('round-front', 'front9', frontHolesPlayed),
    'round-back': round('round-back', 'back9', backHolesPlayed),
  };
  mockRows.tees = {
    [TEE_ID]: { id: TEE_ID, name: 'Blue', slope: 125, course_rating: 72.5, slope_women: null, course_rating_women: null },
  };
  mockRows.players = {
    [PLAYER_ID]: { id: PLAYER_ID, gender: 'male', handicap: null },
  };
}

describe('previewCombinedDifferential — ended-early nines', () => {
  it('combines two nines with no hole data (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    seedPair(null, null);

    const preview = await previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back');

    // No hole data → adjusted gross falls back to the combined gross:
    // (113 / 125) × (90 − 72.5) = 15.82 → 15.8
    expect(preview.handicapDifferential).toBe(15.8);
    expect(preview.combinedGross).toBe(90);
  });

  it('requests holes_played with each round', async () => {
    seedPair(null, null);

    await previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back');

    expect(mockSelects.rounds).toHaveLength(2);
    for (const columns of mockSelects.rounds) expect(columns).toContain('holes_played');
  });

  it('rejects a pair whose back nine was ended early', async () => {
    seedPair(null, 6);

    await expect(previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Both nines must be fully scored to combine',
    );
  });

  it('rejects a pair whose front nine was ended early', async () => {
    seedPair(6, null);

    await expect(previewCombinedDifferential('sc-front', 'sc-back')).rejects.toThrow(
      'Both nines must be fully scored to combine',
    );
  });
});
```

```ts
// src/__tests__/services/handicap/loadCombinedAndPairs.endedEarly.test.ts
/**
 * fetchCombinableNinePairs — a nine whose round was ended early is never
 * offered for combining, even when its card has no per-hole data, which the
 * card-level completeness filter (A4a) lets through.
 */

const mockResults: Record<string, { data: unknown; error: unknown }> = {};
const mockCalls: Record<string, { method: string; args: unknown[] }[]> = {};

/** Chainable + thenable stub recording every call; awaiting resolves mockResults[table]. */
function mockQuery(table: string) {
  const chain: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  for (const method of ['select', 'eq', 'in', 'is', 'order', 'limit']) {
    chain[method] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
      mockCalls[table] = [...(mockCalls[table] ?? []), { method, args }];
      return chain;
    };
  }
  chain.then = (resolve: (value: unknown) => unknown, reject?: (reason: unknown) => unknown) =>
    Promise.resolve(mockResults[table] ?? { data: [], error: null }).then(resolve, reject);
  return chain;
}

jest.mock('@/services/supabase/client', () => ({
  supabase: { from: (table: string) => mockQuery(table) },
}));

import { fetchCombinableNinePairs } from '@/services/handicap/loadCombinedAndPairs';

/** A completed 9-hole card with no per-hole data (scores: {}), as the query returns it. */
function nineRow(
  id: string,
  nineType: 'front9' | 'back9',
  holesPlayed: number | null,
  submittedAt: string,
) {
  return {
    id,
    round_id: `round-${id}`,
    total_gross: 45,
    daily_handicap_used: 10,
    handicap_differential: null,
    course_rating_used: 36,
    slope_rating_used: 125,
    submitted_at: submittedAt,
    scores: {},
    rounds: {
      id: `round-${id}`,
      date: submittedAt.slice(0, 10),
      nine_type: nineType,
      holes_played: holesPlayed,
      selected_tee: { name: 'Blue' },
      courses: { id: 'course-1', name: 'Test Course', clubs: { id: 'club-1', name: 'Test Club' } },
    },
  };
}

/** Rows in the query's order (submitted_at desc). */
function seedScorecards(rows: ReturnType<typeof nineRow>[]) {
  mockResults.handicap_combined_rounds = { data: [], error: null };
  mockResults.scorecards = { data: rows, error: null };
  mockCalls.scorecards = [];
}

describe('fetchCombinableNinePairs — ended-early nines', () => {
  it('pairs nines with no hole data (locks current behaviour)', async () => {
    seedScorecards([
      nineRow('b1', 'back9', null, '2026-09-10T08:00:00Z'),
      nineRow('f1', 'front9', null, '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z'),
    ]);

    const pairs = await fetchCombinableNinePairs('player-1');

    expect(pairs).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(pairs[0].front.scorecardId).toBe('f1');
    expect(pairs[0].back.scorecardId).toBe('b1');
  });

  it('excludes ended-early rounds in the query', async () => {
    seedScorecards([]);

    await fetchCombinableNinePairs('player-1');

    const select = mockCalls.scorecards.find((c) => c.method === 'select');
    expect(String(select?.args[0])).toContain('holes_played');
    expect(mockCalls.scorecards).toContainEqual({ method: 'is', args: ['rounds.holes_played', null] });
  });

  it('skips an ended-early nine and pairs the latest one played in full', async () => {
    seedScorecards([
      nineRow('b-ended', 'back9', 6, '2026-09-12T08:00:00Z'),
      nineRow('b-full', 'back9', null, '2026-09-10T08:00:00Z'),
      nineRow('f1', 'front9', null, '2026-09-05T08:00:00Z'),
    ]);

    const pairs = await fetchCombinableNinePairs('player-1');

    expect(pairs).toHaveLength(1);
    // Before: 'b-ended' (the most recent back nine).
    expect(pairs[0].back.scorecardId).toBe('b-full');
  });
});
```
